notes.title: Offer: BMT-72-140, Namer
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]BMT-72-140 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Namer Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between September 23 and September 30, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]BMT-72-140[/h2][p][/p][p]The BMT-72-140 is a prototype of a Ukrainian Main Battle Tank that is also capable of carrying infantry into battle, combining the advantages of both concepts. It consists of a heavily modified and lengthened T-72A hull and a T-72 turret fitted with an automatic loading mechanism and a 140mm gun called Bagheera. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-bmt-72-140"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/890d8b5645b3f58592ab7d76cdb0132fd8f57cda.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the BMT-72-140 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. It offers great performance in all things that matter as it has thick armor, active protection systems, good mobility and excellent firepower. It can also deploy all standard types of infantry to improve either its destructive abilities or to spot enemies earlier than other vehicles of its class.[/p][p]The BMT-72-140 is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Namer[/h2][p][/p][p]The Namer IFV is an Israeli heavy fighting vehicle version of the Namer platform developed in the early 2000s from the Merkava Main Battle Tank. Israel is a small country and cannot affect high infantry losses, which is why the Namer features extremely high levels of protection. The IFV variant is fitted with a Rafael turret, featuring 30mm autocannon and a Spike missile launcher. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-namer"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_79.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Namer is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer. As its history suggests, it is a superheavy TD with its protection levels being amongst the highest of its class. It is slow and ponderous but its thick front can deflect even advanced shells while maintaining adequate firepower thanks to its autocannon and ATGM combination. Its MBT-like characteristics make this vehicle quite forgiving for new players, but, as they say, a jack-of-all-trades is a master of none.[/p][p]The Namer Tier 10 Premium TD is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Now Available: Special Operation “Tiger Shark”
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]The third chapter of the Black Company Special Operation series, “Tiger Shark”, is now available.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OKRjs94KprA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This mission continues the story of Joshua Seagrove and Kathryn Grey and their rise to fame as Black Company mercenaries. Upon the conclusion of the Lone Star mission, Port Houston is liberated from its occupation by Clayburn Industries.[/p][p]In the aftermath of the events, Seagrove and Grey receive an offer from Suez Incorporated to save a ship hijacked by pirates and bringing it back in exchange for clearing their names of war crime accusations. Not willing to waste such an opportunity, they immediately set sail to a small island in the Indian Ocean, controlled by Louis Pareil, a ruthless French ex-special forces operator-turned-warlord so you’ll be in for quite a fight.[/p][p]For more information about the background, please visit our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-special-operation-tiger-shark"]earlier article.[/url][/b][/p][p]It’s also bringing the following features:[/p][list][*][p]28 new Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Reward camouflage: Tiger Shark[/p][/*][*][p]Reward avatar: Pirate[/p][/*][*][p]6 new reward decals[/p][/*][/list][p]We are eagerly awaiting your feedback and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.365 Now Available
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.365[/b] is now available![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OKRjs94KprA;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]List of Update 0.365 Changes[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Tiger Shark Special Operation and Mission Selection[/b][/p][p]We are happy to present the third mission of the Black Company Special Operation – Tiger Shark! In this mission, the Black Company will take on a notorious pirate warlord deep within his domain, on a pirate island in the Indian Ocean! Read more in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/now-available-special-operation-tiger-shark"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p]The Tiger Shark Special Operation also introduces the option for players to actually choose which mission from the Black Company series you want to play. Please note:[/p][list][*][p]To play Tiger Shark, new players must finish the two previous missions at least once[/p][/*][*][p]This mechanic is currently not available for other older Special Operation mission series[/p][/*][/list][p][b]African Contract[/b][/p][p]In this update, we’re adding a new contract replacing the old Basurmanin one. As usual, you are able to complete the contract missions in exchange for the following prizes:[/p][list][*][p]Olifant Mk.2 Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank for the initial contract completion[/p][/*][*][p]South African camouflage and decals available for contract achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Contract Loot Crate with various camouflages, temporary vehicles and other prizes for further completions[/p][/*][/list][p]As usual, the contract will last several months at least so there is plenty of time to finish it. You can read more about the vehicle in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/upcoming-contract-olifant-mk2"]dedicated article.[/url][/b] Please note, however, that the Olifant MBT is currently not in its final state and we are still working on fixing several issues tied to it.[/p][p][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/p][p]In this update, we are fixing the following issues of the Rough Riders Battle Path and its vehicles:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the description of the Solo mission that also requires you to not die before the completion of the objective[/p][/*][*][p]XM1302: Fixed the maximum speed for the upgraded engine to 85 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]XM1302: Fixed the description of the Mitigation passive ability[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p]With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:[/p][list][*][p]BMP-3M: Fixed the infantry door visual model[/p][/*][*][p]VCAC Mephisto: Increased the ammunition carried to 60[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented players from completing a PvE (Heroic) mission in the "Contract from the Unknown 3" Battalion contract[/p][/*][*][p]Several localization fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a number of future event assets[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Scavenger Run is here!
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p][/p][p]Starting on September 19, you’ll be able to earn a major bonus to your next Gold purchase (even a truly massive one, like 80 percent) by participating in the [b]Scavenger Run[/b] event.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d7e592cc4e3db798306c9dcab6cd6de8d23c2ea1.png"][/img]In other words, in case you win such a bonus and buy 1.000 Gold, you’ll receive 1.800 Gold instead. And that can make one hell of a difference (please note, however, that the maximum amount of bonus Gold obtainable this way is 10.000 Gold).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/9a5d7c130af931c1b6db41df3913bfd05f06c3bc.jpg"][/img]Scavenger Run is, in its core, a very simple event. There are many ruined and abandoned objects across the world of Armored Warfare and your friendly neighborhood arms dealer ran across one of them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3873a4941509b892bc900a323d705d520f6ecf9b.jpg"][/img]You are now being hired to scout it out. On a small map, you choose one of three bases and then scout its three warehouses by clicking on them. Depending on your finds (determined randomly), you will receive a sizeable bonus to your next Gold purchase.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/97f48b6d29f92bb005530aa8a28171d0e4b11849.jpg"][/img]This event will be active for several days (the counter in Garage will always tell you how much time is left), so if you’re planning to stock on Gold for the next Battle Path or simply want to boost your progress right now, it’s the perfect opportunity to do so.

We hope that you’ll enjoy this new mechanic and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]
[/p]

notes.title: Event: Diversity Ranking
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]This week we’re going to get into the entire ranking thing in earnest with the first [b]Diversity Ranking[/b] event.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/100_banner_3x_5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A server-wide ranking list is available but this time, the rules (and the prizes) are different. Between September 19 and September 22 (16 CEST), deal damage using as many vehicles as possible as only a single (best) match will count per each vehicle. For example, this means:[/p][list][*][p]Playing 10 times during the event with vehicle A will only count once (the best result from these 10 matches)[/p][/*][*][p]Playing 5 times during the event with vehicle A and 5 times with vehicle B will count twice (the best result for each vehicle)[/p][/*][/list][p]And so on. These results are them summed to produce your total ranking damage. As usual:[/p][list][*][p]The ranking list will refresh once per day[/p][/*][*][p]All regular modes and vehicles count[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The prizes are as follows:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Top 3 damage dealers will earn 10000 Gold each[/p][/*][*][p]Players ranked 4th to 15th will receive 5000 Gold each[/p][/*][*][p]Players ranked 16th to 30th will receive 2000 Gold each[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope that you will enjoy the event and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Western Firepower
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]AbramsX Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Panzer 87-140 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Altay Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]M8 Ridgway skin for M8-120 Thunderbolt II[/p][/*][*][p]Warhammer Skin for M1A2[/p][/*][*][p]Griffin 120mm Tier 8 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Bradley AAWS-H Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer ([b]offer available in all countries[/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Stryker ADATS Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer ([b]offer available in all countries[/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Rough Riders Loot Crate[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between September 18 and September 25, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]AbramsX[/h2][p][/p][p]AbramsX is an advanced technology demonstrator. It was built as a private venture by General Dynamics Land Systems and unveiled in 2022 to show what the future of the Abrams MBT could look like. It is considerably lighter than a fully upgraded Abrams while retaining its protection levels and firepower thanks to its cutting edge systems. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-abramsx"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_378.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the AbramsX is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. While still maintaining the basic Abrams line features such as a 120mm gun, it is considerably lighter and less armored. On the other hand it is also faster, more agile, stealthier, and features a 30mm autocannon that can reduce most light vehicles to a pile of scrap in seconds thanks to its new ammunition. As a result, this tank can dish out a lot of damage but requires careful and skilled gameplay.[/p][p]The AbramsX Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Panzer 87-140[/h2][p][/p][p]The Panzer 87-140 is an experimental version of Panzer 87 (Swiss Leopard 2A4), fitted with a RUAG 140mm smoothbore cannon and an armor kit called WE. It was developed in the 1980s and early 1990s to counter the next generation of Soviet MBTs, but with the collapse of the Soviet Union, the project was shelved, only to resurface around 2005-2006 but never passing the experimental stage. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-panzer-87-140"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_8_1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Panzer 87-140 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Much like other Leopard series MBTs, it’s a long-range fighter with an extremely powerful gun and the ability to fire with pinpoint accuracy. Even though its armor leaves much to be desired, at long range, this MBT has few equals and can be considered one of the best snipers of its class.[/p][p]The Panzer 87-140 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Altay[/h2][p][/p][p]The Altay is the result of a Turkish program to build a true indigenous MBT. After a decade of development with hundreds of millions of dollars spent, Turkey finally achieved its goal and built a tank that is roughly on par in performance with decades-old Leopard 2 variants while it still uses many foreign components, including some of its most critical systems. Nevertheless, future Altay variants are expected to feature some cutting edge components.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="-8zFMkJTESs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Altay is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank based on the current prototypes, but also upgraded by various hypothetical aftermarket components of the future to surpass its current capabilities and to match its assigned Tier in power. The basic tank is – gameplay-wise – a mobile sniper, much like the Leopard 2 series, relying on its mobility and the penetration of its shells rather than on its armor. There are two key features to this tank: Adjustable Suspension (tilting forward and to the side) and Hybrid Engine with its distinctive electric sound, giving the vehicle excellent mobility and agility.[/p][p]The Altay Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]M8 Ridgway Skin[/h2][p][/p][p]This skin for the M8-120 Thunderbolt II Tier 9 Light Tank is based on our idea of what would the M8 have looked like, had it been a part of Operation Just cause, the American invasion of Panama. Its look is based off an existing M551 Sheridan “Airborne Thunder”, which participated in the said operation. You can read more in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-m8-ridgway"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_52.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The skin is available as a part of the Ridgway Bundle, which contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Ridgway skin for M8-120 Thunderbolt II[/p][/*][*][p]Field Drab base paint ([b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-us-airborne"]learn more[/url][/b])[/p][/*][*][p]7 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]1.500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Gallery (Click to Open)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Warhammer Skin for M1A2[/h2][p][/p][p]This skin for the M1A2 Tier 8 progression Main Battle Tank is based on the real American Abrams tanks, which were seen and photographed during the Iraq War. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-m1a2-warhammer"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/warhammer_2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This skin is available in a bundle along with the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Iraq War ochre base paint (used by the U.S. Army)[/p][/*][*][p]U.S. Cavalry decal[/p][/*][*][p]U.S. Company decal[/p][/*][*][p]Thunderbolt decal (this historical decal appeared on a real early Abrams in honor of General Creighton Abrams’ personal Sherman tank during the Second World War)[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that the bundle includes the skin but not the M1A2 MBT itself. This tank needs to be obtained via progression directly in the game.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/warhammer_1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Griffin 120mm[/h2][p][/p][p]The Armored Warfare version of the Griffin Light Tank is based on an early 2016 tech demonstrator, intended to show the U.S. military during the AUSA 2016 conference that General Dynamics meant business. It was built as a private venture; effectively a scaled-up example of General Dynamics was capable of providing when it came to highly mobile vehicles with a lot of firepower for the U.S. airborne forces. The U.S. Army was impressed and the design has since evolved into what is generally referred to as the MPF Light Tank. You can read more about this vehicle in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-griffin-120mm"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_29.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Griffin 120mm is a Tier 8 Premium Light Tank and a powerful, fast machine, armed not only with its 120mm cannon, but also with special ammunition types, making it deadly at any distance. Few Tier 9 vehicles can match its sheer ferocity on the battlefield.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Bradley AAWS-H[/h2][p][/p][p]The Bradley AAWS-H Tank Destroyer was an attempt by Loral Vought to mount four kinetic guided missiles on an extendable arm while using the Bradley IFV chassis as a platform. Kinetic missiles were cutting edge tech back in the 1980s – unlike standard ATGMs, they destroyed the target by their kinetic energy instead of a HEAT warhead, accelerating to several times the speed of sound. There was little to no defense against them, although they did have some drawbacks, which was why they were never adopted in real life. You can read more about the vehicle in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-bradley-aaws-h"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_39.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Bradley AAWS-H is a Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer. It’s an ATGM-based TD, carrying special kinetic missiles that actually become more effective with increasing distance to your target. It is the embodiment of a long-range missile carrier and is perfect for players who prefer sniping to close combat.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Stryker ADATS[/h2][p][/p][p]ADATS stands for “Air Defense Anti-Tank System,” describing its purpose very well. The system is intended to engage both air and ground armored targets. It was developed in the 1980s by a Swiss company called Oerlikon-Contraves and was offered as an interesting hybrid that would be able to deal with both Soviet tanks and helicopters or attack planes. Unfortunately for it, it came too late – only Canada would actually accept it in service and the end of the Cold War meant the end to all attempts at its large-scale introduction. The ADATS missiles were quite large but, more importantly, extremely fast and were certain to be extremely destructive to any Soviet armored targets, even though this thankfully never had to be tested in real combat. The ADATS turret was offered for a wide variety of platforms and was actively installed on a vehicle that is kind of like a cousin to the Stryker, the Canadian LAV-III. In this configuration, the vehicle was called MMEV.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_31.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, Stryker ADATS is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. It is a wheeled vehicle armed with two weapon systems – powerful long-range guided missiles and short-range unguided rockets, offering it some survivability in short range combat as well as the ability to deal tremendous damage if left to its devices.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Rough Riders Loot Crate[/h2][p][/p][p]The [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-now-available"]Rough Riders[/url][/b] Loot Crate is now available. This Loot Crate contains Rough Riders Battle Coins and Boosters.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="5Y1XaHcZOv8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Battle Coins[/b] are the primary currency of the Rough Riders Battle Path campaign and are used to progress through it and to obtain its prizes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle Coin Boosters[/b] are usable only during an active Battle Path and increase your Battle Coin income by 900 percent for two hours.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that you have to obtain the access to a Battle Path to use both items.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Historical Skins: Leopard Evolution “Schweppermann”
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]We have recently shown you the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-german-winter-0"]new camouflages[/url][/b] we will have for you in the future but that’s not all the German-themed content we will have for you. We’ll also be introducing the [b]first skin for the Leopard Evolution Main Battle Tank called “Schweppermann.”[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c3b244ea9cc84b7e7cf1315fc7651d08185bd9bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Now, we promised we’d continue with the topic of knights and here it is. This skin paints the Leopard 2 Evolution in Bundeswehr colors, including its camouflage and unit insignia. Now, the skin is obviously not based on a specific one vehicle because Leopard Evolution is not (and likely never will be) used by the Bundeswehr. It basically was an export configuration that would later be superseded by Leopard Revolution. However, the skin’s specific elements are taken from existing vehicles. Let’s take a look at them one by one.[/p][p]The camouflage is, of course, the standard NATO one. It entered service around 1986 (it therefore predates unified Germany) and consists of three basic colors – green, black and brown. However, as you can see, the tank features additional white stripes across its hull and turret. These stripes (also known as the “Zebra” camouflage) were seen on several Leopard 2 tanks belonging to the 304th Tank Battalion (Panzerbataillon 304) during winter exercises at Hohenfels in the January of 1996. According to the Germans, this pattern obscures the tank silhouette fairly well at around 2500 meters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6f4461b91048750682850afbc32c34e8244dc267.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The tank, however, does not belong to Panzerbataillon 304 – based on its insignia, it belongs to Panzerbataillon 33. This unit was using Leopard 2A4s (the Leopard Evolution is based on) in the early 1990s and was the first one to switch to the newer Leopard 2A5 model. Back then the unit belonged to the 1st Panzergrenadier Brigade (before its disbandment in 2007).[/p][p]The tactical number and the license plate also belong to a tank from the same unit, as does the unit emblem (a palm tree) on the left side of the turret and the knight image on its right side. This charging knight emblem was seen during the same exercise as the camouflage (Hohenfels, January 1996).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/495c5f4494787f1596d9d55f9bc9d6db5600ada2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The only truly unhistorical element is the tank’s name – Schweppermann. The name matches the knight emblem nicely, we thought, as Seyfried Schweppermann was a legendary 13th and 14th century German knight who served Emperor Ludwig IV. He was known not only for his piety and bravery, but also for fighting well into his 60s. The barracks of Panzerbataillon 123 are named after him (we’ll have a [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-german-winter-0"]decal belonging to the unit as well[/url][/b]), bringing the reference to a full circle.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d0c58650827eabcdb6ec0b2a564e9235e5ec3e4d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And that’s it, commanders. The skin will be available alongside the abovementioned camouflages and decals in October. We hope you’ll like it and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: T-90M, Crusader, Object 640 and Boxer RIWP
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Object 640 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]T-90M Proryv Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]XM2001 Crusader Tier 10 Premium Self-Propelled Gun[/p][/*][*][p]Boxer RIWP Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle [b](available directly without Loot Crates)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]ASCOD LT-105 Tier 8 Premium Light Tank [b](available directly without Loot Crates)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between September 16, 2025 and September 23, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]Object 640[/h2][p][/p][p]The Object 640 is one of the last Soviet era “super tank” monsters, designed to surpass anything the west could field on the battlefield. It featured extremely advanced armor, making it highly resistant to hits while keeping its weight low. The design was truly revolutionary for the late 1980s, but, like with many other Soviet projects of the era, it was discontinued due to the lack of funding. You can learn more about it in a [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-640-black-eagle"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_74.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Object 640 “Black Eagle” is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. It is a fast, agile and well-protected vehicle that plays in a typical Russian-style MBT fashion – ideal for players who want to take things up close and personal. This version of the tank does not feature any camouflage and is ready to be customized as you see fit.[/p][p]The Object 640 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]T-90M Proryv[/h2][p][/p][p]The T-90M Proryv the most advanced Russian Main Battle Tank currently in service and the ultimate step in a long journey that began with the T-72. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-t-90m-proryv"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3bdaf7f2f9a83d6dab5c065cf708d34c4a0a6e93.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the T-90M Proryv is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. With its solid firepower, excellent armor and decent mobility, this vehicle is suitable for all players, including fairly new ones. No matter what tactic you choose, the T-90M will not let you down as it is one of the most versatile MBTs in the entire game.[/p][p]The T-90M is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]XM2001 Crusader[/h2][p][/p][p]The XM2001 Crusader is an American attempt to replace the M109A6 Paladin in the 1990s with something more modern. The project was cancelled in 2002 due to its heavy weight. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xm2001-crusader"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="xAjZAYDISN0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In Armored Warfare, the XM2001 Crusader is a Tier 10 Premium Self-Propelled Gun. The Crusader is an ideal vehicle for players who like to play aggressively. Dominate the battlefield with unrivalled firepower of a three-round 155mm magazine paired with guided HE rounds, and retreat under the cover of smoke thanks to your speed and agility. The Crusader is the ultimate SPG you've been dreaming of![/p][p]The Crusader is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Boxer RIWP[/h2][p][/p][p]The Boxer RIWP is a combination of a Tracked Boxer hull and a modular turret called RIWP. Both components are fairly new and haven’t been officially combined as of now but the Boxer platform can theoretically support this weapon system. You can read more about it in [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-boxer-riwp"]our dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/boxerriwp_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Boxer RIWP is a Tier 10 Premium AFV that’s unique for one reason – it offers five fairly distinctive weapon configurations along with a reliable autocannon capable of quickly dealing with lighter targets. It can also deploy Mechanized Infantry.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]ASCOD LT-105[/h2][p][/p][p]If there was a word best describing the ASCOD platform, it would be the word “international”. It was developed by the Austrians and the Spanish, adopted by the British and available with a wide range of turrets. The joint project from 1988 eventually led to a number of vehicles using the ASCOD platform, the two best-known results of which are the Austrian Ulan IFV and the Spanish Pizarro IFV. The ASCOD LT-105 was a fire support variant of the platform, offered with pretty much any turret a customer would like, including those from B1 Centauro, M1128 MGS or even a South-African one by Denel. However, after two decades of not having to found any customers, the project was terminated and by 2015-2016, it was removed from all official offers. You can learn more about it in a [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-ascod-lt-105"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4090d215c282c5b2c88708ba9de9843182318e75.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the ASCOD LT-105 is a Tier 8 Premium Light Tank. It is fairly unique in one aspect. It is possible to select one of the two turrets: the manned Denel turret with the GT7 gun or the Low-Profile Turret by General Dynamics with the M68 gun, known from the M1128. The first turret has better kinetic shells but fires in a normal manner, while the latter has a clip-style autoloader, balanced by worse overall characteristics of the gun.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Historical Camouflages – German (Winter)
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]The summer’s technically not over yet but the weather says different and with it behind us, it’s time to take a look at some of our upcoming autumn content. For a future German-themed event, we’ve prepared new camouflages and decals for you. Let’s take a look at them together.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f96582140e2c372edfa39a81a5cebc0a8609c841.png"][/img][/p][p]The first of our winter camouflages is called [b]German (134 Panzerbataillon).[/b] As its name suggests, this unusual (atypical) German camouflage was seen on a Leopard 1A1A2 belonging to the 134th Tank Battalion of the 13th Panzergrenadier Brigade during the Central Guardian exercise in the morning of January 21, 1985, in Ohmes near Kirtorf.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3941b67d667d305e86a9788a3974e1bba18bf768.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Central Guardian was a part of the wider REFORGER 85 exercise and the German goal of it was to train in poor weather conditions alongside the U.S. Army reinforcing NATO’s eastern flank. Indeed, it was a cold, snowy day in West Germany and the crew decided to paint their otherwise white-painted tank with irregular green lines to break its silhouette.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/251010d4570f4a46d6bc300b2ba5629acd2f87ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The second camouflage is considerably more modern. It’s called [b]German (Gebirgsjägerbrigade 23)[/b] and was seen on a Bandvagn 206 carrier belonging to the German 23rd Mountain Infantry Brigade during the Grand North exercise in Norway in the February and March of 2024.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3ed0b3642843e2a2d9e1217ad9b357c67d535c72.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The exercise was a part of the Quadriga 24 Bundeswehr exercise, the goal of which was once again training relocation and combat in poor weather with some 12000 German soldiers taking part in it.[/p][p]In addition to these camouflages, there will be three decals available, all three belonging to Bundeswehr tanks.[/p][p]The [b]Panzerbataillon 123 decal[/b] displays the knight helmet of Seyfried Schweppermann, a legendary German knight from the 14th century. It was seen during an exercise in 1990 on a Leopard 2 tank belonging to the 123rd Tank Battalion of the 12th Tank Brigade during an exercise.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5d94ca2f29712d8f58d8f05782e0e05671e0a1de.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You may know this emblem from the Leopard 2A4 Budeswehr skin that’s already available and belongs to the same unit. It was adopted by the unit in 1974 and it symbolizes the shock and awe power of armored, mobile troops – be it tanks today or knights in the Middle Ages. We’ll talk more about Seyfried Schweppermann in the future.[/p][p]The [b]Panzerbataillon 121 decal[/b] also carries medieval symbolism with it. It displays a knight sword in a yellow triangle and was seen on a Leopard 2 tank belonging to the 121st Tank Battalion of the 12th Tank Brigade during the same exercise. The color yellow is common for all emblems of this tank brigade.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/1c49407715de207fe0c6cc602bf9a725c266ff52.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The sword is double-edged, which actually has a meaning – it’s meant to symbolize that the tanks and panzergrenadiers (mechanized infantry) are two blades of the same sword.[/p][p]And, last but not least, the [b]Teutonic Knight decal[/b] showing a charging knight with a lance in the form of a machinegun barrel was seen relatively recently on a Leopard 2A6 tank belonging to the 203rd Tank Battalion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/66efdc894e9a8014d8ac60a743e6c622ededef49.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And that’s it for now, but we’ll return to the topic of knights in the near future. We hope that you’ll enjoy the new assets and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

You’ll find the gift in the Gift section of the shop.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=gift"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you’ll enjoy this present and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Eastern Vehicles
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]TOS-1M Buratino Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Koshmar skin for TOS-1M[/p][/*][*][p]Armata 152 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Boyevaya Podruga skin for T-14 Armata[/p][/*][*][p]Defender skin for T-80UM-1 Bars[/p][/*][*][p]Spetsnaz skin for BMP-1P[/p][/*][*][p]Kurganets-25 Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Msta-S Tier 9 Premium Self-Propelled Gun[/p][/*][*][p]Khrizantema-S Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Object 787 Gadyuka Tier 6 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Iron Crate[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between September 11 and 18, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]TOS-1M Buratino[/h2][p][/p][p]The TOS-1M Buratino is a prototype version of the Russian TOS-1/TOS-1A heavy rocket launcher. It was designed in 1997 at Omsk as an improvement to the old TOS-1 whose roots go back all the way to the Afghan War. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-tos-1m-buratino"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/tos-1m_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the TOS-1M Buratino is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer. As befits its massive rocket launcher installed on the top of a T-90A MBT chassis, its firepower is all but unparalleled and you are looking at perhaps the most destructive vehicle of Armored Warfare. It is available in two configurations – with fast-launching 122mm rockets and the iconic 220mm rockets that can be unlocked either by installing a skin (Koshmar), or by progressing through an active Battle Path.[/p][p]The TOS-1M is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Koshmar Bundle[/h2][p][/p][p]Additionally, we've prepared a skin bundle with a new skin. The skin “Koshmar” we have prepared for you is for the TOS-1M Tier 10 Premium TD. Not only is it cool looking, it also [b]unlocks the overprogression modules for you, including the 220mm turret and the 220mm thermobaric rockets.[/b] You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-tos-1m-koshmar"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/tos-1m_koshmar_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The skin is available as a part of the Koshmar Bundle, which contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Skin: TOS-1M Koshmar[/p][/*][*][p]3 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Armata 152[/h2][p][/p][p]The Armata 152 is a version of the T-14 Armata, armed with larger cannon. One of the upgrades considered for the T-14 Armata was the increase of its caliber to 152mm in order to absolutely, positively destroy anything with the first shot. The 2A83 smoothbore is a behemoth of a gun, designed in the last days of the Soviet empire for the next generation of super-tanks. It’s massive, heavy and quite costly to produce, but, most importantly, it was never truly needed to deal with the western MBTs since the standard 125mm guns were (and still are) up to the task. That is why it never found its way on any Soviet MBT with even the standard T-14 Armata being armed with an improved 125mm cannon. You can, however, experience its awesome firepower in Armored Warfare! Learn more about it in a [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/overkill-152mm-cannons-russian-mbts"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/543121b5b57b3b962c6ed51ec05accf900f10fb3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the T-14 Armata 152 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. While not firing as fast as its 125mm counterpart, the 152mm rounds do enormous damage, often eliminating weaker opponents with a single shot. And then there’s the platform itself – the Armata, the most modern Main Battle Tank in the world. Earn it and use it to dominate![/p][p]The Armata 152 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Boyevaya Podruga Bundle (T-14 Armata)[/h2][p][/p][p]The Boyevaya Podruga skin for the T-14 Armata Tier 10 Main Battle Tank is modeled after a famous Soviet WW2 tank, commanded by Mariya Oktyabrskaya. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-second-world-war"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c046b3f69cf59bbb46d80196292fdaa400d1ea03.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The skin is available as a part of the Boyevaya Podruga bundle, which contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Skin: Boyevaya Podruga for T-14 Armata[/p][/*][*][p]8 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Bundle (T-80UM-1)[/h2][p][/p][p]This skin for the T-80UM-1 Tier 8 MBT is based on the camouflage and markings as seen in 2006 on a T-80U in Kubinka. You can read more about it in a [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-t-80um-1-defender"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/84fc2eb5327ce4365f42ec7060634caf9a940c32.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are offering the Defender skin in a bundle, which includes:[/p][list][*][p]Defender skin for the T-80UM-1 MBT[/p][/*][*][p]3 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]BMP-1P Spetsnaz Skin[/h2][p][/p][p]The skin for the BMP-1P Tier 4 AFV is based on a BMP-1 belonging to the 101st Special Operations Brigade of the Internal Troops of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation, as seen during the Battle of Grozny in 1996. You can read more in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-bmp-1p-spetsnaz"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b4814a423bb2b5854121af568d8ce8f992a26406.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The skin is available as a part of the Spetsnaz Bundle, which contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Skin: Spetsnaz[/p][/*][*][p]Russian (Interior Forces) camouflage[/p][/*][*][p]3 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Kurganets-25[/h2][p][/p][p]The Kurganets-25 Infantry Fighting Vehicle is intended as a cutting edge future replacement to the old BMP series in Russian service. While not as chunky and expensive as the T-15 Armata super-heavy IFV, it’s designed to finally offer the 21st century protection levels the Russian military has been demanding for a long time. However, the design turned out to be quite expensive and while it is currently undergoing state trials, it is unlikely to be ever mass-produced. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kurganets-25"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/kurganets-25_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Kurganets-25 is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. Even though it offers decent protection and mobility for its class, this vehicle is all about firepower. To make sure you always have the right tool for the job, it comes with three distinctive weapon systems – a 57mm autocannon for light targets, fast and small Bulat missiles for highly mobile targets and, finally, full-sized ATGMs that can defeat pretty much anything on the battlefield. If dealing damage is your thing, few vehicles will match your playstyle better.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Msta-S[/h2][p][/p][p]The Msta-S SPG was developed as a replacement to the older 2S3 Akatsiya. The goal was to match (or surpass) the newly developed NATO artillery pieces with long 155mm guns. The production began in 1988 and is currently ongoing with a modernized variant rolling out for the Russian military. More than 500 Msta-S SPGs are still in Russian service and dozens were exported to several other countries. It has seen some combat during the Second Chechen War and the War in Donbass. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-msta-s"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/msta-s_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Msta-S is a Tier 9 Self-Propelled Gun, which makes it only usable in the Global Operations mode and in PvE. It comes with two shell types – a slow-flying one with a high flight arc, and a fast-flying one for use against more mobile targets.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Khrizantema-S[/h2][p][/p][p]The Khrizantema-S is a dedicated tank hunter, built on a modified BMP-3 hull. The first Khrizantema-S prototype appeared in public as early as 1996 with the initial production variant (9P157) entering service in 2005. Around 2010, an upgraded variant called 9P157-2 appeared with a modernized Ukrainian optics system and a hull machinegun the original model lacked. This variant was in use until 2017. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-khrizantema-s"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/khrizantema-s_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Khizantema-S is a Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer. It is quite a stealthy vehicle armed with a twin ATGM launcher. The key to achieving excellent results with this machine is long-range ATGM sniping followed by rapid relocation. The missiles are quite powerful and make hits easy thanks to their excellent performance.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Gadyuka[/h2][p][/p][p]The Gadyuka (“Viper”) is a Soviet-era fire support vehicle consisting of a T-72A hull and turret but instead of the main gun, the vehicle is armed with two 30mm autocannons and two rocket pods in order to perform better against infantry in urban and mountainous environments. A single prototype was built in 1996 and even though the project was cancelled, it eventually led to the rise of the BMPT Terminator series. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-787-gadyuka"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/object_787_gadyuka_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Gadyuka is a Tier 6 Premium Tank Destroyer. Despite having only average protection, its two 30mm autocannons can, along with deadly rocket salvos, rip through enemy vehicles with ease. Indeed, the Gadyuka is one of the most destructive vehicles of its Tier and a worthy addition to every player’s arsenal.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Iron Crate[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve prepared for you an additional offer this week. The [b]Iron Crate[/b] is available in our Web Shop![/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_179_0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This crate allows you to win a Tier 4 to Tier 10 Premium vehicle (or its value in Gold if you have it already). The crate contains some very rare vehicles, including:[/p][list][*][p]ZTL-11 Tier 9 Premium TD[/p][/*][*][p]VN17 Tier 8 Premium AFV[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.360 Now Available
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p align="start"]We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.360[/b] is now available![/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/90a635665c3c6108652766f6ecbaad593ce61a19.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]List of Update 0.360 Changes[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Premium Vehicles for Gold[/b][/p][p align="start"]In this update, we are adding the following Premium vehicles to the dealer trees. These are now available for Gold:[/p][list][*][p]Sophie Wölfli: M60-2000 Tier 7 MBT for 5500 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Sophie Wölfli: Stryker ADATS Tier 9 TD for 14000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Zhang Feng: T-72M2 Wilk Tier 6 MBT for 3250 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Zhang Feng: WWO Wilk Tier 8 TD for 9000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Zhang Feng: VT5 Tier 9 LT for 14000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Marat Shishkin: BMPT Mod.2000 Tier 8 TD for 9000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Marat Shishkin: Challenger Falcon Tier 8 MBT for 9000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Francine De Laroche: Type 90 Tier 7 MBT for 5500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]XM1302 Adjustment[/b][/p][p align="start"]We have analyzed the statistics of the new XM1302 Light Tank and have determined that the vehicle is a little bit too strong. Alright, not just a little bit – we are looking at 65% PvP winrate, making it currently hands down the best vehicle in the game by a wide margin, which is something that has to be addressed.[/p][p align="start"]We are therefore making the following adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]Removed the Spall Liner module increasing the vehicle’s hitpoints[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the Improved Transmission module increasing the vehicle’s maximum speed[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the vehicle’s hitpoints to 3300[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the vehicle’s maximum speed to 85 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the Mitigation ability damage reduction values from 50%/75%/90% to 40%/55%/70% (the ability still reduces module damage taken)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]In short, we removed two modules but improved the base values to compensate (even a bit beyond the bonus the modules provided) and reduced the damage reduction of the Mitigation ability (the speed thresholds remain the same). The vehicle will still be very powerful (we haven’t nerfed its firepower) but now won’t be all but unstoppable.[/p][p align="start"][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/p][p align="start"]In this update, we are fixing the following issues of the Rough Riders Battle Path and its vehicles:[/p][list][*][p]We (fingers crossed) fixed the issue plaguing the Battle Path Shop where players weren’t able to buy items due to the fact that what they see in the Shop is not what the server sees. Such desynchronizations should no longer occur[/p][/*][*][p]Rolling Thunder mission can no longer be completed using any vehicle and requires Light Tanks as intended[/p][/*][*][p]All MERDCS camouflages from the main progression are now correctly compensated (one was missing and we will send the missing Battle Coins to the affected players)[/p][/*][*][p]ELKE: Vehicle is now assigned to Oscar Faraday[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p align="start"]With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the collision model of a number of vehicles (T-80B, Type 90-II, VFM5, ZBL-08, Assaulter, BMP-2M, BMP-3M, Challenger 1)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where attempting to deploy infantry when driving on a slope leads to their instant death[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where it was sometimes impossible to load different shells in the ammunition window[/p][/*][*][p]When firing autocannons in the first person view mode, players can no longer see traces of gunsmoke[/p][/*][*][p]BMPT-72: Fixed an issue that made it impossible to use the Supercharged APS active ability[/p][/*][*][p]BMT-72-140: Fixed the gun depression angles[/p][/*][*][p]BMT-72-140: Removed an incorrect trait from the vehicle (as it does not feature multiple weapon configurations)[/p][/*][*][p]BTR-82A: Small visual model fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Gepard: Fixed an issue causing the aiming reticle to move when switching between first person and third person views[/p][/*][*][p]K1A1: Upgrade modules are now installed by default and do not require unlock[/p][/*][*][p]KF41 Prototype: Small visual model fixes[/p][/*][*][p]KNIFV NLOS: The module adding a bonus to target lock speed from a module is now working correctly (also, we reduced the bonus from 25% to 20%)[/p][/*][*][p]M551 Sheridan: Improved engine now actually improves vehicle performance[/p][/*][*][p]Puma: Tracks no longer move faster than roadwheels[/p][/*][*][p]Shilka: Stock AP shell penetration increased from 60mm to 220mm[/p][/*][*][p]Shilka: Improved AP shell penetration increased from 100mm to 270mm[/p][/*][*][p]Shilka: PELE shell penetration increased from 92mm to 220mm[/p][/*][*][p]T92 and T-92 ACAV: Fixed the visual model (machineguns no longer fly in the air)[/p][/*][*][p]T-62: Fixed the visual model (gun no longer flies in the air)[/p][/*][*][p]T-64BV Mod.2017: Small visual model fixes[/p][/*][*][p]T-90A Burlak: Fixed the flying damaged armor elements on the Gromozeka skin[/p][/*][*][p]TOS-1M: Fixed an issue causing the aiming reticle to move when switching between first person and third person views[/p][/*][*][p]VCAC Mephisto: Improved the time between missile launches from 3s to 2.5s[/p][/*][*][p]VFM5: Added the partial reloading feature again[/p][/*][*][p]ZTZ-20: Small visual model fixes[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]General Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]We continue to research the map loading issues and have implemented several adjustments in order to mitigate their impact (however, the issue is not considered fixed)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Beasts of Steel event mission description (added Tier requirement)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that produced a black screen upon pressing the Reconnect button (when experiencing a disconnect)[/p][/*][*][p]Rate of Decay: Fixed the collision of several rocks so that players no longer fall through them[/p][/*][*][p]Several smaller localization fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a number of future event assets[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Offer: XM2001 Crusader, EBRC
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]XM2001 Crusader Tier 10 Premium Self-Propelled Gun[/p][/*][*][p]EBRC Jaguar Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between September 9, 2025 and September 16, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]XM2001 Crusader[/h2][p][/p][p]The XM2001 Crusader is an American attempt to replace the M109A6 Paladin in the 1990s with something more modern. The project was cancelled in 2002 due to its heavy weight. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xm2001-crusader"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][previewyoutube="xAjZAYDISN0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the XM2001 Crusader is a Tier 10 Premium Self-Propelled Gun. The Crusader is an ideal vehicle for players who like to play aggressively. Dominate the battlefield with unrivalled firepower of a three-round 155mm magazine paired with guided HE rounds, and retreat under the cover of smoke thanks to your speed and agility. The Crusader is the ultimate SPG you've been dreaming of![/p][p]The Crusader is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]EBRC Jaguar[/h2][p][/p][p]The Jaguar is a part of the Scorpion program, launched to develop France’s next generation of armored fighting vehicles. In this program, the Jaguar fulfills the role of a light recon and fire support vehicle. It combines cutting edge technology with high speed and excellent firepower. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-ebrc-jaguar"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080t_2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Jaguar is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It’s fast, light and an amazing scout, but it can also hold its own in combat thanks to its 40mm cannon, guided missiles and active suspension.[/p][p]The Jaguar Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Contract: Olifant Mk.2
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]This autumn, we’ll be replacing the current set of Contract missions that allow you to receive the BMP-1AM Basurmanin AFV with a brand-new African contract that will feature a new prize – the [b]Olifant Mk.2 Main Battle Tank![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/da031d6506e1e0e0b16524edc010ea9a657373b8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Olifant Mk.2 (Afrikaans for “Elephant”) is South Africa’s most advanced Main Battle Tank to date but, much like many other vehicles of the same class, it’s build on much older foundations. The Olifant is a heavily modified (and the final evolution of) the British Centurion MBT, the roots of which go back the final days of the Second World War.[/p][p]South Africa purchased some 200 Centurions Mk.3 from the United Kingdom in the early 1950s but they didn’t last long in service due to issues with maintenance constant overheating. In 1961, half of them were sold off to Switzerland and the other half was mothballed. However, with the threat of Angola rising in the mid-1970s, it was decided to bring them back.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f36fb38a1b05f843ca2d438e2a130b2010a54f08.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The first Olifants (the Mk.1 version) appeared in the late 1970s. With the help of Israel, they were retrofitted with different engines and built upon imported hulls. The armament was local-made, however, making the Olifant the best indigenous African tank in history. The tank saw battle in 1987. During a single battle, South African Olifants destroyed two Angolan T-55 tanks.[/p][p]In the early 1990s, the Mk.1B version appeared with additional armor. The final Mk.2 version was designed with lessons from the Border War in mind. The initial requirements from 1998 called for 96 brand-new MBTs but with the existing budget restraints, it was decided to upgrade existing Olifant Mk.1B’s instead.[/p][p]The Mk.1B version already featured upgraded armor (in form of composite plates covering both the hull and the turret) and the Mk.2 added a new engine to the package along with a new fire control system governing the 105mm Denel GT3B gun.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/dcfde57e3ea514c650c295f8f4e7d1229d9f521f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Ultimately, only 25 vehicles of this type were built between 2005 and 2018. Still, the Olifant is a great example of what budget upgrades can accomplish. With gradual parts replacements over the decades, not much is left of the old Centurion.[/p][p][b]In Armored Warfare, the Olifant Mk.2 will be a Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank.[/b][/p][p]Overall, we are looking at a relatively well-protected Main Battle Tank for its Tier. Compared to Centurion AVRE, the main difference is of course the main gun, which, in this case, is a 105mm rifled cannon. As such, the Olifant will offer more consistent firepower compared to the AVRE, making it more suitable to prolonged engagements. The vehicle will feature a standard set of Tier-appropriate shells, including APFSDS, HESH and HE.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f74049857f71b356c3c8c54acc175b0282377352.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A unique element of this vehicle is the presence of smoke shells and white phosphorus shells. The Olifant will be able to fire these shells from its main gun, providing extra support on the battlefield.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a02546e02f34eef8b0925a603ceaccd3e049fa88.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While lacking ERA, the protection will also be excellent thanks to all that additional armor on its Centurion hull. Aiding in this regard will be the Defense unlockable active ability. Its 1040hp engine will also ensure solid mobility across all surfaces, roughly comparable to the Merkava Mk.2D, although its maximum speed won’t be exactly high (58 km/h).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/bbc5d7ec5cba5a93e8e1cfe0ebdd9d40dcb56f2c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Alongside the vehicle, you will be able to obtain other prizes as well during the next contact (for completing Contract Missions), including:[/p][list][*][p]South African camouflage[/p][/*][*][p]Various South African decals[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope that you’ll enjoy the new contract and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: EMBT, Discounted Gold
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]EMBT Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Challenger 2 Streetfighter II Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Boxer CRV Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Otomatic Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Gepard Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Loot Crate[/p][/*][*][p]Treasure Trove with 10.000 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between September 4, 2025 and September 11, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]EMBT[/h2][p][/p][p]The Enhanced Main Battle Tank (EMBT) is a future MBT demonstrator developed over the course of several years as cooperation between the Germany (KMW) and the French (Nexter). It features a heavily modified Leopard 2 hull with a brand-new turret unveiled in 2022 during the Eurosatory 2022 expo in Paris. Our version of the tank is armed with 140mm ASCALON gun. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-embt"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/embt_1920x1080.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the EMBT is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Extreme accuracy and firepower are its domain as it features an incredibly powerful 140mm gun and a special ability called Machine Learning that increases the kinetic round penetration with each shot (up to three times). In its medium range support vehicle role, this tank has few equals thanks to the abovementioned ability and the availability of top-attack HEAT rounds.[/p][p]The EMBT Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Challenger 2 Streetfighter II[/h2][p][/p][p]The Streetfighter II is an upgrade program to overhaul the venerable Challenger 2 Main Battle Tank for the conditions of modern battlefields, especially urban combat. It features a number of improvements and extra components, most notably a dozer blade, a Brimstone ATGM twin launcher and an advanced camera system by Elbit. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-challenger-2-streetfighter-ii"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_72.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Challenger 2 Streetfighter is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Its main advantages include excellent frontal armor (enhanced by the presence of its dozer blade covering its lower frontal plate), increased ramming damage and long range lethality, courtesy of a powerful ATGM launcher. Whether you desire to bring the fighting up close or support other MBTs at distance, the Streetfighter’s got your back.[/p][p]The Challenger 2 Streetfighter II Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Boxer CRV[/h2][p][/p][p]The Boxer CRV is the Infantry Fighting Vehicle variant of the Boxer platform, featuring a cutting edge turret with 30mm autocannon and guided missiles. It is a truly next-gen IFV with orders coming from all over the world, most notably from Australia and Germany. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-boxer-crv"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/boxer_crv_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Boxer CRV is a Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It is one of the best IFVs in its class, offering a combination of solid mobility and great firepower, including Mechanized Infantry deployment and the dreaded double-launch ATGM feature.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Otomatic[/h2][p][/p][p]The Otomatic was an attempt from the 1980s and 1990s to mate originally naval 76mm rapid-firing cannon with a tracked chassis (either of Palmaria or a Leopard) to create an advanced anti-aircraft gun. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-otomatic"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/otomatic_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Otomatic a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. Thanks to its fast-firing 76mm gun it can deal tremendous amounts of damage over short periods of time and can deal effectively with any target it encounters on the battlefield.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Gepard[/h2][p][/p][p]The Gepard is one of the best short-range anti-aircraft self-propelled guns in the world. Made primarily for Germany and the Netherlands, it remains in active use to this day and has recently seen some combat in Ukraine. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-flakpanzer-gepard"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/gepard_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Gepard a Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. Unlike the Otomatic, it relies not on a single larger gun, but on the hailstorm of shells provided by its two 35mm autocannons. Even the toughest of targets crumble under its withering fire.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Commander Loot Crate[/h2][p][/p][p]This week, we’ve prepared another special offer for you in the form of a brand new [b]Commander Loot Crate[/b], featuring, amongst other things, some of the rarest commanders in the game![/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_228.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This Loot Crate gives you the opportunity to obtain the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Commander Ofelia Kitescu[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Austin Harper[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Alexander Cortez[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Alisa Korhonen[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Erin O’Connell[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Jorge Alvarez[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Joshua Seagrove[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Fyodor Sokolov[/p][/*][*][p]Platinum Commander XP Insignia tokens[/p][/*][*][p]Gold Commander XP Insignia tokens[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Treasure Trove[/h2][p][/p][p]Today, we have a special offer for you. [b]A veritable treasure trove of 10.000 Gold[/b] awaits you at a discounted price.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/chest_of_gold.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Please note[/b] that this item can only be purchased once per user. You can find out more about Gold and its uses in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/guide-boosting-your-progress"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

The selection is wide – now’s the right time to sample which sort of gameplay suits you the most![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/2b9290e710e4513ae8119caec91d9803da88dde9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]After claiming them, these vehicles will appear as tokens [b]in your Inventory section[/b] and can be activated at any point in the future.[/p][p][b]Click on the button below to visit the Web Shop:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=gift"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Bonuses[/h2][p][/p][p]But that’s not all. For the duration of the event, [b]we’ve prepared a set of awesome bonuses![/b] These include:[/p][list][*][p]50% bonus to Battle Coin income from battles[/p][/*][*][p]30% bonus to Credit income from battles[/p][/*][*][p]30% bonus to Experience income from battles[/p][/*][*][p]30% bonus to Reputation income from battles[/p][/*][/list][p]This event represents a great opportunity for Armored Warfare beginners to unlock new vehicles faster than usual with the bonuses as well as to try out what playstyle and vehicle fits then the most.[/p][p][b]And as for you, dear veterans, enjoy the bonuses and don’t forget to share your hard-earn wisdom with the new guys. After all, nobody begins as an expert![/b][/p][p][b]Please note:[/b][/p][list][*][p]There are no compensations for claiming any of these vehicles (Inventory tokens are impossible to activate if you have the permanent version already)[/p][/*][*][p]To activate a temporary vehicle (after claiming it in the Web Shop), please visit your Inventory section of the Garage[/p][/*][*][p]In case you encounter an issue claiming the vehicles in the Web Shop (Error -1006), please wait 15 minutes and try again[/p][/*][*][p]Like what you see? If you play a temporary vehicle and later decide to obtain it permanently (by any means, including random drops, Contracts, Steam DLCs, Web Shop, Battle Path or as a prize from a Loot Crate), your progression (such as crew training) will carry over from the temporary version issued during this event[/p][/*][*][p]There is a known issue with some temporary vehicles having wrong icons, the vehicles themselves are however working as intended[/p][/*][*][p]Having issues claiming gifts with Error -1006? Please wait 15 minutes and try again![/p][/*][*][p]Items from Web Shop disappear after claiming them – look for your vehicle tokens in Inventory[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope that you’ll enjoy the event an, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]
