notes.title: Offer: Object 195 and Object 490
notes.content: [h1]Offer: Object 195 and Object 490[/h1][list][*][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-veteran"]previous[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]Sep 02nd | 2025[/p][p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Object 490 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Object 195 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between September 2 and September 9, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]Object 490[/h2][p][/p][p]The Object 490 Main Battle Tank was an advanced concept from the waning days of the Soviet Union. Designed in the 1980s, it represented a radical departure from the MBT paradigm. Its distinct wedge-like shape, along with the fact that the crew was located in the back, offered unparalleled levels of protection. But the most interesting part of the design was its double suspension paired with two engines, allowing the vehicle to stay mobile even after suffering significant damage. However, the conclusion of the Cold War put an end to this design, along with many other advanced Soviet projects. You can learn more about this vehicle in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-490"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/object490_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Object 490 Tier 10 Premium MBT is perhaps the best armored vehicle in the game. It’s a true behemoth that is almost impossible to slow down, let alone knock out, and concentrated effort is required to stop one of these things when encountering them on the battlefield. The combination of extremely thick armor and a powerful 152mm gun makes this tank incredibly deadly, even though these advantages are balanced by its mediocre agility and the fact that its gun is only forward facing. This MBT is ideal for you if you prefer slow, methodical advances while dealing massive amounts of damage with each shot. If you keep your flanks secure, you’ll be all but impossible to stop.[/p][p]The Object 490 MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Object 195[/h2][p][/p][p]The Object 195 Main Battle Tank is one of the 1980s Soviet supertanks, intended to fight the next generation of NATO MBTs. It was developed in Nizhny Tagil by the experienced Uralvagonzavod design bureau (UKBTM), which was responsible for such legendary tanks as the T-72 and T-90. Much like other such prototypes, it was designed to be armed with massive 152mm smoothbore cannon in an unmanned turret. A single prototype was built and it allegedly passed state trials between 2008 and 2010 but the project was discontinued due to a lack of financing. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-195"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/object195_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Object 195 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank and one of the most versatile vehicles you can get your hands on thanks to a combination of excellent armor, unmanned turret, 152mm hard-hitting gun and one special feature – the coaxial 30mm autocannon that allows you to take out unarmored targets without having to waste a shot of your main weapon.[/p][p]The Object 195 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Historical Camouflages – Veteran
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]In September, we celebrate the Tank Crew Day holiday in honor of all tank crews. This time, we’ll have a camouflage for you along with two historical decals and one not-so-historical avatar. Let’s take a look at them together.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/575dfd776fdbb9bcb9a0934dcdbe21607c4812f2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Veteran camouflage[/b] is semi-historical as it hasn’t been seen on a tank but, of all things, an ambulance truck. We thought the camouflage interesting not only for its improvised pattern consisting of leaf shapes on a dark green surface, but also the fact the vehicle was shot up. The bullet and shrapnel damage forms an integral part of the pattern, giving your vehicles a very battle-weary look.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3aa3b728f1ba545dc3a57568fe300151f83aa420.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The decals, on the other hand, are realistic. There are two. The [b]“Demon” decal[/b] was seen on a T-64B Main Battle Tank back in the summer of 2014, airbrushed on the upper frontal plate ERA. The will also be available as a player avatar.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/589a7c76e7ce2fac765efef49717ab2d2365d5f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The second [b]decal “Maw”[/b] is even older and comes from a Russian BTR used during one of the wars in Chechnya.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/558ceeef2ad86ec81f0eac04ecb8dc7472040880.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We hope that you’ll enjoy the new assets and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Eastern Bloc Week
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p align="start"]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p][b]Armata 152 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Object 640 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/b][/p][/*][*][p]M-95 Degman Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]ZUBR PSP Tier 7 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]BWP-2000 Tier 7 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rough Riders Battle Coins[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Between August 28, 2025 and September 4, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Armata 152[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The Armata 152 is a version of the T-14 Armata, armed with larger cannon. One of the upgrades considered for the T-14 Armata was the increase of its caliber to 152mm in order to absolutely, positively destroy anything with the first shot. The 2A83 smoothbore is a behemoth of a gun, designed in the last days of the Soviet empire for the next generation of super-tanks. It’s massive, heavy and quite costly to produce, but, most importantly, it was never truly needed to deal with the western MBTs since the standard 125mm guns were (and still are) up to the task. That is why it never found its way on any Soviet MBT with even the standard T-14 Armata being armed with an improved 125mm cannon. You can, however, experience its awesome firepower in Armored Warfare! Learn more about it in a [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/overkill-152mm-cannons-russian-mbts"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/543121b5b57b3b962c6ed51ec05accf900f10fb3.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In Armored Warfare, the T-14 Armata 152 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. While not firing as fast as its 125mm counterpart, the 152mm rounds do enormous damage, often eliminating weaker opponents with a single shot. And then there’s the platform itself – the Armata, the most modern Main Battle Tank in the world. Earn it and use it to dominate![/p][p align="start"]The Armata 152 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Object 640[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The Object 640 is one of the last Soviet era “super tank” monsters, designed to surpass anything the west could field on the battlefield. It featured extremely advanced armor, making it highly resistant to hits while keeping its weight low. The design was truly revolutionary for the late 1980s, but, like with many other Soviet projects of the era, it was discontinued due to the lack of funding. You can learn more about it in a [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-640-black-eagle"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_74.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In Armored Warfare, the Object 640 “Black Eagle” is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. It is a fast, agile and well-protected vehicle that plays in a typical Russian-style MBT fashion – ideal for players who want to take things up close and personal. This version of the tank does not feature any camouflage and is ready to be customized as you see fit.[/p][p align="start"]The Object 640 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]M-95 Degman[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The M-95 Degman is an advanced Croatian prototype MBT, developed during the 1990s and 2000s. It is based on the previous Yugoslavian project, the Vihor MBT, which in turn has its roots in the improved T-72M series produced in former Yugoslavia. You can read more about its history in a [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-m-95-degman"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_5_9.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In Armored Warfare, the tank is relatively fast and fairly agile while carrying some potent firepower for its Tier. In fact, its owners can choose from two powerful guns:[/p][list][*][p]125mm 2A46 Russian-style smoothbore gun, known from many Russian MBTs[/p][/*][*][p]120mm CTG NATO-style smoothbore gun that you know from the Challenger 1 Falcon MBT[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]It’s worth noting that the 120mm shells have higher penetration values and the gun can also fire Falarick ATGMs while the 125mm gun has higher damage per shot. Both guns will feature good handling as well as overall performance to offset the vehicle’s weakness, which is its mediocre armor. The Degman must rely on its mobility and firepower to survive, making it an ideal vehicle for aggressive, daring players.[/p][p align="start"][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]ZUBR PSP[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The ZUBR was a Czech privately-funded project by PSP Bohemia from the 1990s to develop a successor platform to the aging Soviet-era BMP-series IFVs and various other obsolete specialized vehicles. Even though it was quite advanced for its time, it was ultimately unsuccessful due to the end of the Cold War and the subsequent cuts in European military budgets, including the Czech one. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-zubr-psp"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_36.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In Armored Warfare, the ZUBR PSP is a Tier 7 wheeled Premium Tank Destroyer. What makes it fairly unique is the fact that you can choose from two different weapon systems for this vehicle:[/p][list][*][p]Cockerill CT-CV turret with 105mm gun[/p][/*][*][p]Four-barreled TOW ATGM launcher[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Each of these weapons changes the gameplay style of the vehicle considerably and it is up to you, how you configure this powerful machine.[/p][p align="start"][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]BWP-2000[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The BWP-2000 IFV was a Polish attempt from the mid-1990s to develop a replacement for the license-produced BMP-1 in the Polish military, since it was getting obsolete by that point. Its protracted development led to its cancellation at the onset of War on Terror, leaving Poland without a modern tracked IFV to this day. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-bwp-2000"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_3_28.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In Armored Warfare, the BWP-2000 is a Tier 7 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle armed with 60mm cannon as well as a set of ATGM launchers. When it comes to AFV playstyle, the BWP-2000 is definitely more of an infantry carrier and fire support vehicle than a scout due to its large size and powerful armament as well as the ability to deploy Mechanized Infantry. It can take quite a bit of punishment and deal it in equal measure.[/p][p align="start"][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Rough Riders Battle Coins[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]This week, we are offering you an opportunity to [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-now-available"]boost your Battle Path[/url][/b] progress and get that main prize you know you want – the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xm1302"]XM1302 Tier 10 Premium LT![/url][/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][previewyoutube="5Y1XaHcZOv8;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"]The following Battle Coin bundles are available:[/p][list][*][p]1.000 Battle Coins (5% off)[/p][/*][*][p]5.000 Battle Coins (10% off)[/p][/*][*][p]10.000 Battle Coins (15% off)[/p][/*][*][p]25.000 Battle Coins (20% off)[/p][/*][*][p]50.000 Battle Coins (35% off)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Battle Coins can be used for a number of things, including:[/p][list][*][p]Force-completing Battle Path missions[/p][/*][*][p]Progressing through Battle Path levels[/p][/*][*][p]Purchasing the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-787-gadyuka"]Gadyuka blueprints from the Shop[/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Please note:[/b] In order to use Battle Coins, you need to obtain the access to the Rough Riders Battle Path.[/p][p align="start"][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We hope that you will enjoy this offer and, as usual:[/p][p align="start"][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: KF41, Boxer RIWP
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]KF41 Lynx Prototype Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Boxer RIWP Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between August 26, 2025 and September 2, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]KF41 Lynx Prototype[/h2][p][/p][p]This is a 2018 prototype of the KF41 Lynx, a cutting edge IFV developed by Rheinmetall for export. Featuring advanced modular armor and multiple gun configurations, the vehicle has already been adopted by Hungary with more contracts pending. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kf41-lynx-prototype"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/kf41lynxprototype_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the KF41 Lynx Prototype is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It is a durable and powerful IFV featuring two weapon configurations (30mm and 35mm) as well as a new infantry type that fires large thermobaric warheads from its anti-tank launchers.[/p][p]The KF41 Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Boxer RIWP[/h2][p][/p][p]The Boxer RIWP is a combination of a Tracked Boxer hull and a modular turret called RIWP. Both components are fairly new and haven’t been officially combined as of now but the Boxer platform can theoretically support this weapon system. You can read more about it in [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-boxer-riwp"]our dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/boxerriwp_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Boxer RIWP is a Tier 10 Premium AFV that’s unique for one reason – it offers five fairly distinctive weapon configurations along with a reliable autocannon capable of quickly dealing with lighter targets. It can also deploy Mechanized Infantry.[/p][p]The Boxer RIWP Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Light Tank (10) Damage Contest
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]With the Light Tank-themed Rough Riders Battle Path in full swing, now's the right time to take one of them for a spin once more![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="PC1MfnkO-8E;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In this contest, we’ll be asking you to deal as much damage as possible while driving a Tier 10 Light Tank. You can compete in a single category:[/p][list][*][p]PvE (excluding [b]any[/b] Special Operations)[/p][/*][/list][p]Post the screenshot of your result (both the detailed and regular tab) in the [b][url="https://discord.com/channels/301850249977266178/720242440816296026"]dedicated contest channel[/url][/b] along with your name, category and result number. We also reserve the right to ask for a replay, so make sure you record your battle. The submission template is as such:[/p][list][*][p]Result / Ingame nickname[/p][/*][/list][p]Attention – as we will be using a program to collect your results, please make absolutely sure you submit them with the template above. Submissions without this template will be ignored.[/p][p]As an example, “50000 / Johndoe” is correct, while “50 000/Johndoe” is not due to the incorrectly placed spaces.[/p][p]The contest ends on August 31, 2025 (22:59 CEST) and all entries must be submitted by then.[/p][p][b]The prizes are as follows:[/b][/p][p]The 5 winners of each category will receive:[/p][list][*][p]First Place: 15.000 Battle Coins and 5 Battle Coin boosters[/p][/*][*][p]Second Place: 12.000 Battle Coins and 4 Battle Coin boosters[/p][/*][*][p]Third Place: 10.000 Battle Coins and 3 Battle Coin boosters[/p][/*][*][p]Fourth Place: 8.000 Battle Coins and 2 Battle Coin boosters[/p][/*][*][p]Fifth Place: 7.200 Battle Coins and 1 Battle Coin booster[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Please note:[/b][/p][list][*][p]One player can only submit one result, period[/p][/*][*][p]All submitted results must be from the battles that take place during the event[/p][/*][*][p]Platoons are not allowed[/p][/*][*][p]The winners will be announced and the prizes will be distributed after the end of the event[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Good luck and see you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Scavenger Run is here!
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]
Starting on August 22, you’ll be able to earn a major bonus to your next Gold purchase (even a truly massive one, like 80 percent) by participating in the Scavenger Run event.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d7e592cc4e3db798306c9dcab6cd6de8d23c2ea1.png"][/img]
In other words, in case you win such a bonus and buy 1.000 Gold, you’ll receive 1.800 Gold instead. And that can make one hell of a difference (please note, however, that the maximum amount of bonus Gold obtainable this way is 10.000 Gold).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/9a5d7c130af931c1b6db41df3913bfd05f06c3bc.jpg"][/img]
Scavenger Run is, in its core, a very simple event. There are many ruined and abandoned objects across the world of Armored Warfare and your friendly neighborhood arms dealer ran across one of them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3873a4941509b892bc900a323d705d520f6ecf9b.jpg"][/img]
You are now being hired to scout it out. On a small map, you choose one of three bases and then scout its three warehouses by clicking on them. Depending on your finds (determined randomly), you will receive a sizeable bonus to your next Gold purchase.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/97f48b6d29f92bb005530aa8a28171d0e4b11849.jpg"][/img]
This event will be active for several days (the counter in Garage will always tell you how much time is left), so if you’re planning to stock on Gold for the next Battle Path or simply want to boost your progress right now, it’s the perfect opportunity to do so.

We hope that you’ll enjoy this new mechanic and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]
[/p]

notes.title: Offer: Europe's Edge
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Lynx Skyranger Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Ajax Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Boxer CRV Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Otomatic Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Gepard Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Loot Crate[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Path Boosters[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between August 21, 2025 and August 28, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]Lynx Skyranger[/h2][p][/p][p]This is a version of the cutting edge Lynx platform but instead of the standard IFV configuration, it utilizes the Skyranger HEL turret to create a short-range anti-aircraft vehicle that can also eliminate drone swarms with ease. This configuration was proposed for the recent Hungarian military upgrade program but never built in real life. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-lynx-skyranger"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/lynxskyranger_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Lynx Skyranger is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It’s best used as a scout killer but it is capable of other roles as well. It features three rather unusual abilities, such as the programmable HE ammunition that explodes above targets, the Starstreak missiles that deal more damages over larger distances and ignore APS, and the High Energy Laser active ability. When activated, the laser blinds enemy targets, significantly reducing their spotting range. You can learn more about these abilities from our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/developer-diary-lynx-skyranger-update"]developer diary.[/url][/b][/p][p]The Skyranger Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Ajax[/h2][p][/p][p]The Ajax is the most modern British Infantry Fighting Vehicle currently in service. Despite being plagued by developmental problems, the program to replace the aging Warrior IFV produced one of the best vehicles in its class. You can read more about it in [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-ajax"]our dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/ajax_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Ajax is a Tier 10 Premium AFV featuring solid protection levels and excellent sustained firepower. Furthermore, it can deploy Mechanized Infantry like other AFVs of its class and has a special ability that allows it to better detect enemies at closer ranges.[/p][p]The Ajax Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Boxer CRV[/h2][p][/p][p]The Boxer CRV is the Infantry Fighting Vehicle variant of the Boxer platform, featuring a cutting edge turret with 30mm autocannon and guided missiles. It is a truly next-gen IFV with orders coming from all over the world, most notably from Australia and Germany. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-boxer-crv"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/boxer_crv_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Boxer CRV is a Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It is one of the best IFVs in its class, offering a combination of solid mobility and great firepower, including Mechanized Infantry deployment and the dreaded double-launch ATGM feature.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Otomatic[/h2][p][/p][p]The Otomatic was an attempt from the 1980s and 1990s to mate originally naval 76mm rapid-firing cannon with a tracked chassis (either of Palmaria or a Leopard) to create an advanced anti-aircraft gun. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-otomatic"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/otomatic_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Otomatic a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. Thanks to its fast-firing 76mm gun it can deal tremendous amounts of damage over short periods of time and can deal effectively with any target it encounters on the battlefield.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Gepard[/h2][p][/p][p]The Gepard is one of the best short-range anti-aircraft self-propelled guns in the world. Made primarily for Germany and the Netherlands, it remains in active use to this day and has recently seen some combat in Ukraine. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-flakpanzer-gepard"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/gepard_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Gepard a Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. Unlike the Otomatic, it relies not on a single larger gun, but on the hailstorm of shells provided by its two 35mm autocannons. Even the toughest of targets crumble under its withering fire.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Commander Loot Crate[/h2][p][/p][p]This week, we’ve prepared another special offer for you in the form of a brand new [b]Commander Loot Crate[/b], featuring, amongst other things, some of the rarest commanders in the game![/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_228.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This Loot Crate gives you the opportunity to obtain the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Commander Ofelia Kitescu[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Austin Harper[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Alexander Cortez[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Alisa Korhonen[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Erin O’Connell[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Jorge Alvarez[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Joshua Seagrove[/p][/*][*][p]Commander Fyodor Sokolov[/p][/*][*][p]Platinum Commander XP Insignia tokens[/p][/*][*][p]Gold Commander XP Insignia tokens[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Rough Riders Boosters[/h2][p][/p][p]This week, we are offering you notes.title: Offer: Type 99A2-140, Type 10
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Type 99A2-140 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Type 10 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between August 19 and August 26, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]Type 99A2-140[/h2][p][/p][p]The Type 99A2-140 is an experimental version of the most advanced Chinese Main Battle Tank in existence – the Type 99A. Unlike its production counterpart, however, it is not armed with a 125mm smoothbore, but massive 140mm smoothbore cannon. This is a theoretical upgrade to the vehicle – while the People’s Republic of China was considering upgrading the firepower of its Main Battle Tanks to face latest western and Russian MBT models, a 140mm gun was never installed on this chassis and was only mentioned in passing by certain Chinese sources. Now, however, your enemies will have the opportunity to experience what such a vehicle with you in command would be like to face in battle![/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_77.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Type 99A2-140 is a rather unique Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. It is essentially a version of the progression Type 99A2 Tier 10 MBT with one difference – the 140mm gun, trading its rate of fire for penetration and single shell damage. It is very fast and mobile (with its maximum speed being well over 90 km/h), protected by ERA and APS both and capable of using an acceleration-boosting active ability that pushes its engine far beyond the limits of common Main Battle Tanks. If used right, the vehicle is extremely deadly and one of the best Tier 10 MBTs on the battlefields of Armored Warfare.[/p][p]The Type 99A2-140 MBT is available [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"]in our Web Shop via Loot Crates.[/url][/b] Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Type 10[/h2][p][/p][p]The Type 10 MBT is the most modern Japanese Main Battle Tank in service and one of the most advanced war machines in the world. Using sophisticated electronics and crystalline steel armor, this tank is more than a match for any enemy that would threaten the islands of Japan. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-type-10-hitomaru"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_55.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Type 10 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. What puts it apart from the other MBTs of its Tier is its special NERA armor. This highly-mobile MBT starts every battle well-armored, but the protection levels decrease with every shot taken. Additionally, this MBT features a special system that tells you the exact chance to penetrate your target. Overall, it’s one of the most powerful MBTs of its Tier and certainly a good choice for players, who prefer rapid action to slow advances.[/p][p]The Type 10 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Gift: Polish Armed Forces Day
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]On August 15, 2025, the entire Poland celebrates the [b]Armed Forces Day[/b], commemorating the 105th anniversary of the 1920 Battle of Warsaw, where the Polish military defeated the Red Army invading forces. During the Polish-Soviet War, the communists ultimately wanted to capture the entirety of Poland but were instead soundly defeated by the forces of Marshal Józef Piłsudski in what is commonly referred to as the Miracle of the Vistula. The celebration of this great victory and the Polish Armed Forces was renewed in 1992 and is accompanied by military parades since 2007.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/t72_polish_no-text-1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]To celebrate the event, we've prepared a gift for you.[/b][/p][p]This gift contains the Polish Army Emblem decal, 1 Platinum Loot Crate and 3 days of Premium Time.[/p][p][b]Click on the link below to claim it![/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=gift"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Asian Week
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p align="start"]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]ZTZ-20 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Type 99B Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]QN-506 Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]VT-5 Tier 9 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Rough Riders Loot Crate[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Between August 14 and August 21, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]ZTZ-20[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The ZTZ-20 is a fictional Chinese Main Battle Tank for the 21st century. It combines western influences with some ideas taken from the T-14 Armata. You can read about its (real and fictional) history in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-ztz-20"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_no_text_1.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In Armored Warfare, the ZTZ-20 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. On its own, it’s a beast of a machine and one of the most powerful vehicles in the game, featuring both a powerful gun and thick armor. It does have a special feature though – its missiles can cover a wide area with burning White Phosphorus that reduces enemy vehicle camouflage and deals damage to anyone entering the zone.[/p][p align="start"]The ZTZ-20 MBT is available [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"]in our Web Shop via Loot Crates.[/url][/b] Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Type 99B[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The Type 99B is a fictional improved version of the currently most modern Chinese Main Battle Tank. It was designed as a concept by the Chinese tank community some years ago and we used the concept as a basis for its introduction. However, our version bears significant differences, most notably the Red Arrow missile launcher on the roof. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-type-99b"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/type99b_1920x1080.jpeg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In Armored Warfare, the Type 99B is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. It is fast, agile, and capable of dealing tremendous damage over a short period of time thanks to its turret-mounted thermobaric missile launcher.[/p][p align="start"]The Type 99B MBT is available [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"]in our Web Shop via Loot Crates.[/url][/b] Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]VT-5[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The VT-5 is a modern Chinese Light Tank that was developed specifically with export in mind. There are many reasons why a country without its own tank development should opt to purchase a Light Tank instead of a full-scale Main Battle Tank. It’s equally as fast if not faster with equal firepower but, what is most important, it is affordable. The VT-5 excels in all these categories. While its armor cannot match that of an MBT, it can protect its crew against most infantry threats thanks to its ERA and cage armor sets. It also has a powerful 105mm gun capable of firing guided missiles, it is packed with advanced electronics and is supremely agile thanks to its 1000hp diesel engine. Simply put, wraps cutting edge technologies up into an affordable bundle. You can learn more about it in [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-vt-5"]a dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_3_26.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In Armored Warfare, the VT-5 is a very powerful Tier 9 Premium Light Tank. Fast and agile, it features solid levels of protection (the configuration in the game is the one featuring the ERA kit as well as the turret cage armor) and a good rate of fire. Additionally, its gun is capable of firing guided missiles. It’s an ideal machine for players who value speed and agility, as it offers plenty of both. The VT-5 is capable of dancing around its opponents on the battlefield, outperforming even some AFVs in mobility.[/p][p align="start"][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]QN-506[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The QN-506 fire support vehicle is a Chinese attempt to design a cheap, export-oriented alternative to the Russian BMPT series. Instead of converting a second or third generation MBT, the engineers at Wuhan Guide Infrared Co., Ltd., likely to keep the vehicle as affordable as possible, opted to base their project on the Type 59 MBT, which is, in its basic form anyway, a copy of the old Soviet T-55 medium tank from the late 1950s. They jam-packed it with cutting edge electronics and a number of weapon systems, including ATGMs, an automatic cannon or smaller caliber rockets. However, despite the use of an unmanned turret, the protection levels of this vehicle are still quite low and, so far, there haven’t been any signs of interest in the QN-506. You can learn more about this vehicle in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-qn-506"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="omzaADMKUck;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]In Armored Warfare, the QN-506 is a Premium Tier 9 Tank Destroyer that gameplay-wise resembles the popular BMPT series. However, unlike the Russian Terminators, it has a number of interesting features including three different weapon systems (30mm cannon, 70mm unguided rockets and 151mm ATGMs) and loitering recon ammunition flying towards the end of a map and spotting everything in its path. The last ability is unique to the QN-506 and makes it one of the most potent support vehicles on the battlefield.[/p][p align="start"][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Rough Riders Loot Crate[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-now-available"]Rough Riders[/url][/b] Loot Crate is now available. This Loot Crate contains Rough Riders Battle Coins and Boosters.[/p][p align="start"][/p][previewyoutube="5Y1XaHcZOv8;full"][/previewyoutube][list][*][p][b]Battle Coins[/b] are the primary currency of the Rough Riders Battle Path campaign and are used to progress through it and to obtain its prizes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle Coin Boosters[/b] are usable only during an active Battle Path and increase your Battle Coin income by 900 percent for two hours.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Please note that you have to obtain the access to a Battle Path to use both items.[/p][p align="start"][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p align="start"][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.355 Now Available
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p align="start"]We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.355[/b] is now available![/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6a48b502a0c31b8a1b57effb074da7606f5ee542.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]List of Update 0.355 Changes[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Economy Changes[/b][/p][p align="start"]As a part of a revitalization of the entire economy of Armored Warfare in order to ensure the game’s longevity, we are making several changes to the game’s economy in regards to Credit income. The changes concern the First Victory of the Day bonus and are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Special Operations (Hardcore difficulty): from 300% bonus for Credits and XP (x4) once per 3 days to 200% bonus for Credits (x3) and 300% for XP (x4) once per 3 days[/p][/*][*][p]Special Operations (Extreme difficulty): from 300% bonus for Credits and XP (x4) once per 3 days to 200% bonus for Credits (x3) and 300% for XP (x4) once per 3 days[/p][/*][*][p]Special Operations (Heroic difficulty): from 900% bonus for Credits and XP (x10) once per 7 days to 200% bonus for Credits (x3) and 900% for XP (x10) once per 7 days[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We’ll continue keeping an eye on the Credit situation to make sure the changes have the desired effect.[/p][p align="start"][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/p][p align="start"]In this update, we are fixing the following issues of the Rough Riders Battle Path and its vehicles:[/p][list][*][p]Forest Green paint is no longer issued three times at Level 43 of the Battle Path[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Ares: Guns now show the correct characteristics in the Garage[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p align="start"]With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:[/p][list][*][p]BMT-72-140: Improved main gun’s depression angles[/p][/*][*][p]Bradley FV: ATGMs no longer ignore launcher elevation and depression[/p][/*][*][p]Leclerc T4: Changed the vehicle’s short name in order for it to be consistent with other Leclerc tanks[/p][/*][*][p]Object 292: Replaced the Kaktus Generation 3 ERA with the intended Malakhit Generation 4 ERA[/p][/*][*][p]T-90A Burlak: Fixed several smaller visual issues with the Gromozeka skin[/p][/*][*][p]T-90A Burlak: Gromozeka skin no longer changes vehicle’s armor[/p][/*][*][p]TOS-1M Buratino: Fixed a bug where the aiming reticle was “jumping” when targeting TOS-1M in battle[/p][/*][*][p]VN20: Deployable turret now also targets enemy infantry (but fires at vehicles with higher priority)[/p][/*][*][p]VN20: Players can now correctly designate targets for the deployable turret (by pressing V, the same way as it works for Mechanized Infantry)[/p][/*][*][p]VN20: Deployable turret fire no longer damages your teammates with splash (shell explosion shockwave) damage[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]General Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Clarified the mission description for the Beasts of Steel event[/p][/*][*][p]Weekend Special Operation Loot Crates now have a correct description (they drop Rough Riders Battle Coins)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Starter Pack reward icons in the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several Battalion Contract mission timers (for M1A2C, BMPT-72 and Challenger 2 Hades vehicles)[/p][/*][*][p]Investigated a number of issues causing the game to crash upon pressing the Reconnect button (an ongoing process)[/p][/*][*][p]Several smaller localization fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a number of future event assets[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: In Development: Special Operation “Tiger Shark”
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]It’s been some time since the last mission updated but we are happy that we can tell you more about the third part of the Black Company Special Operation series called [b]Tiger Shark.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/23459e597484801c8ff70b7aaff5ce3de16b775c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This mission continues the story of Joshua Seagrove and Kathryn Grey and their rise to fame as Black Company mercenaries. Upon the conclusion of the Lone Star mission, Port Houston is liberated from its occupation by Clayburn Industries.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7f972331db3593f3c2d55f9bd366f58ee0359932.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the aftermath of the events, Seagrove and Grey receive an offer from Suez Incorporated to save a ship hijacked by pirates and bringing it back in exchange for clearing their names of war crime accusations. Not willing to waste such an opportunity, they immediately set sail to a small island in the Indian Ocean.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/1381f083a92570c70d53748f02cb55cd061a0eca.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As the description above suggests, the mission will take place on a tropical island controlled by ruthless pirates. These criminals are led by Louis Pareil, a ruthless French ex-special forces operator-turned-warlord so you’ll be in for quite a fight. He has quite a few aces up his sleeve.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3cdfda07de3dd1fb5df934c65d44c8b528385d6d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We carefully listened to your feedback and made two major changes to the design. First, the mission is shorter than the previous two so you’ll no longer spend an hour fighting every time you launch it. Second, starting with its introduction, it’ll be newly possible to select which mission you want to play of the three in the menu.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/96dea945b35cd0415d96ac040233445d62201000.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As always there will be mission-specific achievements with new rewards, including a pirate player avatar and a brand-new camouflage for three environments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/91b36df0e87340995520024b612843ac2c1e7164.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/0e53c01255c7496c6767a41c45ec15de49f51625.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/2ae8923245ada90894f4995635bce518ad689272.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/18e1484c4f0c2505ca7a90fb3684da1b9f8af763.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/bbe9d66fb8830625116b50636b71300adadb8a52.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy this Special Operation that is coming to the game in early September and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p][p][/p]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d2b40b932bec0945b91136a4a8d534037f586912.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Offer: Namer, AFT-10
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Namer Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]AFT-10 Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between August 12 and August 19, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]Namer[/h2][p][/p][p]The Namer IFV is an Israeli heavy fighting vehicle version of the Namer platform developed in the early 2000s from the Merkava Main Battle Tank. Israel is a small country and cannot affect high infantry losses, which is why the Namer features extremely high levels of protection. The IFV variant is fitted with a Rafael turret, featuring 30mm autocannon and a Spike missile launcher. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-namer"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_79.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Namer is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer. As its history suggests, it is a superheavy TD with its protection levels being amongst the highest of its class. It is slow and ponderous but its thick front can deflect even advanced shells while maintaining adequate firepower thanks to its autocannon and ATGM combination. Its MBT-like characteristics make this vehicle quite forgiving for new players, but, as they say, a jack-of-all-trades is a master of none.[/p][p]The Namer Tier 10 Premium TD is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]AFT-10[/h2][p][/p][p]The AFT-10 is a tracked ATGM carrier based on a ZBD-04 IFV hull that carries eight massive Red Arrow-10 guided missiles. In their latest version, these modern ATGMs are capable of devastating even the most modern MBTs at extreme distances and the AFT-10 was designed to do just that – to stop enemy assaults dead in their tracks. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-aft-10"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_71.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the AFT-10 is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer. Its massive ATGM launcher immediately draws comparison with another Tier 10 vehicle, the Kornet-EM. But where Kornet-EM is all about speed, stealth and missile ambushes, the AFT-10 is about one thing and one thing only – uncompromising firepower. It is capable of unleashing devastating missile salvos that can knock out even Tier 10 MBTs in seconds. Additionally, its missiles have a very high penetration value, which means that no matter the angle, no target is truly safe from its reach.[/p][p]The AFT-10 Tier 10 Premium TD is available [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"]in our Web Shop via Loot Crates.[/url][/b] Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Treasure Trove
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today, we have a special offer for you. notes.title: Light Tank (7) Damage Contest
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]With the Light Tank-themed Rough Riders Battle Path in full swing, now's the right time to take one of them for a spin![/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/0.19main_img_5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In this contest, we’ll be asking you to deal as much damage as possible while driving a Tier 7 Light Tank. You can compete in two categories, separated by mode:[/p][list][*][p]PvP (Random Battles)[/p][/*][*][p]PvE (excluding Heroic Special Operations)[/p][/*][/list][p]Post the screenshot of your result (both the detailed and regular tab) in the [b][url="https://discord.com/channels/301850249977266178/720242440816296026"]dedicated contest channel[/url][/b] along with your name, category and result number. We also reserve the right to ask for a replay, so make sure you record your battle. The submission template is as such:[/p][list][*][p]Category / Result / Ingame nickname[/p][/*][/list][p]Attention – as we will be using a program to collect your results, please make absolutely sure you submit them with the template above. Submissions without this template will be ignored.[/p][p]As an example, “PvP / 50000 / Johndoe” is correct, while “PvP/50 000/Johndoe” is not due to the incorrectly placed spaces.[/p][p]The contest ends on August 14, 2025 (22:59 CEST) and all entries must be submitted by then.[/p][p][b]The prizes are as follows:[/b][/p][p]The 5 winners of each category will receive:[/p][list][*][p]First Place: 15.000 Battle Coins and 5 Battle Coin boosters[/p][/*][*][p]Second Place: 12.000 Battle Coins and 4 Battle Coin boosters[/p][/*][*][p]Third Place: 10.000 Battle Coins and 3 Battle Coin boosters[/p][/*][*][p]Fourth Place: 8.000 Battle Coins and 2 Battle Coin boosters[/p][/*][*][p]Fifth Place: 7.200 Battle Coins and 1 Battle Coin booster[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Please note:[/b][/p][list][*][p]One player can only submit one result, period[/p][/*][*][p]All submitted results must be from the battles that take place during the event[/p][/*][*][p]Platoons are not allowed[/p][/*][*][p]The winners will be announced and the prizes will be distributed after the end of the event[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Good luck and see you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: XM2001 Crusader, CATTB
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]XM2001 Crusader Tier 10 Premium Self-Propelled Gun[/p][/*][*][p]CATTB Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Bradley AAWS-H Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Stryker ADATS Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]M1A1 Storm Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank (with Desert Storm bundle)[/p][/*][*][p]Sabre Tier 6 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Challenger 1 Falcon Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Iron Crate[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between August 7, 2025 and August 14, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]XM2001 Crusader[/h2][p][/p][p]The XM2001 Crusader is an American attempt to replace the M109A6 Paladin in the 1990s with something more modern. The project was cancelled in 2002 due to its heavy weight. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xm2001-crusader"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="xAjZAYDISN0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the XM2001 Crusader is a Tier 10 Premium Self-Propelled Gun. The Crusader is an ideal vehicle for players who like to play aggressively. Dominate the battlefield with unrivalled firepower of a three-round 155mm magazine paired with guided HE rounds, and retreat under the cover of smoke thanks to your speed and agility. The Crusader is the ultimate SPG you've been dreaming of![/p][p]The Crusader is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]CATTB[/h2][p][/p][p]The CATTB Main Battle Tank was an experimental platform, developed as one of the early steps in the creation of a next generation Abrams Main Battle Tank, also referred to as the Block III Abrams, or M1A3. It was created in the 1980s as a response to the perceived threat of future Soviet super tanks and featured some truly advanced components, such as the XM291 dual caliber cannon that could switch between 120mm and 140mm calibers. With the collapse of the Soviet Union, the development of this tank became unnecessary and the program was canceled in the 1990s. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-cattb"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_27.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the CATTB is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank and one of the most powerful and versatile MBTs around, devastating its opponents with its signature double-tap feature, allowing it to fire its cannon twice in short order. This allows it to drive around a corner, deal very high amounts of damage and then retreat back into cover, leaving the enemy reeling from the massive blow.[/p][p]This vehicle is available via Loot Crates, which drop CATTB parts. Collect 100 CATTB parts from these Loot Crates to assemble the whole vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Bradley AAWS-H[/h2][p][/p][p]The Bradley AAWS-H Tank Destroyer was an attempt by Loral Vought to mount four kinetic guided missiles on an extendable arm while using the Bradley IFV chassis as a platform. Kinetic missiles were cutting edge tech back in the 1980s – unlike standard ATGMs, they destroyed the target by their kinetic energy instead of a HEAT warhead, accelerating to several times the speed of sound. There was little to no defense against them, although they did have some drawbacks, which was why they were never adopted in real life. You can read more about the vehicle in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-bradley-aaws-h"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_39.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Bradley AAWS-H is a Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer. It’s an ATGM-based TD, carrying special kinetic missiles that actually become more effective with increasing distance to your target. It is the embodiment of a long-range missile carrier and is perfect for players who prefer sniping to close combat.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Stryker ADATS[/h2][p][/p][p]ADATS stands for “Air Defense Anti-Tank System,” describing its purpose very well. The system is intended to engage both air and ground armored targets. It was developed in the 1980s by a Swiss company called Oerlikon-Contraves and was offered as an interesting hybrid that would be able to deal with both Soviet tanks and helicopters or attack planes. Unfortunately for it, it came too late – only Canada would actually accept it in service and the end of the Cold War meant the end to all attempts at its large-scale introduction. The ADATS missiles were quite large but, more importantly, extremely fast and were certain to be extremely destructive to any Soviet armored targets, even though this thankfully never had to be tested in real combat. The ADATS turret was offered for a wide variety of platforms and was actively installed on a vehicle that is kind of like a cousin to the Stryker, the Canadian LAV-III. In this configuration, the vehicle was called MMEV.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_31.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, Stryker ADATS is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. It is a wheeled vehicle armed with two weapon systems – powerful long-range guided missiles and short-range unguided rockets, offering it some survivability in short range combat as well as the ability to deal tremendous damage if left to its devices.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]M1A1 Storm with Desert Storm bundle[/h2][p][/p][p]In 1985, the Abrams was upgraded with, amongst other things, the 120mm M256 smoothbore cannon. Over 5000 M1A1 tanks were produced until 1992. This tank participated in Operation Desert Storm, which forged its legendary reputation.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the M1A1 Storm is a Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank. The M1A1 Storm look was inspired by Operation Desert Storm, including a gorgeous camouflage net model. But, more importantly, this tank is equipped with a massive frontal dozer blade, adding extra armor and ramming damage to the long list of its advantages.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Sabre[/h2][p][/p][p]The Sabre is an interesting British recon vehicle, assembled together from older Scorpion hulls and Fox turrets after both parts were brought to zero hour state (completely overhauled) by a company called Alvis. The resulting vehicle from the early 1990s was called Sabre and, considering it was made of decades old components, it worked fairly well as a scouting vehicle, participating in the Iraq War as well as in several peacekeeping missions. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-sabre"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_4_42.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Tier 6 Sabre Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle is one of the deadliest vehicles on the battlefield thanks to its rather unique upward-aimed Swingfire missile launcher that allows it to fire over obstacles or while hidden, for example behind uneven terrain. While being quite difficult to master, this ability makes it a potent ambusher, especially in skilled hands.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Challenger 1 Falcon[/h2][p][/p][p]The Falcon is an experimental turret developed in the early 2000s in Jordan as an upgrade to the Jordanian Al-Hussein (Challenger 1) Main Battle Tanks. It's a low profile turret, armed with an automatically loaded Swiss 120mm L/50 RUAG smoothbore gun, capable of firing standard NATO ammunition. The operator controls the turret from inside the vehicle's hull, significantly improving crew protection. A prototype was built and tested, but the design was never mass-produced.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_10_0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Challenger 1 Falcon is a Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank. The best word to characterize this lumbering behemoth in the game is “tough” – its excellent hull armor shrugs off most shells while the damage its low profile turret takes when it is reduced by 90% thanks to the fact the crew is not located directly in it. Despite being generally very slow and sluggish, the Challenger 1 Falcon can take tremendous punishment and is ideal for the players who prefer the British Main Battle Tank play style.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Iron Crate[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve prepared for you an additional offer this week. The [b]Iron Crate[/b] is available in our Web Shop![/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_179_0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This crate allows you to win a Tier 4 to Tier 10 Premium vehicle (or its value in Gold if you have it already). The crate contains some very rare vehicles, including:[/p][list][*][p]ZTL-11 Tier 9 Premium TD[/p][/*][*][p]VN17 Tier 8 Premium AFV[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: TOS-1M, Kornet-D1
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]TOS-1M Buratino Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Koshmar skin for TOS-1M[/p][/*][*][p]Kornet-D1 Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between August 5 and 12, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]TOS-1M Buratino[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The TOS-1M Buratino is a prototype version of the Russian TOS-1/TOS-1A heavy rocket launcher. It was designed in 1997 at Omsk as an improvement to the old TOS-1 whose roots go back all the way to the Afghan War. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-tos-1m-buratino"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/tos-1m_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the TOS-1M Buratino is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer. As befits its massive rocket launcher installed on the top of a T-90A MBT chassis, its firepower is all but unparalleled and you are looking at perhaps the most destructive vehicle of Armored Warfare. It is available in two configurations – with fast-launching 122mm rockets and the iconic 220mm rockets that can be unlocked either by installing a skin (Koshmar), or by progressing through an active Battle Path.[/p][p]The TOS-1M is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Koshmar Bundle[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Additionally, we've prepared a skin bundle with a new skin. The skin “Koshmar” we have prepared for you is for the TOS-1M Tier 10 Premium TD. Not only is it cool looking, it also [b]unlocks the overprogression modules for you, including the 220mm turret and the 220mm thermobaric rockets.[/b] You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-tos-1m-koshmar"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/tos-1m_koshmar_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The skin is available as a part of the Koshmar Bundle, which contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Skin: TOS-1M Koshmar[/p][/*][*][p]3 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Kornet-D1[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The Kornet-D1 Tank Destroyer was one of the proposed variants for the BMD-4M chassis. As a dedicated tank hunter, it was supposed to be armed with two Kornet ATGM quad launchers, providing the Russian Airborne forces with long-range tank-killing capabilities. The project was launched in 2013 but the vehicle never reached the prototype stage with the program likely being canceled in 2018. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kornet-d1"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_58.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Kornet-D1 is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer and a tracked counterpart to the wheeled Kornet-EM progression vehicle. It is only lightly armed but also very stealthy and its lack of vision range is compensated by the ability to deploy a Sniper. Additionally, when configured properly, the vehicle is capable of launching two missiles at once, making it incredibly deadly against any target, especially at long ranges.[/p][p]This vehicle is available via Loot Crates, which drop Kornet-D1 parts. Collect 100 Kornet-D1 parts from these Loot Crates to assemble the whole vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Now Available: Beasts of Steel
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]We’ve prepared another event for you to participate in this autumn. Get ready for the [b]Beasts of Steel[/b] event![/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/banner_1920x1080_5.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]You’ll be earning amazing prizes, including:[/p][list][*][p][b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-t-90a-burlak"]T-90A Burlak Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-t-90a-burlak-gromozeka"]Gromozeka skin for Burlak[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-modern-russian"]Amazing camouflages and decals[/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, the event contains Rough Riders Battle Coins, Battle Coin boosters and two older skins.[/p][p]Its rules are, once again, very simple. You can participate by [b]destroying 5 enemy vehicles in PvE (or 1 in PvP) in three separate matches per day[/b] while driving a Tier 3 vehicle or higher in order to receive a reward.[/p][p][b]Please note:[/b][/p][list][*][p]This event may run concurrently with other events and is available to all players[/p][/*][*][p]You may only complete one objective per day[/p][/*][*][p]The event starts on August 1, 2025 and ends on September 18, 2025[/p][/*][/list][p][b]We hope that you will enjoy this event and will see you on the battlefield![/b][/p]
