notes.title: Offer: Eastern Vehicles
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Rough Riders Gift[/p][/*][*][p]T-90M Proryv Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Typhoon-VDV Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]BMP-2M Berezhok Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]BTR-82A Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Kurganets-25 Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Msta-S Tier 9 Premium Self-Propelled Gun[/p][/*][*][p]Khrizantema-S Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]T-72B3 Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between July 31 and August 7, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]Rough Riders Gift[/h2][p][/p][p]This week we have prepared a special gift for you.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/banner_1920x1080_5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This gift contains 3 Platinum boosters and 2 Battle Coin boosters.[/p][p][b]Click on the link below to claim it![/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=gift"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]T-90M Proryv[/h2][p][/p][p]The T-90M Proryv the most advanced Russian Main Battle Tank currently in service and the ultimate step in a long journey that began with the T-72. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-t-90m-proryv"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/styles/news_body_image_1/public/u183517/1920x1080_426.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the T-90M Proryv is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. With its solid firepower, excellent armor and decent mobility, this vehicle is suitable for all players, including fairly new ones. No matter what tactic you choose, the T-90M will not let you down as it is one of the most versatile MBTs in the entire game.[/p][p]The T-90M is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Typhoon-VDV[/h2][p][/p][p]The Typhoon-VDV is a modern Russian reconnaissance and special use vehicle. It is perhaps the best-armed version of the Typhoon platform, featuring a Spitsa turret. Several vehicles of this type have been built and are currently in use by the Russian military. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-typhoon-vdv"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/styles/news_body_image_1/public/u183517/1920x1080_423.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Typhoon-VDV is a Tier 10 Premium AFV. It is a powerful vehicle on its own, featuring high firepower in the form of 30mm autocannon and an ATGM launcher with two tubes loaded with thermobaric missiles that can be launched both at once. Its task on the battlefield is supporting other scout vehicles by increasing their spotting capabilities thanks to a new active ability.[/p][p]The Typhoon-VDV Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]BMP-2M Berezhok[/h2][p][/p][p]The BMP-2M Berezhok is one of the latest modifications of the now obsolete Soviet BMP-2. It received a new turret and a limited numbers of these infantry fighting vehicles are already in service. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-bmp-2m-berezhok"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/armored-warfare-bmp-2m-1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the BMP-2M is a Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. While not exactly well-armored, it is fitted with multiple weapon systems, including a powerful 30mm autocannon and deadly Kornet missiles. It is truly one of the most hard-punching AFVs in the game and is suitable for aggressive, skilled players.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]BTR-82A[/h2][p][/p][p]The BTR-82A is the standard wheeled armored fighting vehicle of the Russian army. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-btr-82a"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/armored-warfare-btr-82a-1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the BTR-82A is a Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. Despite its light armor, the BTR-82A can – especially in its upgraded form with missile launchers – hit the enemy where it hurts. Fast, maneuverable and rugged, in skilled hands the BTR-82A turns into one of the deadliest machines of its Tier.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Kurganets-25[/h2][p][/p][p]The Kurganets-25 Infantry Fighting Vehicle is intended as a cutting edge future replacement to the old BMP series in Russian service. While not as chunky and expensive as the T-15 Armata super-heavy IFV, it’s designed to finally offer the 21st century protection levels the Russian military has been demanding for a long time. However, the design turned out to be quite expensive and while it is currently undergoing state trials, it is unlikely to be ever mass-produced. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kurganets-25"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/kurganets-25_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Kurganets-25 is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. Even though it offers decent protection and mobility for its class, this vehicle is all about firepower. To make sure you always have the right tool for the job, it comes with three distinctive weapon systems – a 57mm autocannon for light targets, fast and small Bulat missiles for highly mobile targets and, finally, full-sized ATGMs that can defeat pretty much anything on the battlefield. If dealing damage is your thing, few vehicles will match your playstyle better.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Msta-S[/h2][p][/p][p]The Msta-S SPG was developed as a replacement to the older 2S3 Akatsiya. The goal was to match (or surpass) the newly developed NATO artillery pieces with long 155mm guns. The production began in 1988 and is currently ongoing with a modernized variant rolling out for the Russian military. More than 500 Msta-S SPGs are still in Russian service and dozens were exported to several other countries. It has seen some combat during the Second Chechen War and the War in Donbass. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-msta-s"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/msta-s_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Msta-S is a Tier 9 Self-Propelled Gun, which makes it only usable in the Global Operations mode and in PvE. It comes with two shell types – a slow-flying one with a high flight arc, and a fast-flying one for use against more mobile targets.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Khrizantema-S[/h2][p][/p][p]The Khrizantema-S is a dedicated tank hunter, built on a modified BMP-3 hull. The first Khrizantema-S prototype appeared in public as early as 1996 with the initial production variant (9P157) entering service in 2005. Around 2010, an upgraded variant called 9P157-2 appeared with a modernized Ukrainian optics system and a hull machinegun the original model lacked. This variant was in use until 2017. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-khrizantema-s"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/khrizantema-s_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Khizantema-S is a Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer. It is quite a stealthy vehicle armed with a twin ATGM launcher. The key to achieving excellent results with this machine is long-range ATGM sniping followed by rapid relocation. The missiles are quite powerful and make hits easy thanks to their excellent performance.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]T-72B3[/h2][p][/p][p]The T-72B3 is the most modern Russian T-72 variant currently in service. It is a heavily upgraded version of the T-72B, featuring Kontakt-5 ERA kit and an improved Fire Control System. Together, these modifications allow the aging T-72 to serve well into the 21st century. You can learn more about its history [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-t-72b3"]in our dedicated article![/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/styles/news_body_image_1/public/u183517/t-72b3_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the T-72B3 is a Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank. It continues the tradition of other Russian tanks. Its low silhouette, good mobility, powerful 125mm gun and its advanced ERA kit make it a formidable opponent. This version of the T-72B3 is offered without any camouflage.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy this offer and, as usual:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.350 Now Available
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.350[/b] is now available![/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/aw_bp14_diaryissue_35_1920x1080_0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]List of Update 0.350 Changes[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/p][p]In this update, we are fixing the following issues of the Rough Riders Battle Path and its vehicles:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the Battle Path screen background on some resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Path shop no longer contains a duplicate Leopard Cockerill with an incorrect price tag[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect timer on one of the Challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bugged Sentinel skin in the Battle Path shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrectly placed Purchase button for Battle Coins[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Anthony Diaz icon in the Battle Path Ranks window[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Battle Path logo appearance[/p][/*][*][p]ELKE: Applied several visual model fixes[/p][/*][*][p]ELKE: Partially fixed the tracks clipping into the ground[/p][/*][*][p]ELKE: Removed the incorrectly placed gun breech module[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Ares: Partially fixed the tracks clipping into the ground[/p][/*][*][p]XM1302: Fixed the aim reticle alignment[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p]With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where selecting different weapons on a single vehicle did not change its characteristics in the Garage window[/p][/*][*][p]BMT-72-140: Fixed the incorrect gun depression and elevation values in the Garage window[/p][/*][*][p]Borsuk: Applying camouflage no longer makes the vehicle look dirty from mud[/p][/*][*][p]CATTB: Fixed the missing ERA element on the right side in the Armor Inspector window[/p][/*][*][p]Leopard 2A6 Hades: Fixed the antenna flying in the air[/p][/*][*][p]M60A3: Fixed an issue where the gun could fire through targets at close distances[/p][/*][*][p]M8 MGM-166: Fixed the entire collision model that was larger than the vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Otomatic: Fixed the turret collision model[/p][/*][*][p]TOS-1M: Fixed the turret collision model[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a number of future event assets[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Historical Camouflages – Modern Russian
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]In recent news, we unveiled the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-t-90a-burlak-gromozeka"]Gromozeka skin[/url][/b] that’s coming as a part of the Beasts of Steel event. The event’s complementing the Rough Riders Battle Path and is generally Russian-themed, because what would American armed forces be without proper adversaries?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/e5006a5bb8cdaf6ca629f49477be39c96ecbb9de.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Aside from Rough Riders Battle Coins and Battle Coin boosters, the prizes will include new camouflages and animal-themed decals and that’s what we’d like to tell you more about today. Most of these camouflages have been seen fairly recently in real life, although some are quite a bit older. Let’s take a look at them in the order they appear in the event.[/p][p]Let’s start with the [b]Russian (Marines)[/b] camouflage. This atypical camouflage was seen fairly recently on a BMP-2 belonging to the 299th Marines Training Center “Saturn” of the Baltic Fleet in Kaliningrad.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ee959aa593e65873a247150b19749e384482f758.png"][/img][/p][p]Next up are three recently seen digital camouflages – [b]Woodland, Desert and Urban[/b]. These were seen during the Army 2020 and Army 2021 expos in Moscow on different vehicles, including the Tigr armored car. These camouflages are used only during expos instead of combat as Russia (unlike Ukraine) isn’t using digital camouflages en masse.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c156475d20cb6b9c0467418e8a8e7ec92ce81fc2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/56e0daa62b92e94a11bfd25370eddb593649cddc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/74e0ef15a51696284e896b4f05d210952e344bfa.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Another camouflage we’ll have for you is called [b]Russian (39th Motor Rifle Brigade)[/b] and, as its name suggests, it was seen on a T-55AM belonging to the eponymous unit in 2015. This Far East unit from Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk has a long history reaching back to the early days of the Second World War, having fought the Japanese in Manchuria.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/0994d76da2c57f051c7e92e0be42b5439893f7bc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Finally, there’s the [b]Russian (Spots)[/b] camouflage seen on a T-72A in 2024, an interesting twist on the traditional Russian black-sand-green colors.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b6d3a8e138fb20ceac4f450ac4805b2f1425fd3f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ll also have several animal-themed decals for you, including:[/p][list][*][p]Dolphin – emblem of the Soviet 336th Marines Brigade, as seen on a PT-76 in Baltiysk in 1990[/p][/*][*][p]Swallow – emblem of the Soviet 15th Guards Mechanized Brigade during the Second World War[/p][/*][*][p]Deer – emblem of the Soviet 13th Guards Mechanized Brigade during the Second World War[/p][/*][*][p]Elephant – emblem of the Soviet 14th Guards Mechanized Brigade during the Second World War[/p][/*][*][p]Elk – emblem of the Soviet 740th Anti-Aircraft Artillery Regiment during the Second World War[/p][/*][/list][p]And last but not least, there’s the emblem belonging to the Soviet 24th "Iron" Motor Guards Division garrisoned in Lvov, as seen in 1989. This decal doesn’t contain the image of an animal (it’s a depiction of a river and mountains) but is tied to a story involving a T-72B1 with three layers of ERA on top of each other, a deliberate attempt at disinformation from the Soviet side. We considered the story interesting enough to add it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6fb5f0fefc1d3ef0f1080de2e619c8960a01a024.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But that’s still not all. Three older skins await you as well:[/p][list][*][p]Tamanskaya Division for T-90[/p][/*][*][p]Motherland for T-90A[/p][/*][*][p]Nakidka for T-90MS[/p][/*][/list][p]And if you have them already? No problem, in that case you’ll receive 2000 bonus Battle Coins for each.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a834ee0a926fbb3f7a2d2a11b5bdbf5907680abc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Beasts of Steel event is launching soon. We hope you’ll enjoy it and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d2b40b932bec0945b91136a4a8d534037f586912.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Offer: KF51 Panther, Panzer 87-140
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]KF51 Panther Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Panzer 87-140 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between July 29, 2025 and August 5, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]KF51 Panther[/h2][p][/p][p]The KF51 Panther Main Battle Tank first appeared in 2022 as a demonstrator of Rheinmetall’s capabilities, mating a modified Leopard 2 hull with a brand-new turret armed not only with cutting edge weaponry, but also a missile launcher. The Panther is one of western next-gen MBT projects, much like the EMBT and the next-generation Abrams. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kf51-panther"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/kf_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the KF51 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. The KF51 Panther is at its core a medium-range vehicle with reliable armor and solid firepower that, in addition to its 130mm gun and NERA armor, boasts a powerful missile launcher. This combination makes it one of the most powerful MBTs you can encounter in the game.[/p][p]The KF51 Panther Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Panzer 87-140[/h2][p][/p][p]The Panzer 87-140 is an experimental version of Panzer 87 (Swiss Leopard 2A4), fitted with a RUAG 140mm smoothbore cannon and an armor kit called WE. It was developed in the 1980s and early 1990s to counter the next generation of Soviet MBTs, but with the collapse of the Soviet Union, the project was shelved, only to resurface around 2005-2006 but never passing the experimental stage. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-panzer-87-140"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_8_1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Panzer 87-140 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Much like other Leopard series MBTs, it’s a long-range fighter with an extremely powerful gun and the ability to fire with pinpoint accuracy. Even though its armor leaves much to be desired, at long range, this MBT has few equals and can be considered one of the best snipers of its class.[/p][p]The Panzer 87-140 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy this offer and, as usual:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Scavenger Run is here!
notes.content:
[p]Commanders!

Starting on July 25, you’ll be able to earn a major bonus to your next Gold purchase (even a truly massive one, like 80 percent) by participating in the [b]Scavenger Run[/b] event.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d7e592cc4e3db798306c9dcab6cd6de8d23c2ea1.png"][/img]
In other words, in case you win such a bonus and buy 1.000 Gold, you’ll receive 1.800 Gold instead. And that can make one hell of a difference (please note, however, that the maximum amount of bonus Gold obtainable this way is 10.000 Gold).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/9a5d7c130af931c1b6db41df3913bfd05f06c3bc.jpg"][/img]
Scavenger Run is, in its core, a very simple event. There are many ruined and abandoned objects across the world of Armored Warfare and your friendly neighborhood arms dealer ran across one of them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3873a4941509b892bc900a323d705d520f6ecf9b.jpg"][/img]
You are now being hired to scout it out. On a small map, you choose one of three bases and then scout its three warehouses by clicking on them. Depending on your finds (determined randomly), you will receive a sizeable bonus to your next Gold purchase.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/97f48b6d29f92bb005530aa8a28171d0e4b11849.jpg"][/img]
This event will be active for several days (the counter in Garage will always tell you how much time is left), so if you’re planning to stock on Gold for the next Battle Path or simply want to boost your progress right now, it’s the perfect opportunity to do so.

We hope that you’ll enjoy this new mechanic and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]
[/p]

notes.title: Historical Skins: T-90A Burlak “Gromozeka”
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]With the recent conclusion of the Operation Liberty event, we were pleasantly surprised by its popularity and by how many players were actively participating in order to get their hands on its two epic skin rewards.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/2ad1202b666b95125c3a08ea77de08b5922adaaf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is why, starting in early August, we’ll be launching yet another epic event that’ll run until mid-September, featuring two epic prizes – the [b]Gromozeka skin for the T-90A Burlak and the vehicle itself.[/b] That’s right, you’ll be able to earn that sweet tank and the skin by simply playing every day. But let’s take a look at the skin itself.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5be2a1da24e40277204b7ed472cb3e5b8067c273.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Once again, the skin isn’t exactly historical in the strictest sense of the word, because the Burlak turret never entered service. A prototype or two were made and that was about it – you can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-t-90a-burlak"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][i]But what if the Burlak [b]had[/b] entered service?[/i] That is the theme of the skin.[/p][p]As you can see on the screenshots, the vehicle is painted in Russian military colors and shows many signs of heavy use. It looks like it has seen a lot of combat in mercenary hands and even has some camouflage nets attached to it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/1532d01a043c0614043902ac9e980086fb6d377e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The name Gromozeka comes from an award-winning Soviet cartoon movie “The Mystery of the Third Planet” from 1981 (or an even earlier book from the 1960s the movie was based on), where it was the name of one of the characters, an alien archeologist. We’ve chosen the name as a tribute to the quality of journalism as it is tied to a certain story that is perhaps better left unmentioned.[/p][p]Still, regardless of the background, Gromozeka is a mercenary vehicle and as such is adorned with crude soldier sense of humor in mind.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7a65109933a7632bc6f5b30dd19f8eed70a5a922.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The skin has one more interesting property – it unlocks the vehicle’s modules usually locked behind contract requirements. That way you’ll be able to play your Burlak at full power immediately after getting it.[/p][p]The skin and the vehicle of course aren’t the only prizes in the event. You’ll be able to earn Rough Riders Battle Coins, new beast-themed decals, older skins and new great-looking camouflages. We’ll tell you more about those in the near future but, for now:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Scandinavian Week
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Stridsvagn 2000 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]CV90120 Ghost Tier 9 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]CV90 Mk.IV Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]CV90105 TML Tier 7 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Swedish bundle with real-life Swedish camouflages[/p][/*][*][p]Norwegian bundle with real-life Scandinavian camouflages and unit insignia[/p][/*][*][p]Danish bundle with real-life Danish camouflage and base paint[/p][/*][*][p]Pile of Gold Loot Crate[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between July 24, 2025 and July 31, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]Stridsvagn 2000[/h2][p][/p][p]The Stridsvagn 2000 was to be Sweden’s next Main Battle Tank, designed to combat Soviet super-tanks such as the Black Eagle. For its time, the project was nothing short of revolutionary with extremely thick frontal armor and a powerful 140mm gun that could take on literally anything in its day. However, the Soviet threat dissipated with the collapse of the Soviet Union, which pushed Sweden to seek a cheaper solution to its tank problem, namely the Leopard 2 MBT. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-stridsvagn-2000"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_73.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Stridsvagn 2000 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank that represents the essence of practicality. Solid armor, decent mobility and excellent damage over time output make this tank one of the most versatile tools you can have in your arsenal, equally capable in PvP and PvE. Aside from its advanced NERA armor, the Strv 2000 features a coaxial 40mm autocannon. The key to success is switching between both weapon systems and maximizing your damage output while your NERA armor eliminated one enemy shell after another.[/p][p]The Stridsvagn 2000 MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]CV90120 Ghost[/h2][p][/p][p]The CV90120 “Ghost” Light Tank was a Swedish demonstrator based on an earlier fire support model of the CV90120. As its name suggests, the vehicle is armed with 120mm smoothbore cannon but that’s the least interesting on its features. The Ghost is named after a special camouflage system called ADAPTIV that's capable of masking the bulky tank in the IR spectrum so well it disappears from enemy screens – like a ghost. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-cv90120-ghost"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_4_43.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the CV90120 Ghost is a Tier 9 Premium Light Tank. Depending on your choices, it can be configured two ways – as a fast hit-and-run Light Tank using the combination of a Ready Rack and its excellent mobility, or as a stealthy sniper using the ADAPTIV system and the upgraded ammunition. While you won’t be as stealthy as dedicated Tank Destroyers or small AFVs, you’ll still be able to do a lot of damage from behind the safety of your lines.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]CV90 Mk.IV[/h2][p][/p][p]The Swedish CV90 Mk.IV IFV is the most modern version of the old but constantly developed CV90 platform. Since its introduction in the early 1990s, the vehicle was upgraded so much that this 2018 model bears little resemblance to the three decades old original, featuring cutting edge electronics as well as a brand new turret. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-cv90-mkiv"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_76.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the CV90 Mk.IV is a Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It is a durable and reliable infantry carrier capable not only of dealing tremendous damage with its 50mm autocannon, but of launching powerful Spike missiles as well. In addition to that, it’s relatively well-protected and can also carry Mechanized Infantry. What’s there not to like?[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]CV90105 TML[/h2][p][/p][p]The CV90105 TML from the 1990s was one of the first attempts to convert the CV90 chassis into a fire support vehicle by combining it with a French TML turret. The result was a fairly capable Light Tank with considerable firepower in the form of its 105mm GIAT gun that could successfully take out most MBTs of its time. Unfortunately, the vehicle didn’t manage to attract any customers and remained a prototype only. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-cv90105-tml"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_3_57.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the CV90105 TML is a Tier 7 Premium Light Tank. Depending on your choices, it can be configured two ways. You can opt for a more sustained firepower with the large 12-round clip – this way you need to stay behind your own team or hide in bushes, turning your Light Tank into something like a close support Tank Destroyer. Or, you can opt for the fun option of turning your CV90105 TML into a hit and run monster. Ambush an enemy, empty the magazine into his sides or rear and immediately retreat.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Swedish Bundle[/h2][p][/p][p]Despite its neutrality, Sweden is one of the premiere arms manufacturers in the world and has a powerful standing army to boot. Much of its vehicle fleet is compatible with western tech and the country now operates the Leopard 2 MBT (under the name Stridsvagn 122) as well as several CV90 variants. This bundle includes several camouflages tied to Sweden as well as a special player title.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_3_39.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The bundle consists of:[/p][list][*][p]Scandinavian Summer camouflage ([b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-scandinavia"]read more[/url][/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Scandinavian Winter camouflage ([b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-scandinavia"]read more[/url][/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Swedish Export camouflage ([b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflage-swedish-export"]read more[/url][/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Swedish Urban camouflage (as seen on various CV90 prototypes)[/p][/*][*][p]Swedish Flag decal[/p][/*][*][p]Player title “Viking”[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Norwegian Bundle[/h2][p][/p][p]Norway is a part of the NATO with its units regularly taking part in operations abroad. One of the elite units of the Norwegian military is the famous Telemark Battalion of Mechanized Infantry and this bundle includes two items tied to it as well as the Scandinavian camouflages used by Norway and a Norwegian base paint, as seen on a Telemark Leopard deployed to Estonia in 2017.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_51.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The bundle consists of:[/p][list][*][p]Scandinavian Summer camouflage ([b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-scandinavia"]read more[/url][/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Scandinavian Winter camouflage ([b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-scandinavia"]read more[/url][/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Scandinavian base paint ([b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-scandinavia"]read more[/url][/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Telemark Battalion decal[/p][/*][*][p]Telemark Battalion flag[/p][/*][*][p]Player title “Einheri”[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Danish Bundle[/h2][p][/p][p]And last but definitely not least, we have Denmark, the army equipped with some of the best military hardware there is, including the Leopard 2A7DK Main Battle Tank. Aside from its simple but unique camouflage, this bundle contains a Danish player title, the Scandinavian base paint and a decal.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_48.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The bundle consists of:[/p][list][*][p]Danish camouflage ([b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-finland-and-denmark"]read more[/url][/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Scandinavian base paint ([b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-scandinavia"]read more[/url][/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Danish 1st Armored Battalion decal[/p][/*][*][p]Player title “Thrice-Hearted” (referring to the Holger Danske legend)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Pile of Gold[/h2][p][/p][p]We also have the [b]Pile of Gold[/b] Loot Crate for you. This Loot Crate contains copious amounts of Gold for you to win.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/814_234_0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This Loot Crate includes:[/p][list][*][p]250.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]100.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]50.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]10.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]5.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]1.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]100 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy this offer and, as usual:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Rough Riders Battle Path is now available!
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]We’re happy to announce that the [b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b] campaign has just begun.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="5Y1XaHcZOv8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The Rough Riders Battle Path is focused on U.S. cavalry, from its humble beginnings in the Revolutionary War, the Civil War, the Rough Riders era of the late 19th century and both world wars to its transformation to the Armored Cavalry branch after the Vietnam War. The rewards will therefore be theme-appropriate, but there’s also a different theme at play here.[/p][p]There are 50 levels of waiting for you as usual. Let’s start with the vehicles:[/p][list][*][p][b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-elke"]ELKE[/url][/b] Tier 7 Premium LT for reaching Level 20 (featuring an elevated weapons station allowing you to ambush your enemies with ease)[/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-rdflt-ares"]RDF/LT Ares[/url][/b] Tier 8 Premium LT for reaching Level 35 (featuring powerful missile launchers as well as 75mm gun)[/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xm1302"]XM1302[/url][/b] Tier 10 Premium LT for reaching Level 50 (featuring new “Mitigation” passive ability – the faster you go, the less damage you take)[/p][/*][/list][p]There of course are new epic skins based on real-life vehicles, such as:[/p][list][*][p]M60A3 “Crustacean” for the M60A3[/p][/*][*][p]M3A2 Cavalry Vehicle for the M2 Bradley[/p][/*][*][p]IPM1 “Danger Zone” for the M1 Abrams[/p][/*][/list][p]Each comes with its unique story of U.S. service. New camouflages, decals and base paints will also come with this Battle Path.[/p][p]You can review the prizes in the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-prize-highlights"]following article.[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Accessing the Battle Path[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]In order to join the Battle Path campaign, please enter the game and click on the Rough Riders icon on the upper bar. From there, you can simply purchase the Battle Path access:[/p][list][*][p]Standard pass (access only)[/p][/*][*][p]Golden pass with access and 50.000 Battle Coins[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The access can also be purchased in our Web Shop:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=bp"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d2b40b932bec0945b91136a4a8d534037f586912.jpg[/img]

66[/p][/*][*][p]VT5: Increased the amount of APS charges to 12[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p]With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your notes.title: Rough Riders Battle Path: Vehicle Mechanics
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p][/p][p]Since the [b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b] is coming soon and we’d like to take one more look at its weird and cool vehicles that you’ll have the opportunity to obtain soon.[/p][p]First is the [b]ELKE.[/b] While a combination of an unmanned turret and a light hull might seem unremarkable first, it is anything but. The most important part of the vehicle is, of course, its ability to depress and elevate its gun using a complex system. Here you can see it in action. The vehicle boasts -25/+20 depression and elevation angles.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="X8dLT3qZYkI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]And then there is the incredibly powerful (for its Tier) 75mm gun that is basically a crossbreed between a regular gun and an autocannon. Indeed, it is capable of automatic fire:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="5Qjbd4FtfLM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This light tank will be capable of tremendous speed but it will also allow you to ambush your enemies while taking cover behind a hill thanks to that elevated gun. What will be your tactic of choice? You decide.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="rWJYL9Hs6Y0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The [b]RDF/LT Ares[/b] is somewhat similar to the ELKE, but instead of focusing on the gun (which remains awesome despite being a Tier higher), it adds guided missiles to the equation. The regular missiles are nothing to scoff at, but the high-explosive Stinger missiles are devastating.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="dJRi1cGtQh8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Fast and deadly, the Ares will decimate all opposition of played correctly.[/p][p]And last but not least, we have the [b]XM1302[/b] on the top Tier. Here, the highlight of the tank (aside from its firepower and mobility) will be its new ability, “Mitigation” – this ability allows the vehicle to take reduced damage when moving fast, as demonstrated below:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="rTXos4UhEb4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We aim to make the XM1302 one of the most powerful vehicles of Armored Warfare thanks to its combination of a rapid-firing cannon and great mobility. This vehicle will be perfect for players who prefer not to stand still, but instead dart around the battlefield, aiding their allies or even single handedly decimating whole squads of enemies in a relentless assault.[/p][p]And that’s about it, commanders, now you know everything about the next Battle Path. Well... almost everything, as we have one or two surprises left for you. But for now, saddle up because the event is about to start and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Eastern Bloc Week
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Object 490 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Object 640 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]M-95 Degman Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]ZUBR PSP Tier 7 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]BWP-2000 Tier 7 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Shadow Protocol Loot Crate ([b]final offer[/b])[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between July 17 and July 22, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Object 490[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The Object 490 Main Battle Tank was an advanced concept from the waning days of the Soviet Union. Designed in the 1980s, it represented a radical departure from the MBT paradigm. Its distinct wedge-like shape, along with the fact that the crew was located in the back, offered unparalleled levels of protection. But the most interesting part of the design was its double suspension paired with two engines, allowing the vehicle to stay mobile even after suffering significant damage. However, the conclusion of the Cold War put an end to this design, along with many other advanced Soviet projects. You can learn more about this vehicle in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-490"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/armored-warfare-object-490.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Object 490 Tier 10 Premium MBT is perhaps the best armored vehicle in the game. It’s a true behemoth that is almost impossible to slow down, let alone knock out, and concentrated effort is required to stop one of these things when encountering them on the battlefield. The combination of extremely thick armor and a powerful 152mm gun makes this tank incredibly deadly, even though these advantages are balanced by its mediocre agility and the fact that its gun is only forward facing. This MBT is ideal for you if you prefer slow, methodical advances while dealing massive amounts of damage with each shot. If you keep your flanks secure, you’ll be all but impossible to stop.[/p][p]The Object 490 MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Object 640[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The Object 640 is one of the last Soviet era “super tank” monsters, designed to surpass anything the west could field on the battlefield. It featured extremely advanced armor, making it highly resistant to hits while keeping its weight low. The design was truly revolutionary for the late 1980s, but, like with many other Soviet projects of the era, it was discontinued due to the lack of funding. You can learn more about it in a [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-640-black-eagle"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_74.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Object 640 “Black Eagle” is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. It is a fast, agile and well-protected vehicle that plays in a typical Russian-style MBT fashion – ideal for players who want to take things up close and personal. This version of the tank does not feature any camouflage and is ready to be customized as you see fit.[/p][p]The Object 640 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]M-95 Degman[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The M-95 Degman is an advanced Croatian prototype MBT, developed during the 1990s and 2000s. It is based on the previous Yugoslavian project, the Vihor MBT, which in turn has its roots in the improved T-72M series produced in former Yugoslavia. You can read more about its history in a [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-m-95-degman"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_5_9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the tank is relatively fast and fairly agile while carrying some potent firepower for its Tier. In fact, its owners can choose from two powerful guns:[/p][list][*][p]125mm 2A46 Russian-style smoothbore gun, known from many Russian MBTs[/p][/*][*][p]120mm CTG NATO-style smoothbore gun that you know from the Challenger 1 Falcon MBT[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s worth noting that the 120mm shells have higher penetration values and the gun can also fire Falarick ATGMs while the 125mm gun has higher damage per shot. Both guns will feature good handling as well as overall performance to offset the vehicle’s weakness, which is its mediocre armor. The Degman must rely on its mobility and firepower to survive, making it an ideal vehicle for aggressive, daring players.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]ZUBR PSP[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The ZUBR was a Czech privately-funded project by PSP Bohemia from the 1990s to develop a successor platform to the aging Soviet-era BMP-series IFVs and various other obsolete specialized vehicles. Even though it was quite advanced for its time, it was ultimately unsuccessful due to the end of the Cold War and the subsequent cuts in European military budgets, including the Czech one. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-zubr-psp"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_36.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the ZUBR PSP is a Tier 7 wheeled Premium Tank Destroyer. What makes it fairly unique is the fact that you can choose from two different weapon systems for this vehicle:[/p][list][*][p]Cockerill CT-CV turret with 105mm gun[/p][/*][*][p]Four-barreled TOW ATGM launcher[/p][/*][/list][p]Each of these weapons changes the gameplay style of the vehicle considerably and it is up to you, how you configure this powerful machine.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]BWP-2000[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The BWP-2000 IFV was a Polish attempt from the mid-1990s to develop a replacement for the license-produced BMP-1 in the Polish military, since it was getting obsolete by that point. Its protracted development led to its cancellation at the onset of War on Terror, leaving Poland without a modern tracked IFV to this day. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-bwp-2000"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_3_28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the BWP-2000 is a Tier 7 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle armed with 60mm cannon as well as a set of ATGM launchers. When it comes to AFV playstyle, the BWP-2000 is definitely more of an infantry carrier and fire support vehicle than a scout due to its large size and powerful armament as well as the ability to deploy Mechanized Infantry. It can take quite a bit of punishment and deal it in equal measure.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Shadow Protocol Loot Crate[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/shadow-protocol-battle-path-now-available"][b]Shadow Protocol[/b][/url] Loot Crate is now available. This Loot Crate contains Shadow Protocol Battle Coins and Boosters.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="pk7xVMRxZmg;full"][/previewyoutube][list][*][p][b]Battle Coins[/b] are the primary currency of the Shadow Protocol Battle Path campaign and are used to progress through it and to obtain its prizes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle Coin Boosters[/b] are usable only during an active Battle Path and increase your Battle Coin income by 900 percent for two hours.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that you have to obtain the access to a Battle Path to use both items.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Puma, Boxer RIWP
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Puma Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Boxer RIWP Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between July 15, 2025 and July 22, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]Puma[/h2][p][/p][p]The Puma is the principal IFV of the Bundeswehr and one of the most modern vehicles in its category in the world. While expensive, it features nearly unparalleled situational awareness and protection. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-puma"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_410.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Puma is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. The Puma doesn’t feature any special or situational features. It’s simply one of the best performing infantry carriers out there, laying down fire with its 30mm autocannon and guided missiles.[/p][p]The Puma Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Boxer RIWP[/h2][p][/p][p]The Boxer RIWP is a combination of a Tracked Boxer hull and a modular turret called RIWP. Both components are fairly new and haven’t been officially combined as of now but the Boxer platform can theoretically support this weapon system. You can read more about it in [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-boxer-riwp"]our dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_436.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Boxer RIWP is a Tier 10 Premium AFV that’s unique for one reason – it offers five fairly distinctive weapon configurations along with a reliable autocannon capable of quickly dealing with lighter targets. It can also deploy Mechanized Infantry.[/p][p]The Boxer RIWP Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Celebrating Bastille Day
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]July 14 is celebrated in France as the National Celebration (La fête nationale), but it is more commonly known in the English-speaking countries as the Bastille Day. The name signifies one of the most important episodes of the French Revolution, the storming of the Bastille prison-fortress on the 14th of July 1789. The fortress was considered a symbol of royal power and its fall was a significant blow to the authority of the king.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/new_front_4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Until July 17, 2025, 16:00 CEST, you’ll be earning [b]30% more Experience and Reputation per battle.[/b] Additionally, you can pick up a [b]gift[/b] that contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]2.000 Battle Coins for the Shadow Protocol Battle Path[/p][/*][*][p]1.000 Battle Coins for the Rough Riders Battle Path[/p][/*][*][p]2 Battle Coin Boosters[/p][/*][*][p]3 Platinum Boosters[/p][/*][*][p]7 days of Premium Time[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Click on the link below to claim it![/b][/p][p]

We hope that you’ll enjoy this present and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]
