notes.title: Offer: Bastille Day
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]EMBT Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]EBRC Jaguar Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Challenger 2 Streetfighter II Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Leclerc Tropicalisé skin for Leclerc[/p][/*][*][p]Glorieux skin for Leclerc[/p][/*][*][p]Bastille skin for Leclerc Prototype[/p][/*][*][p]Leclerc T40 Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]AMX-10 RCR with the Vive la France skin[/p][/*][*][p]French camouflages[/p][/*][*][p]Marder 2 Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Leopard Revolution Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Treasure Trove with 10.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Shadow Protocol Battle Coins ([b]final offer with maximum discounts[/b])[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between July 10, 2025 and July 17, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]EMBT[/h2][p][/p][p]The Enhanced Main Battle Tank (EMBT) is a future MBT demonstrator developed over the course of several years as cooperation between the Germany (KMW) and the French (Nexter). It features a heavily modified Leopard 2 hull with a brand-new turret unveiled in 2022 during the Eurosatory 2022 expo in Paris. Our version of the tank is armed with 140mm ASCALON gun. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-embt"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/embt_1920x1080.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the EMBT is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Extreme accuracy and firepower are its domain as it features an incredibly powerful 140mm gun and a special ability called Machine Learning that increases the kinetic round penetration with each shot (up to three times). In its medium range support vehicle role, this tank has few equals thanks to the abovementioned ability and the availability of top-attack HEAT rounds.[/p][p]The EMBT Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]EBRC Jaguar[/h2][p][/p][p]The Jaguar is a part of the Scorpion program, launched to develop France’s next generation of armored fighting vehicles. In this program, the Jaguar fulfills the role of a light recon and fire support vehicle. It combines cutting edge technology with high speed and excellent firepower. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-ebrc-jaguar"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080t_2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Jaguar is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It’s fast, light and an amazing scout, but it can also hold its own in combat thanks to its 40mm cannon, guided missiles and active suspension.[/p][p]The Jaguar Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Challenger 2 Streetfighter II[/h2][p][/p][p]The Streetfighter II is an upgrade program to overhaul the venerable Challenger 2 Main Battle Tank for the conditions of modern battlefields, especially urban combat. It features a number of improvements and extra components, most notably a dozer blade, a Brimstone ATGM twin launcher and an advanced camera system by Elbit. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-challenger-2-streetfighter-ii"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_72.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Challenger 2 Streetfighter is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Its main advantages include excellent frontal armor (enhanced by the presence of its dozer blade covering its lower frontal plate), increased ramming damage and long range lethality, courtesy of a powerful ATGM launcher. Whether you desire to bring the fighting up close or support other MBTs at distance, the Streetfighter’s got your back.[/p][p]The Challenger 2 Streetfighter II Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Leclerc Tropicalisé Skin[/h2][p][/p][p]This skin for the Leclerc Tier 9 Main Battle Tank is based on an export model for the United Arab Emirates. In real life, the vehicle features a number of improvements or modifications over the French model, but the in-game version simply adds this cool desert look to your Leclerc. You can read more in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-leclerc-tropicalise"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_6_8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The skin is available as a part of the Tropicalisé Bundle, which contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Tropicalisé skin for Leclerc[/p][/*][*][p]FORAD Blue base paint[/p][/*][*][p]7 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]1.500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Gallery (Click to Open)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Glorieux Skin for Leclerc[/h2][p][/p][p]Another realistic skin that we introduced based on your feedback is the Glorieux one. This skin for the Leclerc Tier 9 progression Main Battle Tank is based on one particular Leclerc MBT that took part in the KFOR operations in former Yugoslavia. Its unique camouflage along with other historical details makes it one of the best looking skins to date. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-leclerc-glorieux"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_19.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This skin is available in a bundle:[/p][list][*][p]Glorieux skin for Leclerc[/p][/*][*][p]White base paint (used by the French during U.N. peacekeeper missions, goes nicely with the next decal)[/p][/*][*][p]Battle-Hardened status for Leclerc[/p][/*][*][p]1.000 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that the bundles include the skin but not the Leclerc MBT itself. This tank needs to be obtained via progression directly in the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gallery (Click to Open)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Bastille skin for Leclerc Prototype[/h2][p][/p][p]Bastille is a French-themed skin for the Leclerc Prototype Tier 7 progression Main Battle Tank, celebrating the abovementioned holiday with the traditional French colors.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_7_5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The skin is available as a part of the Bastille Bundle, which contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Bastille skin for Leclerc Prototype[/p][/*][*][p]3 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that this bundle does not contain the Leclerc Prototype Tier 7 MBT, only the skin itself.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Leclerc T40[/h2][p][/p][p]Sometimes called the French Terminator, this vehicle was designed on the Leclerc MBT chassis with one purpose in mind – to accompany tanks and fight off infantry attacks the same way as the Russian BMPT series does. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-leclerc-t40"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_18.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Leclerc T40 is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. It offers you a combination of a durable hull, rapid-fire 40mm automatic cannon and, most importantly, the Javelin missile system. Simply right-click the target, wait until it becomes locket and fire the Javelin ATGM – it will home itself on the target, attacking its weak roof armor. Thanks to this ability, the Leclerc T40 is one of the most destructive vehicles in the game.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]AMX-10 RCR[/h2][p][/p][p]The AMX 10 RCR is the updated variant of the French AMX 10 RC fire support vehicle by GIAT, originally developed in the early 1980s. This light and nimble wheeled 6x6 AFV was armed with a 105mm gun, allowing it to knock out even armored targets at considerable distances. Over 200 of these aging vehicles were upgraded by Nexter in 2010 with improved armor and electronics, enabling them to fulfill modern battlefield tasks until their eventual replacement by the Jaguar. You can learn more about its history in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-amx-10-rcr"]dedicated article![/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_3_17.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the AMX 10 RCR is a Tier 8 wheeled Premium Tank Destroyer. It’s incredibly agile with its wheeled chassis allowing it to outrun pretty much any enemy on the battlefield save for the fastest AFVs. Its gun accuracy is also top notch, making this vehicle perfect for sniper-style gameplay as its thin armor can’t protect it against enemy shells at close distances. This vehicle also comes with the Hydraulic Suspension active ability.[/p][p]This vehicle is also available in a special bundle, which contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]AMX-10 RCR Tier 8 Premium TD[/p][/*][*][p]Vive la France skin for AMX-10 RCR[/p][/*][*][p]République skin for ERC-90 F4 Sagaie[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]French Camouflages[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve also prepared two French historical camouflages. In reality, it’s pretty much one iconic camouflage with two different layouts that is most famous for its appearance on the Leclerc MBT. It consists of green, brown and black stripes and is available in two variants – one has the edges clearly defined while the other variant has them blurred. Both were observed on the Leclerc MBT, sometimes even on vehicles from the same series.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_3_40.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Please note that each of these camouflages can be installed on any vehicle that has the camouflage customization feature available (any vehicle with the exception of vehicles with permanent skins) and that each of these camouflages can be used in all three environments.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gallery (Click to Open)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Leopard 2 Revolution[/h2][p][/p][p]The Leopard 2 Revolution is a continuation of the older Evolution upgrade, intended to improve the performance of the older variants of the Leopard 2 Main Battle Tank in order to make it excel even on the battlefields of the 21st century. The improvements include a comprehensive armor upgrade, ROSY soft-kill APS and smoke grenade launchers as well as an entire suite of cutting edge electronics. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-leopard-2-revolution"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_53.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Leopard 2 Revolution is a Tier 8 Main Battle Tank. It is not only well-armored, it also features an extremely accurate 120mm gun with advanced ammunition, allowing it to destroy its opponents at very long ranges, rivaling those of Tank Destroyers. The German tanks in general perform best at longer ranges and the Revolution is no exception.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Marder 2[/h2][p][/p][p]The Marder 2 was an experimental German IFV, developed in the late 1980s to replace the aging Marder IFV. It featured more armor, a new turret and a brand-new Rheinmetall dual-caliber autocannon that could fire both 35mm and 50mm rounds. Despite its qualities, the vehicle was never accepted in service due to its high cost and because it was no longer needed because of the fall of the Soviet Union. A single surviving prototype can be found today in the Koblenz military collection. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-marder-2"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_50.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Marder 2 is a Tier 8 Armored Fighting Vehicle. With its 44 tons, it’s one of the heaviest and toughest AFVs around. Unlike many other AFVs of its Tier, it is not armed with guided missiles, relying instead on its extremely powerful 50mm autocannon. This vehicle can also deploy Mechanized Infantry.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Treasure Trove[/h2][p][/p][p]Today, we have a special offer for you. [b]A veritable treasure trove of 10.000 Gold[/b] awaits you at a discounted price.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/chest_of_gold.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Please note[/b] that this item can only be purchased once per user. You can find out more about Gold and its uses in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/guide-boosting-your-progress"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Shadow Protocol Battle Coins[/h2][p][/p][p]This week, we are offering you an opportunity to [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/shadow-protocol-battle-path-now-available"]boost your Battle Path[/url][/b] progress and get that main prize you know you want – the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-knifv-nlos-lps"]KNIFV NLOS LPS Tier 10 Premium TD![/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="pk7xVMRxZmg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The following Battle Coin bundles are available:[/p][list][*][p]1.000 Battle Coins (20% off)[/p][/*][*][p]5.000 Battle Coins (30% off)[/p][/*][*][p]10.000 Battle Coins (40% off)[/p][/*][*][p]25.000 Battle Coins (50% off)[/p][/*][*][p]50.000 Battle Coins (60% off)[/p][/*][/list][p]Battle Coins can be used for a number of things, including:[/p][list][*][p]Force-completing Battle Path missions[/p][/*][*][p]Progressing through Battle Path levels[/p][/*][*][p]Purchasing the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-787-gadyuka"]Gadyuka blueprints from the Shop[/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Please note:[/b] In order to use Battle Coins, you need to obtain the access to the Shadow Protocol Battle Path.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bp"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Rough Riders Battle Path: Prize Highlights
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]The [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-info-and-preorder"]Rough Riders Battle Path[/url][/b] is coming in the second half of July and, as usual, we’d like to take a moment to tell you more about its prizes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/dd1542c49fbbee061f50956a6be4a829c5351661.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As you already know, the topic of this Battle Path is the history of U.S. light tanks – or, rather, the U.S. cavalry. As such, the Battle Path features numerous American-themed prizes, including vehicles and everything else. As usual, we have three [b]new Premium vehicles[/b] for you:[/p][list][*][p][b]ELKE[/b] Tier 7 Premium LT for reaching Level 20 (featuring an elevated weapons station allowing you to ambush your enemies with ease)[/p][/*][*][p][b]RDF/LT Ares[/b] Tier 8 Premium LT for reaching Level 35 (featuring powerful missile launchers as well as 75mm gun)[/p][/*][*][p][b]XM1302[/b] Tier 10 Premium LT for reaching Level 50 (featuring new “Mitigation” passive ability – the faster you go, the less damage you take)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/abf17dd73288fa95645f58bac1e1160f9461d754.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3ff234c608b85835c487c9de58af4fa38a8a892c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, you can earn the [b]following older vehicles[/b] by progressing down this Battle Path:[/p][list][*][p]T92 ACAV Tier 2 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]M60A3 SLEP Tier 6 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Expeditionary LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Griffin 120mm Tier 8 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][/list][p]It also has to be mentioned that the Light Tanks from the vehicle pool are getting buffed. You can learn more about that in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/developer-diary-light-tank-changes"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/42cc1369e13399a7b4feddf2f56d075d9ba70a23.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/042f133bfdd8f75b5022fb890ccb3d23a10ea3bb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ce09a20a91411fad97550f3132e74237d7d5d163.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a94f248b3dd57a8b86702c1b84465766d4ba2fa3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b4f38cde31b5a3c56a32e99259abf287dd1468f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You will also be able to earn the [b]MPF Tier 10 Premium Light Tank[/b] via blueprints available in the Battle Path Shop. The M10 Booker skin for it was also added to the Battle Path Shop pool.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/646df926659ad81e3cdbf80204a5a738af1553f3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There is also a returning [b]Premium commander called Anthony Diaz[/b] for reaching Level 49. This rugged commander has a set of versatile skills that make him suitable for a lot of vehicles.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c9ad85450f7d0f812db2f3f776f3c4ff8f77b715.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And last but not least, some of the most epic skins and camouflages are making a return as well, including (but not limited to):[/p][list][*][p]Full set of Prime skins[/p][/*][*][p]Freedom Rider skin[/p][/*][*][p]Ridgway skin for M8-120[/p][/*][*][p]Rough Rider skin for M60A3 SLEP[/p][/*][*][p]Gunslinger skin for the T249 Vigilante[/p][/*][*][p]Asgard skin for the M1A2[/p][/*][*][p]Vanguard skin for CATTB[/p][/*][*][p]Full set of MERDCS camouflages[/p][/*][*][p]Reforger 83 camouflages[/p][/*][*][p]Skins for the reward Light Tanks mentioned above (such as Acid and Reaper)[/p][/*][/list][p]Here are some of them:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/44c73596edc87de472e81b93adeb8eff8a9883c6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/8d4054e8fec81790deaa3c489571920234555b62.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/77dab9f55edc521649c8b1d607302200c6acb099.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c13d223f706f73af8d676bfa70089ef7fbd30c67.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6f84d2d09e78063274c03ad1d18339ac3e818370.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d7b59cf972680ff65c80631e9af23c5662fc2ac2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But those are older prizes, what you want to see are some new ones, right? Let’s take a look at some of the new skins and camouflages that are coming in this Battle Path:[/p][p]This skin for the Bradley is called [b]M3A2 Cavalry Fighting Vehicle.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5abf2ad342141eca4ca673a461b5f6417a03c8df.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The M3 series of the Bradley platform is built for reconnaissance, carrying fewer troops and more ammunition and sensors instead. This particular Bradley belonged to the 1st Squadron of the 4th Cavalry Regiment, as seen in November 2004 during Operation Iraqi Freedom, the American invasion of Iraq.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/cc358b9e00a0107c04db9b6d903d8ec72ae04073.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We chose the Bradley not only for its cavalry version, but also because it’s one of the best performing IFVs in the game currently. And to make things even better, we finally made Bradley’s launcher elevate and depress in battle. Take a look:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7ad6739a161c6311e29ff31007fbf2c35e931ff6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5eff68bc1967534cb94428a8cd1245eb5423bcf9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Next skin we have for you is called [b]IPM1 Danger Zone[/b] for the M1 Abrams MBT.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c99af31143d19cb29caac1a41442cdf8a955378c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The "Danger Zone" was an IPM1 Abrams participating in (and winning) the 1987 Canadian Army Trophy that took place in the Bergen-Hohne training area. It belonged to Company D of the 4th Squadron, 8th Cavalry Regiment, 3rd Armored Division in West Germany. It used a stylized version of the "Bill the Cat" cartoon as its emblem, which was an inside poke at one of its rivals, 3-64 Armor, who had been using the comic-strip cat Garfield as its mascot.[/p][p]Another major emblem was the "Spearhead" belonging to the 3rd Armored Division, located at the back of the turret. The flags on the vehicle were event-specific and were not used in regular service. The Canadian flag was in recognition of the close training between the team and the Royal Canadian Dragoons. And, last but not least, the name "Danger Zone" came from a popular song from the Top Gun movie.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/24c71c966021a462e91b77d48b3f8c73c6750f25.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As you can see, the skin converts the M1 into an IPM1 with its rear turret stowage.[/p][p]The third skin we have for you is called [b]M60A3 Crustacean.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f0bc50f3c2426afe3f4d21bffc8413ab4c03ae88.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The "Crustacean" was an M60A1 tank serving in Germany in the 1970s with the 73rd Armor Regiment. It was one of the vehicles selected to test the new camouflage patterns coming out of the MASSTER program in Fort Hood. The variant used on this particular vehicle used two primary colors – Rust Brown and Sand, each covering roughly 40 percent of the vehicle in wide areas. The rest was divided between Forest Green and Black colors. This camouflage appeared in 1973 and was used on multiple vehicles of the VII Corps. The emblem on the tank consisted of a stylized depiction of the Mk.VII Liberty tank from the First World War with a shell on top of it. The meaning of this emblem is unknown.[/p][p]While the original “Crustacean” was an M60A1, we decided to adapt the skin for the M60A3 Main Battle Tank as the M60A1 already has a nice historical skin (the USMC, also available via the Battle Path Shop or during events). The skin is available for both its configurations:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4574f4ae22faf039bf6b6f26979640cfb047deef.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As for the [b]camouflages, colors and decals[/b] – as we mentioned above, these follow the history of U.S. cavalry from the Revolutionary War and the American fight with the British.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/01003fd2b366c2985c760f050461ac7f29ad0888.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/306423f1b9e9fbef03bb168a2fecfaf4a3e8e7df.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Civil War was also a major milestone of the U.S. cavalry history with both sides relying on brilliant commanders and brave soldiers.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/81384fcd57446e0a2af456f49c548072af5c6fcd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d4e6e625d08c16fb8d8a865e8f9c27db21f07b66.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Then came the Rough Rider era and both World Wars that saw the cavalry change into a powerful mechanized force.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/aa85e94c2df8678b298b6a32e54cbe0cd94ca9fa.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/57308a7ff20c1beddb6629fcbaf44a7bcef7bed0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Cold War saw the cavalry change again into an Air Cavalry branch with helicopters and Armored Cavalry with heavy vehicles, including tanks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/30e702d7e3cc16faad3bdbf4a019943aabfe5a12.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And even after the fall of the Soviet Union, America’s greatest adversary, the cavalry units continue to uphold their traditions as a new threat rises to challenge the most powerful military the world has ever seen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f95bf9af89a88439717fb54ff4335ee2b7663b7b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This and much more is waiting for you in the Rough Riders Battle Path. We hope that you’ll enjoy this event and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d2b40b932bec0945b91136a4a8d534037f586912.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Offer: KF41, Ajax
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]KF41 Lynx Prototype Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Ajax Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between July 8, 2025 and July 15, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]KF41 Lynx Prototype[/h2][p][/p][p]This is a 2018 prototype of the KF41 Lynx, a cutting edge IFV developed by Rheinmetall for export. Featuring advanced modular armor and multiple gun configurations, the vehicle has already been adopted by Hungary with more contracts pending. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kf41-lynx-prototype"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/kf41lynxprototype_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the KF41 Lynx Prototype is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It is a durable and powerful IFV featuring two weapon configurations (30mm and 35mm) as well as a new infantry type that fires large thermobaric warheads from its anti-tank launchers.[/p][p]The KF41 Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Ajax[/h2][p][/p][p]The Ajax is the most modern British Infantry Fighting Vehicle currently in service. Despite being plagued by developmental problems, the program to replace the aging Warrior IFV produced one of the best vehicles in its class. You can read more about it in [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-ajax"]our dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/ajax_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Ajax is a Tier 10 Premium AFV featuring solid protection levels and excellent sustained firepower. Furthermore, it can deploy Mechanized Infantry like other AFVs of its class and has a special ability that allows it to better detect enemies at closer ranges.[/p][p]The Ajax Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Celebrating the United States Independence Day
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]As every year, Armored Warfare is celebrating the [b]United States of America Independence Day.[/b] On the 4th of July 1776, following the end of the American Revolutionary War, the thirteen American colonies ratified the Declaration of Independence.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/_002_5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Until July 6, 2025, 16:00 CEST, you’ll be earning [b]100% more Battle Coins per battle.[/b] Additionally, you can pick up a [b]gift[/b] that contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]2.000 Battle Coins for the Shadow Protocol Battle Path[/p][/*][*][p]1.000 Battle Coins for the Rough Riders Battle Path[/p][/*][*][p]2 Battle Coin Boosters[/p][/*][*][p]3 Platinum Boosters[/p][/*][*][p]7 days of Premium Time[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Click on the link below to claim it![/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=gift"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you’ll enjoy this present and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: American Firepower
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]AbramsX Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]MPF Tier 10 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]KF41 Lynx Prototype Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Ajax Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Griffin 120mm Tier 8 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Bradley AAWS-H Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Stryker ADATS Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]M1A1 Storm Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Iron Crate[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between July 3 and July 10, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]AbramsX[/h2][p][/p][p]AbramsX is an advanced technology demonstrator. It was built as a private venture by General Dynamics Land Systems and unveiled in 2022 to show what the future of the Abrams MBT could look like. It is considerably lighter than a fully upgraded Abrams while retaining its protection levels and firepower thanks to its cutting edge systems. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-abramsx"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_378.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the AbramsX is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. While still maintaining the basic Abrams line features such as a 120mm gun, it is considerably lighter and less armored. On the other hand it is also faster, more agile, stealthier, and features a 30mm autocannon that can reduce most light vehicles to a pile of scrap in seconds thanks to its new ammunition. As a result, this tank can dish out a lot of damage but requires careful and skilled gameplay.[/p][p]The AbramsX Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]MPF Light Tank[/h2][p][/p][p]The General Dynamics Light Tank prototype is one of the contenders in the U.S. Mobile Protected Firepower program to replace the Stryker platform in the fire support role for the U.S. Airborne forces. It is one of very few modern Light Tanks in existence. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-mpf-light-tank"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/mpf_0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the MPF is a Tier 10 Premium Light Tank. Within its class, it’s one of the heaviest and the best protected specimen with its hull protected by NERA armor capable of absorbing damage in the initial stages of battle. With its powerful 120mm gun and decent mobility, it is a decent front-line fighter, holding its own even in the thickest of fighting.[/p][p]The MPF Tier 10 Premium LT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]KF41 Lynx Prototype[/h2][p][/p][p]This is a 2018 prototype of the KF41 Lynx, a cutting edge IFV developed by Rheinmetall for export. Featuring advanced modular armor and multiple gun configurations, the vehicle has already been adopted by Hungary with more contracts pending. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kf41-lynx-prototype"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/kf41lynxprototype_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the KF41 Lynx Prototype is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It is a durable and powerful IFV featuring two weapon configurations (30mm and 35mm) as well as a new infantry type that fires large thermobaric warheads from its anti-tank launchers.[/p][p]The KF41 Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Ajax[/h2][p][/p][p]The Ajax is the most modern British Infantry Fighting Vehicle currently in service. Despite being plagued by developmental problems, the program to replace the aging Warrior IFV produced one of the best vehicles in its class. You can read more about it in [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-ajax"][b]our dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/ajax_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Ajax is a Tier 10 Premium AFV featuring solid protection levels and excellent sustained firepower. Furthermore, it can deploy Mechanized Infantry like other AFVs of its class and has a special ability that allows it to better detect enemies at closer ranges.[/p][p]The Ajax Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Griffin 120mm[/h2][p][/p][p]The Armored Warfare version of the Griffin Light Tank is based on an early 2016 tech demonstrator, intended to show the U.S. military during the AUSA 2016 conference that General Dynamics meant business. It was built as a private venture; effectively a scaled-up example of General Dynamics was capable of providing when it came to highly mobile vehicles with a lot of firepower for the U.S. airborne forces. The U.S. Army was impressed and the design has since evolved into what is generally referred to as the MPF Light Tank. You can read more about this vehicle in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-griffin-120mm"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_29.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Griffin 120mm is a Tier 8 Premium Light Tank and a powerful, fast machine, armed not only with its 120mm cannon, but also with special ammunition types, making it deadly at any distance. Few Tier 9 vehicles can match its sheer ferocity on the battlefield.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Bradley AAWS-H[/h2][p][/p][p]The Bradley AAWS-H Tank Destroyer was an attempt by Loral Vought to mount four kinetic guided missiles on an extendable arm while using the Bradley IFV chassis as a platform. Kinetic missiles were cutting edge tech back in the 1980s – unlike standard ATGMs, they destroyed the target by their kinetic energy instead of a HEAT warhead, accelerating to several times the speed of sound. There was little to no defense against them, although they did have some drawbacks, which was why they were never adopted in real life. You can read more about the vehicle in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-bradley-aaws-h"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_39.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Bradley AAWS-H is a Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer. It’s an ATGM-based TD, carrying special kinetic missiles that actually become more effective with increasing distance to your target. It is the embodiment of a long-range missile carrier and is perfect for players who prefer sniping to close combat.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Stryker ADATS[/h2][p][/p][p]ADATS stands for “Air Defense Anti-Tank System,” describing its purpose very well. The system is intended to engage both air and ground armored targets. It was developed in the 1980s by a Swiss company called Oerlikon-Contraves and was offered as an interesting hybrid that would be able to deal with both Soviet tanks and helicopters or attack planes. Unfortunately for it, it came too late – only Canada would actually accept it in service and the end of the Cold War meant the end to all attempts at its large-scale introduction. The ADATS missiles were quite large but, more importantly, extremely fast and were certain to be extremely destructive to any Soviet armored targets, even though this thankfully never had to be tested in real combat. The ADATS turret was offered for a wide variety of platforms and was actively installed on a vehicle that is kind of like a cousin to the Stryker, the Canadian LAV-III. In this configuration, the vehicle was called MMEV.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_31.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, Stryker ADATS is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. It is a wheeled vehicle armed with two weapon systems – powerful long-range guided missiles and short-range unguided rockets, offering it some survivability in short range combat as well as the ability to deal tremendous damage if left to its devices.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]M1A1 Storm[/h2][p][/p][p]In 1985, the Abrams was upgraded with, amongst other things, the 120mm M256 smoothbore cannon. Over 5000 M1A1 tanks were produced until 1992. This tank participated in Operation Desert Storm, which forged its legendary reputation.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_2_28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the M1A1 Storm is a Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank. The M1A1 Storm look was inspired by Operation Desert Storm, including a gorgeous camouflage net model. But, more importantly, this tank is equipped with a massive frontal dozer blade, adding extra armor and ramming damage to the long list of its advantages.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Iron Crate[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve prepared for you an additional offer this week. The [b]Iron Crate[/b] is available in our Web Shop![/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_179_0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This crate allows you to win a Tier 4 to Tier 10 Premium vehicle (or its value in Gold if you have it already). The crate contains some very rare vehicles, including:[/p][list][*][p]ZTL-11 Tier 9 Premium TD[/p][/*][*][p]VN17 Tier 8 Premium AFV[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d2b40b932bec0945b91136a4a8d534037f586912.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Don't forget about our Socials![/h3][p]

notes.title: Of Issues (July 3)
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]On July 3, during the night (roughly between 3 AM and 9 AM CEST), [b]the game suffered from unexpected issues that led to a loss of data from this period of time.[/b] As a result, the accounts were reverted to the status from right before the issues arose.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/aw_bp14_diaryissue_04_1920x1080_0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]What this means is the following:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Progression vehicle acquisitions from the abovementioned period were rolled back, please feel free to purchase them again[/p][/*][*][p]Any progress accumulated during the abovementioned period as well as match results were lost[/p][/*][*][p]Regarding loot crates – if these were obtained before the issues arose and only opened during the issues, they were returned to your inventory. If the loot crates were obtained and opened during the issues, the data was lost and we cannot restore these crates[/p][/*][*][p]Regarding Operation Liberty, the data for mission completion during the issues was lost and we cannot restore it. However, today’s stage can still be completed until 2 AM (July 4) in order for it to count. The event unfortunately cannot be extended[/p][/*][*][p]Items purchased during the issues from Web Shop, Steam and other similar platforms were not delivered but we managed to recover the data. These items will be delivered to their owners in the near future (roughly the next day or two)[/p][/*][/list][p]The issues are now resolved and we would like to apologize for the inconvenience. And since it’s July 4 tomorrow, we’ll have a cool gift for you, including Battle Coins (for the current and the next Battle Path), boosters and Premium Time.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Namer and Skyranger
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Namer Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Lynx Skyranger Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between July 02, 2025 and July 08 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Namer[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The Namer IFV is an Israeli heavy fighting vehicle version of the Namer platform developed in the early 2000s from the Merkava Main Battle Tank. Israel is a small country and cannot affect high infantry losses, which is why the Namer features extremely high levels of protection. The IFV variant is fitted with a Rafael turret, featuring 30mm autocannon and a Spike missile launcher. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-namer"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_79.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Namer is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer. As its history suggests, it is a superheavy TD with its protection levels being amongst the highest of its class. It is slow and ponderous but its thick front can deflect even advanced shells while maintaining adequate firepower thanks to its autocannon and ATGM combination. Its MBT-like characteristics make this vehicle quite forgiving for new players, but, as they say, a jack-of-all-trades is a master of none.[/p][p]The Namer Tier 10 Premium TD is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Lynx Skyranger[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]This is a version of the cutting edge Lynx platform but instead of the standard IFV configuration, it utilizes the Skyranger HEL turret to create a short-range anti-aircraft vehicle that can also eliminate drone swarms with ease. This configuration was proposed for the recent Hungarian military upgrade program but never built in real life. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-lynx-skyranger"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/lynxskyranger_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Lynx Skyranger is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It’s best used as a scout killer but it is capable of other roles as well. It features three rather unusual abilities, such as the programmable HE ammunition that explodes above targets, the Starstreak missiles that deal more damages over larger distances and ignore APS, and the High Energy Laser active ability. When activated, the laser blinds enemy targets, significantly reducing their spotting range. You can learn more about these abilities from our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/developer-diary-lynx-skyranger-update"]developer diary.[/url][/b][/p][p]The Skyranger Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: BMT-72-140
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]BMT-72-140 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]TOS-1M Buratino Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Koshmar skin for TOS-1M[/p][/*][*][p]T-15 Kinzhal Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Leclerc T40 Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Otomatic Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Abrams AGDS Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Hunter Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]BMPT Mod.2017 Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Shadow Protocol Loot Crate[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between June 26 and July 3, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]BMT-72-140[/h2][p][/p][p]The BMT-72-140 is a prototype of a Ukrainian Main Battle Tank that is also capable of carrying infantry into battle, combining the advantages of both concepts. It consists of a heavily modified and lengthened T-72A hull and a T-72 turret fitted with an automatic loading mechanism and a 140mm gun called Bagheera. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-bmt-72-140"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/890d8b5645b3f58592ab7d76cdb0132fd8f57cda.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the BMT-72-140 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. It offers great performance in all things that matter as it has thick armor, active protection systems, good mobility and excellent firepower. It can also deploy all standard types of infantry to improve either its destructive abilities or to spot enemies earlier than other vehicles of its class.[/p][p]The BMT-72-140 is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]TOS-1M Buratino[/h2][p][/p][p]The TOS-1M Buratino is a prototype version of the Russian TOS-1/TOS-1A heavy rocket launcher. It was designed in 1997 at Omsk as an improvement to the old TOS-1 whose roots go back all the way to the Afghan War. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-tos-1m-buratino"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/tos-1m_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the TOS-1M Buratino is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer. As befits its massive rocket launcher installed on the top of a T-90A MBT chassis, its firepower is all but unparalleled and you are looking at perhaps the most destructive vehicle of Armored Warfare. It is available in two configurations – with fast-launching 122mm rockets and the iconic 220mm rockets that can be unlocked either by installing a skin (Koshmar), or by progressing through an active Battle Path.[/p][p]The TOS-1M is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Koshmar Bundle[/h2][p][/p][p]Additionally, we've prepared a skin bundle with a new skin. The skin “Koshmar” we have prepared for you is for the TOS-1M Tier 10 Premium TD. Not only is it cool looking, it also [b]unlocks the overprogression modules for you, including the 220mm turret and the 220mm thermobaric rockets.[/b] You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-tos-1m-koshmar"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/tos-1m_koshmar_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The skin is available as a part of the Koshmar Bundle, which contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Skin: TOS-1M Koshmar[/p][/*][*][p]3 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]T-15 Kinzhal[/h2][p][/p][p]This vehicle is a version of the T-15 heavy IFV (built on the Armata platform) but instead of the Bumerang turret featuring 30mm autocannon, it’s armed with another combat module called Kinzhal. The Kinzhal module’s main armament is long 57mm automatic cannon that can devastate even the heaviest IFVs it could meet on the battlefield. A prototype appeared in 2019 but the concept was not approved for mass production. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-t-15-kinzhal"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_t-15.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the T-15 Kinzhal is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer. Unlike the original progression version of the T-15, it’s a vehicle that relies heavily on its autocannon. The 57mm gun is immensely powerful and can fire in three round bursts with one of the highest damage per minute outputs in the game. In addition to its outstanding firepower, the Kinzhal is heavily armored and despite its average mobility, it’s one of the most durable and versatile vehicles in Armored Warfare.[/p][p]This vehicle is available via Loot Crates, which drop T-15 Kinzhal parts. Collect 100 T-15 Kinzhal parts from these Loot Crates to assemble the whole vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Leclerc T40[/h2][p][/p][p]Sometimes called the French Terminator, this vehicle was designed on the Leclerc MBT chassis with one purpose in mind – to accompany tanks and fight off infantry attacks the same way as the Russian BMPT series does. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-leclerc-t40"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/leclerc_t40_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Leclerc T40 is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. It offers you a combination of a durable hull, rapid-fire 40mm automatic cannon and, most importantly, the Javelin missile system. Simply right-click the target, wait until it becomes locket and fire the Javelin ATGM – it will home itself on the target, attacking its weak roof armor. Thanks to this ability, the Leclerc T40 is one of the most destructive vehicles in the game.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Otomatic[/h2][p][/p][p]The Otomatic was an attempt from the 1980s and 1990s to mate originally naval 76mm rapid-firing cannon with a tracked chassis (either of Palmaria or a Leopard) to create an advanced anti-aircraft gun. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-otomatic"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/otomatic_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Otomatic a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. Thanks to its fast-firing 76mm gun it can deal tremendous amounts of damage over short periods of time and can deal effectively with any target it encounters on the battlefield.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Abrams AGDS[/h2][p][/p][p]The Abrams AGDS (Armored Ground Defense System) was a vehicle concept and proposal, drafted in July 1996 by Dr. Asher H. Sharoni (a former colonel in the Israeli Defense Forces) and Lawrence D. Bacon from a Californian company called Western Design Howden. It was supposed to be an air-defense vehicle, protecting the Abrams formations against flying threats, although its weaponry can be deployed against ground targets as well. The United States were, at the time, sorely lacking a vehicle comparable to the Russian Shilka and one of the ideas was to use the Abrams chassis paired with a new turret to produce an armored AA gun that would be able to keep up with the American tank units. This plan was never realized and the vehicle stayed only on paper but you can play the Abrams AGDS in Armored Warfare and experience what it would have been like, had it ever been deployed.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/abrams_agds_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Abrams AGDS is a very unique Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. What makes it so special are its two large guided missile launchers capable of firing an incredibly devastating volley within seconds. The AGDS can devastate practically every opponent on the battlefield with a single salvo, making it one of the best and most effective mid-to-long range vehicles in the game. At close ranges, it can rely on excellent frontal turret protection and its two 35mm autocannons to keep enemies at bay until the missile launcher reloads to unleash another deadly swarm of missiles. The Abrams AGDS is one of the most feared vehicles in Armored Warfare![/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Hunter AFV[/h2][p][/p][p]Another alternative name for this vehicle is NGAFV (or Next Gen AFV), since it belongs to a whole program to replace the obsolete M113 APC in Singaporean service and to operate alongside its predecessor, another indigenous Singaporean IFV called Bionix. Hunter is the name of the production model of this program. The Hunter AFV is the pinnacle of bleeding edge of technology. In this sense, it can be compared to the AS21 Redback and both vehicles share several characteristics, not the least of which being relatively large size. This bulky IFV offers considerable levels of protection and firepower. It is expected to serve in the Singaporean army in large numbers in the near future with its mass-production having recently begun. You can read more about its history in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/singapores-sling"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/hunter_afv_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Hunter AFV is a Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. As its description above suggests, it is a rather standard-sized IFV with good levels of protection and excellent firepower (consisting of a 30mm autocannon and a Spike ATGM launcher). It also features a recently introduced type of armor, NERA. Simply put, NERA is an ablative armor kit that deteriorates whenever it gets hit. In other words, the vehicle starts with excellent protection levels but it will lose some with damage taken as the battle progresses. Apart from that, the vehicle is adequately mobile and quite universal. It can, of course, also deploy Mechanized Infantry.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]BMPT Mod.2017[/h2][p][/p][p]The BMPT Mod.2017 is one specific version of the BMPT Terminator that was deployed in 2017 in Syria for extended testing along with some other Russian prototype equipment, including the SU-57 jet fighter and the Uran-9 combat robot. It consists of a modified T-90 hull with a modernized turret from BMPT-72 installed on it. Another major difference was the presence of a new type of Explosive Reactive Armor that was made of soft fabric bags with explosive filler. You can read more about it in our [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-m1a1-storm-and-bmpt-mod2017"][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/bmpt_mod_2017_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the BMPT Mod. 2017 is a Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer and arguably the most powerful variant of the BMPT family. Like the others, it combines a tank hull with an unmanned turret, armed with two 30mm cannons as well as four missile launchers. Its thick armor and advanced ATGMs quickly made it one of the most feared vehicles of Tier 8 battlefields, a position it retains to this day.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Shadow Protocol Loot Crate[/h2][p][/p][p]The [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/shadow-protocol-battle-path-now-available"][b]Shadow Protocol[/b][/url] Loot Crate is now available. This Loot Crate contains Shadow Protocol Battle Coins and Boosters.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="pk7xVMRxZmg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Battle Coins[/b] are the primary currency of the Shadow Protocol Battle Path campaign and are used to progress through it and to obtain its prizes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle Coin Boosters[/b] are usable only during an active Battle Path and increase your Battle Coin income by 900 percent for two hours.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that you have to obtain the access to a Battle Path to use both items.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Rough Riders Battle Path: Improvements
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]In our previous articles, we have discussed the [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-info-and-preorder"][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/url] and its [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-economy"][b]economy[/b][/url] and other improvements, such as the [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/developer-diary-light-tank-changes"][b]upcoming buffs of the Light Tank class[/b][/url]. But we have also been gathering your feedback and today we’d like to tell you more about the improvements we are making to the upcoming event.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/dd1542c49fbbee061f50956a6be4a829c5351661.jpg"][/img][/p][p]First and foremost, we are adding a new vehicle prize to the event. [b]Griffin 120mm will be obtainable upon reaching Level 43.[/b] The Griffin 120mm Tier 8 Premium Light Tank is an excellent vehicle in its class and represents a powerful addition to your arsenal. It is a powerful, fast machine, armed not only with its 120mm cannon, but also with special ammunition types, making it deadly at any distance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/42cc1369e13399a7b4feddf2f56d075d9ba70a23.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And if you have it already? That’s right, that’s another item you will receive bonus Battle Coins for. Jut to recap, the Battle Path now contains the following vehicle prizes:[/p][list][*][p]ELKE Tier 7 Premium Light Tank (new)[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Ares Tier 8 Premium Light Tank (new)[/p][/*][*][p]XM1302 Tier 10 Premium Light Tank (new)[/p][/*][*][p]T92 ACAV Tier 2 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]M60A3 SLEP Tier 6 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Expeditionary LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Griffin 120mm Tier 8 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][/list][p]The other prizes such as skins will be unveiled soon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/abf17dd73288fa95645f58bac1e1160f9461d754.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3ff234c608b85835c487c9de58af4fa38a8a892c.jpg"][/img]Furthermore, we decided to make an [b]improvement to the Cavalry Blues camouflage.[/b] While blue by default, the camouflage will be able to change colors based on the base paint you use. Please note that the camouflage is pre-order exclusive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/fe9536c9ed2c9ecea954f2028515dca81046ddae.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/93d2fad23564c77e9b231b9056d5d375df6d2f86.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Next, we are [b]increasing the amount of Battle Coins available from completing Battle Path chain missions from 20000 to 35000.[/b][/p][p]As announced earlier, the missions will require Tier 3 to Tier 10 Light Tanks, so make sure you stock up on those – or you can earn them as you progress through the Battle Path.[/p][p]And last but definitely not least, we are [b]adding a large number of items to the Battle Path shop[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p]New MPF blueprints in the blueprint slot of the Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Commanders Seagrove and Grey make a return[/p][/*][*][p]13 new or returning vehicles (including Ajax, EMBT, Typhoon-VDV, XM2001 Crusader, M2020, VN20 and XK3)[/p][/*][*][p]18 new skins (including the Honey Badger, M1A3 Aces, T-14 with Nakidka, Koschei the Deathless and M10 Booker)[/p][/*][*][p]Over 50 new camouflages from the previous 5 Battle Paths[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Battle Path is now available for pre-order. The bundles are available in our Web Shop:[/b][/p][p][/p]
[url=https://arwar.co/3TeRle6][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Offer: Altay, Type 10
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Altay Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Type 10 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between June 24, 2025 and July 1, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]Altay[/h2][p][/p][p]The Altay is the result of a Turkish program to build a true indigenous MBT. After a decade of development with hundreds of millions of dollars spent, Turkey finally achieved its goal and built a tank that is roughly on par in performance with decades-old Leopard 2 variants while it still uses many foreign components, including some of its most critical systems. Nevertheless, future Altay variants are expected to feature some cutting edge components.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="-8zFMkJTESs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Altay is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank based on the current prototypes, but also upgraded by various hypothetical aftermarket components of the future to surpass its current capabilities and to match its assigned Tier in power. The basic tank is – gameplay-wise – a mobile sniper, much like the Leopard 2 series, relying on its mobility and the penetration of its shells rather than on its armor. There are two key features to this tank: Adjustable Suspension (tilting forward and to the side) and Hybrid Engine with its distinctive electric sound, giving the vehicle excellent mobility and agility.[/p][p]The Altay Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Type 10[/h2][p][/p][p]The Type 10 MBT is the most modern Japanese Main Battle Tank in service and one of the most advanced war machines in the world. Using sophisticated electronics and crystalline steel armor, this tank is more than a match for any enemy that would threaten the islands of Japan. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-type-10-hitomaru"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_55.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Type 10 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. What puts it apart from the other MBTs of its Tier is its special NERA armor. This highly-mobile MBT starts every battle well-armored, but the protection levels decrease with every shot taken. Additionally, this MBT features a special system that tells you the exact chance to penetrate your target. Overall, it’s one of the most powerful MBTs of its Tier and certainly a good choice for players, who prefer rapid action to slow advances.[/p][p]The Type 10 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]
