notes.title: Offer: EMBT, Panzer 87-140, Battle Coins
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]EMBT Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Panzer 87-140 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Shadow Protocol Battle Coins[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between June 19, 2025 and June 26, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]EMBT[/h2][p][/p][p]The Enhanced Main Battle Tank (EMBT) is a future MBT demonstrator developed over the course of several years as cooperation between the Germany (KMW) and the French (Nexter). It features a heavily modified Leopard 2 hull with a brand-new turret unveiled in 2022 during the Eurosatory 2022 expo in Paris. Our version of the tank is armed with 140mm ASCALON gun. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-embt"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/embt_1920x1080.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the EMBT is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Extreme accuracy and firepower are its domain as it features an incredibly powerful 140mm gun and a special ability called Machine Learning that increases the kinetic round penetration with each shot (up to three times). In its medium range support vehicle role, this tank has few equals thanks to the abovementioned ability and the availability of top-attack HEAT rounds.[/p][p]The EMBT Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Panzer 87-140[/h2][p][/p][p]The Panzer 87-140 is an experimental version of Panzer 87 (Swiss Leopard 2A4), fitted with a RUAG 140mm smoothbore cannon and an armor kit called WE. It was developed in the 1980s and early 1990s to counter the next generation of Soviet MBTs, but with the collapse of the Soviet Union, the project was shelved, only to resurface around 2005-2006 but never passing the experimental stage. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-panzer-87-140"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_8_1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Panzer 87-140 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Much like other Leopard series MBTs, it’s a long-range fighter with an extremely powerful gun and the ability to fire with pinpoint accuracy. Even though its armor leaves much to be desired, at long range, this MBT has few equals and can be considered one of the best snipers of its class.[/p][p]The Panzer 87-140 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Shadow Protocol Battle Coins[/h2][p][/p][p]This week, we are offering you an opportunity to [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/shadow-protocol-battle-path-now-available"]boost your Battle Path[/url][/b] progress and get that main prize you know you want – the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-knifv-nlos-lps"]KNIFV NLOS LPS Tier 10 Premium TD![/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="pk7xVMRxZmg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The following Battle Coin bundles are available:[/p][list][*][p]1.000 Battle Coins (10% off)[/p][/*][*][p]5.000 Battle Coins (20% off)[/p][/*][*][p]10.000 Battle Coins (30% off)[/p][/*][*][p]25.000 Battle Coins (40% off)[/p][/*][*][p]50.000 Battle Coins (50% off)[/p][/*][/list][p]Battle Coins can be used for a number of things, including:[/p][list][*][p]Force-completing Battle Path missions[/p][/*][*][p]Progressing through Battle Path levels[/p][/*][*][p]Purchasing the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-787-gadyuka"]Gadyuka blueprints from the Shop[/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Please note:[/b] In order to use Battle Coins, you need to obtain the access to the Shadow Protocol Battle Path.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bp"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy this offer and, as usual:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Developer Diary: Light Tank Changes
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]As you already know, the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-info-and-preorder"]Rough Riders Battle Path[/url][/b] is coming in July and the main topic of it will be the history of armored cavalry – or, in game terms, Light Tanks. Upon reviewing the performance of the entire class, we discovered that while some of them are performing adequately or even very well (MPF comes to mind), some others are in serious need of improvements. Today, we’ll tell you more about them.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/0.19main_img_4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]At this moment, we are working on the following changes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Tier 1[/b] PT-85: Improved HEAT damage and penetration (440mm, 310 damage) and reduced reload time from 4.68s to 4s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 2[/b] T92 (and T92 ACAV): Improved camouflage from 25% to 30% and reduced reload time from 3 to 2.6s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 3[/b] Scorpion: Improved camouflage from 25% to 30%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 4[/b] Scorpion 90: Improved camouflage from 25% to 30%, viewrange increased from 340m to 440m, improved AP shell damage and penetration (550mm, 290 damage), improved AP shell damage and penetration (605mm, 390 damage)[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that the Scorpion 90 shell adjustments will also be made to LAV-300 as it uses the same shells. Let’s continue:[/p][list][*][p][b]Tier 5[/b] M551 Sheridan: Increased its mobility by improving acceleration (2.8s and 11s respectively) and hull traverse (63 deg/s)[/p][/*][/list][p]Begleitpanzer 57 is performing very well for its Tier and does not need any buffs.[/p][list][*][p][b]Tier 6[/b] RDF/LT: The gun is manually loaded on this model so the vehicle will receive a loader.[/p][/*][/list][p]In fact, the [b]RDF/LT[/b] (which is obtainable as a prize from the Rough Riders Battle Path) is received a larger number of buffs, so let’s take a closer look at thus vehicle. The following changes will be taking place:[/p][list][*][p]Improved camouflage from 25% to 30%[/p][/*][*][p]M464 AP shell penetration increased from 550mm to 575mm[/p][/*][*][p]M464 AP shell damage increased from 260 to 290[/p][/*][*][p]T70E3 HESH shell damage increased from 230 to 260[/p][/*][*][p]0 to 32 km/h acceleration improved to 1.65s[/p][/*][*][p]0 to max acceleration improved to 11s[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum speed increased to 90 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum reverse increased to 40 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]Hull traverse rate increased to 77.49 deg/s[/p][/*][/list][p]Moving on to other Tier 6 Light Tanks:[/p][list][*][p][b]Tier 6[/b] Expeditionary Tank: Viewrange increased from 410m to 420m[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 6[/b] Stingray 1: Reload time within magazine improved from 3 to 2.7s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 6[/b] VFM 5: Vehicle now has a 7-round magazine with 2.7s between shots within and 20s full magazine reload (partial reload is possible), we have also gave the vehicle a new HE shell with 55mm of penetration and 690 damage[/p][/*][/list][p]On Tier 7, CV90105 TML requires no buffs as it is performing fairly well. The same can be said of Stingray 2, therefore:[/p][list][*][p][b]Tier 7[/b] TAM 2IP: Increased hitpoints from 2200 to 2400, improved camouflage from 25% to 30%, improved viewrange from 430m to 440m and improved acceleration (3.53s and 15.39s respectively)[/p][/*][/list][p]Coming up on Tier 8, most Light Tanks perform fairly well. Harimau, Griffin 120mm and Leopard Cockerill do not need any improvements. Did we mention we’d be adding Griffin 120mm to the Rough Riders prize pool? Because we will, but more on that later. For now, there are three tanks that need to be addressed here. First is the [b]ASCOD:[/b][/p][p]This vehicle has two turrets – a manned one and an unmanned one.[/p][list][*][p]We removed the Ready Rack mechanism from the manned one and set the regular reload time to 3.5s[/p][/*][*][p]The unmanned turret reload time within its magazine was improved from 4s to 2s[/p][/*][/list][p]And now, the bigger stuff. [b]Dragun 125[/b] is getting a larger set of changes, including:[/p][list][*][p]Improved camouflage from 20% to 25%[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum speed increased to 75 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]Reload time improvement from 5.14s to 4.9s[/p][/*][*][p]Viewrange improvement from 430m to 440m[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle received a new Invar-M tandem HEAT ATGM with 1050mm of penetration and 770 damage[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle received a new 3UBK14F1 thermobaric ATGM with 80mm of penetration and 1000 damage[/p][/*][/list][p]And [b]M8-105 Buford[/b] is receiving the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]Reload time improvement from 3.74s to 3.5s[/p][/*][*][p]Increased hitpoints from 2500 to 2750[/p][/*][*][p]Viewrange improvement from 430m to 450m[/p][/*][*][p]HEAT round M152/6 now offers 810mm penetration and 610 damage[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new transmission module adding 2.5% bonus to acceleration 10% bonus to hull traverse[/p][/*][/list][p]On Tier 9, CV90120T Ghost is performing well enough, as are ZTQ-15 and Anders. Remaining are the VT-5 and M8-120 Thunderbolt II. The [b]VT-5[/b] is receiving the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]Increased the BTA2 APFSDS shell penetration to 740mm (ZTL-11 uses similar shell, there it is increased to 800mm)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new HE shell, DTB2 from ZTL-11[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of ammo carried from 54 to 66[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of APS charges to 12[/p][/*][/list][p]The [b]M8-120 Thunderbolt[/b] (and its Hades version) is receiving the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]0 to 32 km/h acceleration improved from 3.93s to 3.5s[/p][/*][*][p]0 to max acceleration improved to 17s[/p][/*][*][p]Increased hitpoints from 2650 to 2800[/p][/*][*][p]Reload time improvement from 4.21s to 4s[/p][/*][*][p]Viewrange improvement from 430m to 440m[/p][/*][/list][p]And, last but not least, there’s the highest Tier. On Tier 10 there are only three Light Tanks (as of now) and two of the three perform really well – especially the MPF. The [b]K21 XC-8[/b] is getting the following buffs:[/p][list][*][p]Increased hitpoints from 2650 to 2900[/p][/*][*][p]Reload time improvement from 3.53s to 2.7s[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of APS charges to 8[/p][/*][/list][p]And that’s it. There are several more buffs we are working on, but those are not related directly to Light Tanks. From American vehicles, the T249 Vigilante will receive a different Gatling gun mechanic (similar to the M48 GAU-8) along with a shell penetration buff, some improvements to Shilka (mostly penetration) and VCAC Mephisto (increasing the amount of missiles carried and some reload times), all based on your feedback.[/p][p]We hope that you’ll enjoy the changes and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Kornet-D1, Object 195 and Object 490
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Object 490 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Object 195 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Kornet-D1 Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between June 17 and June 24, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]Object 490[/h2][p][/p][p]The Object 490 Main Battle Tank was an advanced concept from the waning days of the Soviet Union. Designed in the 1980s, it represented a radical departure from the MBT paradigm. Its distinct wedge-like shape, along with the fact that the crew was located in the back, offered unparalleled levels of protection. But the most interesting part of the design was its double suspension paired with two engines, allowing the vehicle to stay mobile even after suffering significant damage. However, the conclusion of the Cold War put an end to this design, along with many other advanced Soviet projects. You can learn more about this vehicle in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-490"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/object490_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Object 490 Tier 10 Premium MBT is perhaps the best armored vehicle in the game. It’s a true behemoth that is almost impossible to slow down, let alone knock out, and concentrated effort is required to stop one of these things when encountering them on the battlefield. The combination of extremely thick armor and a powerful 152mm gun makes this tank incredibly deadly, even though these advantages are balanced by its mediocre agility and the fact that its gun is only forward facing. This MBT is ideal for you if you prefer slow, methodical advances while dealing massive amounts of damage with each shot. If you keep your flanks secure, you’ll be all but impossible to stop.[/p][p]The Object 490 MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Object 195[/h2][p][/p][p]The Object 195 Main Battle Tank is one of the 1980s Soviet supertanks, intended to fight the next generation of NATO MBTs. It was developed in Nizhny Tagil by the experienced Uralvagonzavod design bureau (UKBTM), which was responsible for such legendary tanks as the T-72 and T-90. Much like other such prototypes, it was designed to be armed with massive 152mm smoothbore cannon in an unmanned turret. A single prototype was built and it allegedly passed state trials between 2008 and 2010 but the project was discontinued due to a lack of financing. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-195"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/object195_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Object 195 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank and one of the most versatile vehicles you can get your hands on thanks to a combination of excellent armor, unmanned turret, 152mm hard-hitting gun and one special feature – the coaxial 30mm autocannon that allows you to take out unarmored targets without having to waste a shot of your main weapon.[/p][p]The Object 195 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Kornet-D1[/h2][p][/p][p]The Kornet-D1 Tank Destroyer was one of the proposed variants for the BMD-4M chassis. As a dedicated tank hunter, it was supposed to be armed with two Kornet ATGM quad launchers, providing the Russian Airborne forces with long-range tank-killing capabilities. The project was launched in 2013 but the vehicle never reached the prototype stage with the program likely being canceled in 2018. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kornet-d1"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_58.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Kornet-D1 is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer and a tracked counterpart to the wheeled Kornet-EM progression vehicle. It is only lightly armed but also very stealthy and its lack of vision range is compensated by the ability to deploy a Sniper. Additionally, when configured properly, the vehicle is capable of launching two missiles at once, making it incredibly deadly against any target, especially at long ranges.[/p][p]This vehicle is available via Loot Crates, which drop Kornet-D1 parts. Collect 100 Kornet-D1 parts from these Loot Crates to assemble the whole vehicle.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Rough Riders Battle Path: Economy
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]During our recent launch of the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-info-and-preorder"]Rough Riders Battle Path pre-order[/url][/b], many questions were raised about the Battle Path’s requirements that we’d like to summarily address in this article.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/61acf638d4c02451933f3bb9153fb641beb25884.png"][/img][/p][p]Right off the bat, let’s look at the economy. We did several things differently compared to the previous Battle Paths.[/p][list][*][p]We [b]shifted the focus back from missions to the main progression[/b], thus increasing the prices of later Battle Path levels[/p][/*][*][p]In addition to providing a large number of new prizes like in earlier Battle Paths, we also [b]added a number of existing assets[/b] to the level progression, for which existing players are compensated (some of them are available even new through the Battle Path shop for example and, in this sense, can be considered a Battle Coin transfer to the new Battle Path)[/p][/*][*][p]We [b]repurposed the missions[/b] – instead of being objectives by themselves with their separate rewards, they now serve to provide players with more Battle Coins[/p][/*][/list][p]Overall, the economy looks as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Chain missions (which will require Light Tanks in various Tier brackets) will provide [b]bonus 20.000 Battle Coins[/b] and have been tuned to become easier to complete[/p][/*][*][p]Compensations for existing items will [b]reach up to 65.000 Battle Coins[/b] with each existing asset offering 1.500 Battle Coins as a compensation – the amount was tuned based on the number of extra items added to the Battle Path (with Commander Diaz getting a special high compensation prize)[/p][/*][*][p]Another free event (much like Operation Liberty) will launch during the Rough Riders Battle Path to provide [b]extra Battle Coins[/b] and many extra boosters[/p][/*][*][p]At the same time, the total cost of passing the entire Rough Riders main content from Level 1 to Level 50 [b]increased by 75.000 Battle Coins[/b]. Please note that this by itself is nowhere near new or unprecedented as, even without overprogression, some previous Battle Paths had even higher requirements[/p][/*][/list][p]As a result, for players who own some of the American items provided in this Battle Path, the progression may even be easier than the current Battle Path.[/p][p]A separate issue is that of the entry price. We understand that this is a sensitive topic for many of you, especially with what’s going on in the industry right now. It has been a difficult decision for us as well, but we would love to win you over with the [b]Battle Path content we will highlight in the future[/b], such as:[/p][list][*][p]New skins and prizes[/p][/*][*][p]New gameplay features of the vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Light tank buffs – and not just the reward ones featured in Rough Riders, of course[/p][/*][*][p]The yet-unannounced system partially tied to the XM1302[/p][/*][/list][p]We will post more about these before the launch of the event itself so that you can see for yourselves whether what we have prepared for you is worth your time.[/p][p]And, last but definitely not least, we’d like to thank you for all your feedback as well as your continued support that inspires us to continue working on this game even a decade after its launch. It means a lot for us to see you submit even the harshest of criticisms because, at the end of the day, the opposite of support isn’t hate – it’s indifference, and you show us every day how much you care. We will do our best not to disappoint.[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Eastern Vehicles
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]June Gift and Bonus[/p][/*][*][p]T-90M Proryv Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Typhoon-VDV Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Armata 152 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Boyevaya Podruga skin for T-14 Armata[/p][/*][*][p]Defender skin for T-80UM-1 Bars[/p][/*][*][p]Spetsnaz skin for BMP-1P[/p][/*][*][p]Kurganets-25 Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Msta-S Tier 9 Premium Self-Propelled Gun[/p][/*][*][p]Khrizantema-S Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Object 787 Gadyuka Tier 6 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][*][p]Pile of Gold Loot Crate[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between June 11 and June 19, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]June Gift and Bonus[/h2][p][/p][p]This week we have prepared a special treat for you. Aside from [b]100% bonus to Battle Coin income[/b] (available until June 15), we also have a gift for you.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/key_art_2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This gift contains two decals, a camouflage, 2 Battle Path boosters and 3 Platinum Loot Crates. Please note that one of the decals and the camouflage were issued before, in which case you will not receive them again.[/p][p][b]Click on the link below to claim it![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]T-90M Proryv[/h2][p][/p][p]The T-90M Proryv the most advanced Russian Main Battle Tank currently in service and the ultimate step in a long journey that began with the T-72. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-t-90m-proryv"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/54ff3c74e65197d8baecb4688b7c8160d706553a.png"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the T-90M Proryv is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. With its solid firepower, excellent armor and decent mobility, this vehicle is suitable for all players, including fairly new ones. No matter what tactic you choose, the T-90M will not let you down as it is one of the most versatile MBTs in the entire game.[/p][p]The T-90M is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Typhoon-VDV[/h2][p][/p][p]The Typhoon-VDV is a modern Russian reconnaissance and special use vehicle. It is perhaps the best-armed version of the Typhoon platform, featuring a Spitsa turret. Several vehicles of this type have been built and are currently in use by the Russian military. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-typhoon-vdv"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d2a462d28d30e067f75de44361a88fbdc66d47c7.png"][/img]In Armored Warfare, the Typhoon-VDV is a Tier 10 Premium AFV. It is a powerful vehicle on its own, featuring high firepower in the form of 30mm autocannon and an ATGM launcher with two tubes loaded with thermobaric missiles that can be launched both at once. Its task on the battlefield is supporting other scout vehicles by increasing their spotting capabilities thanks to a new active ability.[/p][p]The Typhoon-VDV Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Armata 152[/h2][p][/p][p]The Armata 152 is a version of the T-14 Armata, armed with larger cannon. One of the upgrades considered for the T-14 Armata was the increase of its caliber to 152mm in order to absolutely, positively destroy anything with the first shot. The 2A83 smoothbore is a behemoth of a gun, designed in the last days of the Soviet empire for the next generation of super-tanks. It’s massive, heavy and quite costly to produce, but, most importantly, it was never truly needed to deal with the western MBTs since the standard 125mm guns were (and still are) up to the task. That is why it never found its way on any Soviet MBT with even the standard T-14 Armata being armed with an improved 125mm cannon. You can, however, experience its awesome firepower in Armored Warfare! Learn more about it in a [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/overkill-152mm-cannons-russian-mbts"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/543121b5b57b3b962c6ed51ec05accf900f10fb3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the T-14 Armata 152 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. While not firing as fast as its 125mm counterpart, the 152mm rounds do enormous damage, often eliminating weaker opponents with a single shot. And then there’s the platform itself – the Armata, the most modern Main Battle Tank in the world. Earn it and use it to dominate![/p][p]The Armata 152 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Boyevaya Podruga Bundle (T-14 Armata)[/h2][p][/p][p]The Boyevaya Podruga skin for the T-14 Armata Tier 10 Main Battle Tank is modeled after a famous Soviet WW2 tank, commanded by Mariya Oktyabrskaya. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-second-world-war"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c046b3f69cf59bbb46d80196292fdaa400d1ea03.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The skin is available as a part of the Boyevaya Podruga bundle, which contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Skin: Boyevaya Podruga for T-14 Armata[/p][/*][*][p]8 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Defender Bundle (T-80UM-1)[/h2][p][/p][p]This skin for the T-80UM-1 Tier 8 MBT is based on the camouflage and markings as seen in 2006 on a T-80U in Kubinka. You can read more about it in a [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-t-80um-1-defender"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/84fc2eb5327ce4365f42ec7060634caf9a940c32.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We are offering the Defender skin in a bundle, which includes:[/p][list][*][p]Defender skin for the T-80UM-1 MBT[/p][/*][*][p]3 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]BMP-1P Spetsnaz Skin[/h2][p][/p][p]The skin for the BMP-1P Tier 4 AFV is based on a BMP-1 belonging to the 101st Special Operations Brigade of the Internal Troops of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation, as seen during the Battle of Grozny in 1996. You can read more in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-bmp-1p-spetsnaz"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b4814a423bb2b5854121af568d8ce8f992a26406.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The skin is available as a part of the Spetsnaz Bundle, which contains the following items:[/p][list][*][p]Skin: Spetsnaz[/p][/*][*][p]Russian (Interior Forces) camouflage[/p][/*][*][p]3 Platinum Loot Crates[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Kurganets-25[/h2][p][/p][p]The Kurganets-25 Infantry Fighting Vehicle is intended as a cutting edge future replacement to the old BMP series in Russian service. While not as chunky and expensive as the T-15 Armata super-heavy IFV, it’s designed to finally offer the 21st century protection levels the Russian military has been demanding for a long time. However, the design turned out to be quite expensive and while it is currently undergoing state trials, it is unlikely to be ever mass-produced. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kurganets-25"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/kurganets-25_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Kurganets-25 is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. Even though it offers decent protection and mobility for its class, this vehicle is all about firepower. To make sure you always have the right tool for the job, it comes with three distinctive weapon systems – a 57mm autocannon for light targets, fast and small Bulat missiles for highly mobile targets and, finally, full-sized ATGMs that can defeat pretty much anything on the battlefield. If dealing damage is your thing, few vehicles will match your playstyle better.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Msta-S[/h2][p][/p][p]The Msta-S SPG was developed as a replacement to the older 2S3 Akatsiya. The goal was to match (or surpass) the newly developed NATO artillery pieces with long 155mm guns. The production began in 1988 and is currently ongoing with a modernized variant rolling out for the Russian military. More than 500 Msta-S SPGs are still in Russian service and dozens were exported to several other countries. It has seen some combat during the Second Chechen War and the War in Donbass. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-msta-s"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/msta-s_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Msta-S is a Tier 9 Self-Propelled Gun, which makes it only usable in the Global Operations mode and in PvE. It comes with two shell types – a slow-flying one with a high flight arc, and a fast-flying one for use against more mobile targets.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Khrizantema-S[/h2][p][/p][p]The Khrizantema-S is a dedicated tank hunter, built on a modified BMP-3 hull. The first Khrizantema-S prototype appeared in public as early as 1996 with the initial production variant (9P157) entering service in 2005. Around 2010, an upgraded variant called 9P157-2 appeared with a modernized Ukrainian optics system and a hull machinegun the original model lacked. This variant was in use until 2017. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-khrizantema-s"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/khrizantema-s_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Khizantema-S is a Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer. It is quite a stealthy vehicle armed with a twin ATGM launcher. The key to achieving excellent results with this machine is long-range ATGM sniping followed by rapid relocation. The missiles are quite powerful and make hits easy thanks to their excellent performance.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Gadyuka[/h2][p][/p][p]The Gadyuka (“Viper”) is a Soviet-era fire support vehicle consisting of a T-72A hull and turret but instead of the main gun, the vehicle is armed with two 30mm autocannons and two rocket pods in order to perform better against infantry in urban and mountainous environments. A single prototype was built in 1996 and even though the project was cancelled, it eventually led to the rise of the BMPT Terminator series. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-787-gadyuka"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/object_787_gadyuka_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Gadyuka is a Tier 6 Premium Tank Destroyer. Despite having only average protection, its two 30mm autocannons can, along with deadly rocket salvos, rip through enemy vehicles with ease. Indeed, the Gadyuka is one of the most destructive vehicles of its Tier and a worthy addition to every player’s arsenal.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Pile of Gold[/h2][p][/p][p]We also have the [b]Pile of Gold[/b] Loot Crate for you. This Loot Crate contains copious amounts of Gold for you to win.[/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/814_234_0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This Loot Crate includes:[/p][list][*][p]250.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]100.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]50.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]10.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]5.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]1.000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]500 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]100 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy this offer and, as usual:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Now Available: Operation Liberty
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]We’ve prepared another event for you to participate in this June and July in order to earn bonus Battle Coins as well as other prizes. The theme of the event is the USA and France.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6ab8956e20d903f87a89e5ec13285ffea0d53603.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You’ll be earning American- and French-themed prizes, including two legendary skins:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-abramsx-reaver"][b]Reaver for AbramsX[/b][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-leclerc-t40-concorde"][b]Concorde for Leclerc T40[/b][/url][/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, the event contains AbramsX crates (effectively a discount), two new camouflages and new decals. Its rules are, once again, very simple. You can participate simply by destroying 5 enemy vehicles in PvE (or 1 in PvP) every day (while driving a Tier 3 vehicle or higher) in order to receive a reward.[/p][p][b]Please note:[/b][/p][list][*][p]This event may run concurrently with other events and is available to all players[/p][/*][*][p]You may only complete one objective per day[/p][/*][*][p]The event starts on June 11, 2025 and ends on July 16, 2025[/p][/*][/list][p][b]We hope that you will enjoy this event and will see you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Rough Riders Battle Path: Info and Preorder
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]Today, we’d like to tell you more about the upcoming [b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b] campaign as a whole along with the changes and improvements we’ve prepared for you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/61acf638d4c02451933f3bb9153fb641beb25884.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Preorder[/h2][p][/p][p]You can now secure the access to the Battle Path early (and with preorder-exclusive items) in the Web Shop “Battle Path” section. The following bundles are available:[/p][list][*][p]Rough Riders access with the Cavalry Blues camouflage and the Modern Cavalryman player avatar[/p][/*][*][p]Rough Riders access with 50.000 Battle Coins, the Cavalry Blues camouflage and the Modern Cavalryman player avatar[/p][/*][*][p]Rough Riders access with 10 Battle Coin boosters, the Cavalry Blues camouflage and the Modern Cavalryman player avatar[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Please note that the access price in Gold will increase from 3.999 Gold to 5.999 Gold at the launch of the event. However, the compensation for receiving the access multiple times remains 3.999 Gold for all such cases.[/b][/p][p]The camouflage gives your vehicle a subtle rusty, worn-look only acquired by long years of service. If you’re not into flamboyant patterns, this is the right camouflage for you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/9e705f039d8e14346ca0097c4f0d669aa09ea30e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For more details about the Rough Riders Battle Path, please read below.[/p][p][b]The bundles are available in our Web Shop:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Rough Riders[/h2][p][/p][p]The Rough Riders Battle Path is focused on U.S. cavalry, from its humble beginnings in the Revolutionary War, the Civil War, the Rough Riders era of the late 19th century and both world wars to its transformation to the Armored Cavalry branch after the Vietnam War. The rewards will therefore be theme-appropriate, but there’s also a different theme at play here.[/p][p]There will be 50 levels of waiting for you as usual. Let’s start with the vehicles:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-elke"][b]ELKE[/b][/url] Tier 7 Premium LT for reaching Level 20 (featuring an elevated weapons station allowing you to ambush your enemies with ease)[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-rdflt-ares"][b]RDF/LT Ares[/b][/url] Tier 8 Premium LT for reaching Level 35 (featuring powerful missile launchers as well as 75mm gun)[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xm1302"][b]XM1302[/b][/url] Tier 10 Premium LT for reaching Level 50 (featuring new “Mitigation” passive ability – the faster you go, the less damage you take)[/p][/*][/list][p]There will of course be new epic skins based on real-life vehicles, such as:[/p][list][*][p]M60A3 “Crustacean” for the M60A3[/p][/*][*][p]M3A2 Cavalry Vehicle for the M2 Bradley[/p][/*][*][p]IPM1 “Danger Zone” for the M1 Abrams[/p][/*][/list][p]Each comes with its unique story of U.S. service. New camouflages, decals and base paints will also come with this Battle Path.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/eaa740391fa5fed162963ad8ba917c3570389467.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]However, there’s also a major change that’s new with this Battle Path because it will allow you to [b]earn previously released content as well as new.[/b][/p][p]This content includes several new Premium vehicles, epic American skins and more. Here are a few examples of items you will also earn:[/p][list][*][p]T92 ACAV Tier 2 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]M60A3 SLEP Tier 6 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Expeditionary LT Tier 8 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Full set of Prime skins[/p][/*][*][p]Freedom Rider skin[/p][/*][*][p]Ridgway skin for M8-120[/p][/*][*][p]Rough Rider skin for M60A3 SLEP[/p][/*][*][p]Gunslinger skin for the T249 Vigilante[/p][/*][*][p]Full set of MERDCS camouflages[/p][/*][*][p]Reforger 83 camouflages[/p][/*][*][p]Skins for the reward Light Tanks mentioned above (such as Acid and Reaper)[/p][/*][/list][p]And much more. And if you are worried about the performance of your new Light Tanks – don’t be. They will be receive a [b]comprehensible buff[/b] along with the release of the Battle Path. If you own any of these rewards already, you’ll receive Battle Coins instead, making your progression through the Battle Path faster.[/p][p]But that is still not all. After all, what would a Battle Path be without a commander? [b]Commander Anthony Diaz[/b] will be making an appearance after nearly a decade of exile. You may have forgotten him but he has not forgotten you! This rugged commander has a set of versatile skills that make him suitable for a lot of vehicles.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6196451db7d883aa345f66e8769f18d3aaeeef09.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There are a few players who acquired his services in the past. To recognize their long service, these players will be rewarded with a lot of Battle Coins if they own Anthony Diaz.[/p][p][/p][h2]What else is new?[/h2][p][/p][p]The missions have been overhauled once again. This time, the missions will require Light Tanks, so better stock up on those – or use those you acquire from the Battle Path, they should perform fine in their new upgraded forms. Instead of high-stakes challenges, the missions have become a source of additional Battle Path boosters, Battle Coins and other goodies (and are therefore easier to complete than before).[/p][p]And, last but not least, we have added a couple of things to the Battle Path shop as usual – for the standardized prizes, of course. The rest of the Battle Path remains mostly the same. The Battle Path is currently planned to launch in the second half of July but, as usual, the specific date will be announced a bit later. We hope you’ll enjoy this Battle Path as much as we enjoyed designing it and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: In Development: XM1302
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]With the information of the first two Rough Riders Battle Path vehicles (ELKE, RDF/LT Ares) out in the open, it’s time to take a look at the final prize of the event, the [b]XM1302 Light Tank.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/19465d44e8fad9a927377ec2b8ac9fe8567f0ea7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But, as usual, a little history first.[/p][p]The XM1302 Light Tank prototype was developed by BAE to participate in the Mobile Protected Firepower (MPF) program, which was a U.S. Army program to replace the aging Stryker platform. U.S. Airborne forces needed a highly mobile fire support platform, which effectively called for a reincarnation of the old Light Tank concept that had ended in active service with the M551 Sheridan.[/p][p]Two companies answered the call – BAE Land Systems with its prototype based on the old M8 Thunderbolt II Light Tank, and General Dynamics with a Light Tank based on the Griffin demonstrator. The first was the XM1302. The first iteration of this final incarnation of the M8 appeared in 2015 and was gradually upgraded until the launch of the MPF program in 2019. Twelve prototypes were in February 2021 and were thoroughly tested that year but, despite showing some quality, BAE was disqualified from the program in March 2022. Some say that the game was rigged from the start in GDLS's favor but regardless of how things went down, that was the end of XM1302.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/12b5e99b3d48f2efef1c4dcafec20d81277986ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The fate of all prototypes is unknown but at least one ended up in the U.S. Army Armor & Cavalry Collection museum in Fort Moore. The winning proposal by GDLS was renamed to M10C Booker and went on to be initially approved for mass production, only to be unceremoniously cancelled in 2025, once again leaving the U.S. Army without a highly mobile Light Tank the third or fourth time around. Time really is a flat circle.[/p][p][b]In Armored Warfare, the XM1302 will become a Tier 10 Premium Light Tank and the third and final new vehicle prize of the Rough Riders Battle Path.[/b][/p][p]Those of you familiar Armored Warfare’s many vehicles will likely immediately draw comparison to the MPF. That’s right; the current MPF Tier 10 Premium Light Tank was the competing project that became the M10C Booker. However, while meeting the same requirements and therefore being similar to one another in real life, these vehicles couldn’t be different in the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/cef001d4b0a9a8481059d5bb9e08c4b63310f2c1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The MPF in the game is one of the heaviest Light Tanks around and is protected by layers of NERA. The XM1302 is effectively the opposite. We modeled the basic configuration without additional armor (which can be seen on most photos) and, instead of protection, we made it about speed.[/p][p]But let’s get the armor out of the way first. The vehicle has basic armor and that’s about it. Its protection lies in its special ability (described below), mobility, and the Iron Fist active protection system mounted on its turret with the Supercharged APS ability available. The APS, while not present on the real-life prototype, is quite realistic as it could be found on earlier BAE prototypes). The smoke grenade launcher is also improved compared to other vehicles of its class.[/p][p]The main weapon is the 105mm M35 soft recoil cannon that can be found on the XM8. The main difference is its ability to deal a lot of damage in a short period of time thanks to it having a large magazine and a very high rate of fire when it’s loaded. Granted, you won’t be penetrating most MBTs in their upper frontal plate, but that’s not how you are intended to play anyway. The gun will also offer excellent depression and elevation angles (-13/+20) so the vehicle will be easy and convenient to use.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/fc0de564f600f3b254ee1884e0442ef5f1975d6f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But the main point is its mobility. The XM1302 will be very fast and agile – that’s a given as its lack of armor needs to be compensated somehow. However, there’s one more trick to it. The XM1302 will offer a special [b]new passive ability called Mitigation.[/b][/p][p]Very simply put, the faster the tank goes, the less damage it takes. The current work looks roughly as such:[/p][list][*][p]If you are going 32 km/h (or faster) upon shell impact, you receive only 50% damage[/p][/*][*][p]If you are going 50 km/h (or faster, almost at maximum off-road speed) upon shell impact, you receive only 25% damage[/p][/*][*][p]If you are going 70 km/h (almost at maximum speed) upon shell impact, you receive only 10% damage[/p][/*][/list][p]There are of course downsides to this ability as well. For one, the mitigation does not affect module damage so it’s perfectly possible to become immobilized. Damage dealt by ramming and fires is not mitigated either. And last but not least, the numbers above are not final yet, we are still in the process of implementing the ability and it will require additional testing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/089fb8e5b4b2d4cbf927e4ee061dbe7368658af2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And that’s still not everything. Owning this vehicle will be very useful because it’ll become a prerequisite to owning ANOTHER vehicle in an unannounced upcoming system, but it’s too early to talk about that. For now, please take the vehicle “as described above”.[/p][p]We hope you will enjoy this amazing machine as much as we enjoyed making it for you. We’ll tell you more about the rest of the Battle Path in the very near future, but for now:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Historical Skins: Leclerc T40 Concorde
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p][/p][p]We have already unveiled [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-abramsx-reaver"]one skin[/url][/b] for the Operation Liberty event that is starting in the near future, but that is definitely not all the event’s going to contain. There is a second set of French prizes and the chief amongst them is the [b]Concorde skin for Leclerc T40.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/fd6eec562c2dbcdac3b9ffec727fc453e2056ffb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Despite the Leclerc T40 never making to the prototype stage, this skin is actually based on a real-life vehicle, the Leclerc Main Battle Tank “Concorde” number 6014-0030. The “Concorde” belonged to the second series of the tank, production run 8 – with improved electronics. The second series of the Leclerc was produced between 1997 and 2003 and consisted of 178 vehicles.[/p][p]The real-life “Concorde” served with the 501st-503rd Combat Tank Regiment, a unit tracing its roots back to the First World War, having fought during the Second World War with the British (including the battle of El Alamein). It survived the Cold War mostly intact and exists (albeit in a different form) today – in 2009 it was reformed as the 501st Combat Tank Regiment.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6038653921375c3c5aa4028b5d41e58bb4df3fc7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This skin clads your Leclerc T40 in all the appropriate insignia as well as a large camouflage tarp on the hull.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b71879f94b2d485c83f77bcb27d2548fc1e567bf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As for the other assets, we also have a brand-new French camouflage for you called [b]French (Export)[/b], as seen on a VBCI infantry fighting vehicle during the Eurosatory expo in Paris in 2024. We are also adding several real-life Leclerc MBT names as decals.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c6fc7dc4e1116cc5e40485d29bffa200e7b03215.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Just like with the AbramsX skin, you will be able to obtain this one by simply playing the game. The “Operation Liberty” event is starting on June 11 and if you play the game every day, you’ll receive the skin on July 14 (the Bastille Day). But even if you’re not interested in this particular skin, the event will offer a number of other prizes, most notably bonus Battle Coins for the Shadow Protocol Battle Path.[/p][p]We hope you’ll enjoy this content and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Asian Week
notes.content:
Commanders!

[list]
[*]     ZTZ-20 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Type 99B Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     QN-506 Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer
[*]     VT-5 Tier 9 Premium Light Tank
[*]     Iron Crate
[/list]

[b]Between June 5 and June 11, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:

[h3]ZTZ-20[/h3]
 

The ZTZ-20 is a fictional Chinese Main Battle Tank for the 21st century. It combines western influences with some ideas taken from the T-14 Armata. You can read about its (real and fictional) history in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-ztz-20][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url]

[img]https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_no_text_1.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the ZTZ-20 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. On its own, it’s a beast of a machine and one of the most powerful vehicles in the game, featuring both a powerful gun and thick armor. It does have a special feature though – its missiles can cover a wide area with burning White Phosphorus that reduces enemy vehicle camouflage and deals damage to anyone entering the zone.

The ZTZ-20 MBT is available [url=https://aw.my.games/web-shop][b]in our Web Shop via Loot Crates.[/b][/url] Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

 
[url=https://aw.my.games/web-shop][img]https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png[/img][/url]
 

[h3]VT-5[/h3]

The VT-5 is a modern Chinese Light Tank that was developed specifically with export in mind. There are many reasons why a country without its own tank development should opt to purchase a Light Tank instead of a full-scale Main Battle Tank. It’s equally as fast if not faster with equal firepower but, what is most important, it is affordable. The VT-5 excels in all these categories. While its armor cannot match that of an MBT, it can protect its crew against most infantry threats thanks to its ERA and cage armor sets. It also has a powerful 105mm gun capable of firing guided missiles, it is packed with advanced electronics and is supremely agile thanks to its 1000hp diesel engine. Simply put, wraps cutting edge technologies up into an affordable bundle. You can learn more about it in a [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-vt-5]dedicated article.[/url]

In Armored Warfare, the VT-5 is a very powerful Tier 9 Premium Light Tank. Fast and agile, it features solid levels of protection (the configuration in the game is the one featuring the ERA kit as well as the turret cage armor) and a good rate of fire. Additionally, its gun is capable of firing guided missiles. It’s an ideal machine for players who value speed and agility, as it offers plenty of both. The VT-5 is capable of dancing around its opponents on the battlefield, outperforming even some AFVs in mobility.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://aw.my.games/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h3]Type 99B[/h3]

The Type 99B is a fictional improved version of the currently most modern Chinese Main Battle Tank. It was designed as a concept by the Chinese tank community some years ago and we used the concept as a basis for its introduction. However, our version bears significant differences, most notably the Red Arrow missile launcher on the roof. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-type-99b]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/010c19bf93f3fc07efe78ca9f5420804a4c33d2f.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the VT-5 is a very powerful Tier 9 Premium Light Tank. Fast and agile, it features solid levels of protection (the configuration in the game is the one featuring the ERA kit as well as the turret cage armor) and a good rate of fire. Additionally, its gun is capable of firing guided missiles. It’s an ideal machine for players who value speed and agility, as it offers plenty of both. The VT-5 is capable of dancing around its opponents on the battlefield, outperforming even some AFVs in mobility.

In Armored Warfare, the Type 99B is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. It is fast, agile, and capable of dealing tremendous damage over a short period of time thanks to its turret-mounted thermobaric missile launcher.

The Type 99B MBT is available [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop]in our Web Shop via Loot Crates[/url]. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[url=https://aw.my.games/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]



[h3]QN-506[/h3]

The QN-506 fire support vehicle is a Chinese attempt to design a cheap, export-oriented alternative to the Russian BMPT series. Instead of converting a second or third generation MBT, the engineers at Wuhan Guide Infrared Co., Ltd., likely to keep the vehicle as affordable as possible, opted to base their project on the Type 59 MBT, which is, in its basic form anyway, a copy of the old Soviet T-55 medium tank from the late 1950s. They jam-packed it with cutting edge electronics and a number of weapon systems, including ATGMs, an automatic cannon or smaller caliber rockets. However, despite the use of an unmanned turret, the protection levels of this vehicle are still quite low and, so far, there haven’t been any signs of interest in the QN-506. You can learn more about this vehicle in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-qn-506]dedicated article.[/url]

[previewyoutube=omzaADMKUck;full][/previewyoutube]

In Armored Warfare, the QN-506 is a Premium Tier 9 Tank Destroyer that gameplay-wise resembles the popular BMPT series. However, unlike the Russian Terminators, it has a number of interesting features including tree different weapon systems (30mm cannon, 70mm unguided rockets and 151mm ATGMs) and loitering recon ammunition flying towards the end of a map and spotting everything in its path. The last ability is unique to the QN-506 and makes it one of the most potent support vehicles on the battlefield.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://aw.my.games/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h3]Iron Crate[/h3]

We’ve prepared for you an additional offer this week. The Iron Crate is available in our Web Shop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/942f092081cb583c76d71a3315ee4cda42d6a505.jpg[/img]

This crate allows you to win a Tier 4 to Tier 10 Premium vehicle (or its value in Gold if you have it already). The crate contains some very rare vehicles, including:

[list]
[*]     ZTL-11 Tier 9 Premium TD
[*]     VN17 Tier 8 Premium AFV
[/list]

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://aw.my.games/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: In Development: RDF/LT Ares
notes.content:
Commanders!

On Monday, we revealed the [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-elke]first article[/url] of the upcoming Rough Riders Battle Path and now we’re ready to show you the second one. Please welcome the RDF/LT Ares Light Tank prototype!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/8b5130b944d869c4daae9560743d64e1171a481f.jpg[/img]

But, as usual, a little history first.

Since the days of the Vietnam War until the mid-1990s, the standard American light tank was the M551 Sheridan. As light tanks go, it was mediocre at best and with its problematic Vietnam record, it’s no wonder that the U.S. Army started to look for replacement.

The RDF/LT (Rapid Deployment Force Light Tank) was one of such designs by AAI Corporation. It originated in an earlier Light Tank program that went nowhere (as usual), but the lessons learned allowed AAI to develop this tank in hope of further participation in the U.S. Marine AVCT program. The Marines needed something fast with a lot of firepower but at the same time light enough to be transported using a sling under a CH-53 helicopter. The original prototype AAI produced was armed with a 75mm Ares cannon but realizing its experimental nature, AAI opted to replace it with an older, well-tested 76mm M32 rifled gun that had been previously used on the M41 Walker Bulldog Light Tank. Despite this, the result was quite an advanced and fast vehicle with its hull made of aluminum and even the gun received new APFSDS shells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7f19ff326f04eb3d2784d159ff78c8acd4cecf29.jpg[/img]

Regardless, despite these qualities, the Marines didn’t want it and that was the end of the RDF/LT. The end of the 1970s wasn’t really a good time for experimental projects with the funding being cut left and right as an aftermath of the lost Vietnam War. And so the Marines went for the LAV and HMMWV wheeled vehicles instead, leaving the RDF/LT in prototype stage only. The project was officially terminated in 1985.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/88eedd51b689343873cde64887c64fac650035b2.jpg[/img]

This RDF version is equipped with an unmanned turret (reducing the crew to two men) and Stinger missile pods to provide the vehicle with anti-air capabilities. This configuration appeared in a full-scale mock-up version.

[b]In Armored Warfare, the RDF/LT Ares will become a Tier 8 Premium Light Tank and the second prize of the Rough Riders Battle Path.[/b]

Performance-wise, we’re looking at something similar to the previously unveiled ELKE – an extremely mobile light tank with poor protection, armed with 75mm rapid-firing cannon with more advanced shells than used on the ELKE and a larger magazine – up to 18 shells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4e0fc46ee0d0d466e530bed1f5c165b6a07e2f74.jpg[/img]

However, there will be some notable differences. For one, the turret is unmanned, which means the vehicle won’t be as vulnerable as the ELKE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4abb94e737eda170fcda15d6b52ddc41b6db7ccf.jpg[/img]

As you can also see from the images, the vehicle is armed with ATGM launchers. In real-life, they fire Stinger SAMs. Our version fires Starstreaks, which are theoretically compatible with the launcher platform. The Stingers are also implemented – as potent thermobaric warhead missiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/9b670aed02e802e03fc668135c73d46c3821531b.jpg[/img]

And, last but not least, the vehicle has an even more powerful engine and will therefore be even more suitable for the fast and hard-hitting gameplay Light Tanks are intended for. Overall, this tank will offer more tactical options than the ELKE because its missiles clearly are a long distance weapon system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/0eca95cedc44a7d56a7f44c1346f2c55e9c7f429.jpg[/img]

However, the core will remain the same – to be perhaps the ultimate Light Tank of its Tier.

We hope that you’ll enjoy this vehicle and, as always:

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Historical Skins: AbramsX Reaver
notes.content:
Commanders!

It wouldn’t be a U.S. Independence Day celebration without new American content and this year’s no exception. However, you might now be thinking, why take a look at it right now when we’re three days into June? Well, there’s a good reason for that, which we’ll explain below. Right now, we’re happy to introduce the newest skin that we will have for you – the [b]Reaver for AbramsX[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a6ce4cc8460b27f1992bb18d6c79e1bf7a947509.png[/img]

Considering the vehicle choice, the skin is not exactly historical in the truest sense of the word. Rather, it is inspired by real vehicles and revolves around a specific theme:

“What would happen if the AbramsX prototype was adopted in U.S. service?”

This particular AbramsX, named “Reaver” by its crew, clearly served in some middle-eastern country.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f2101bd22e367dad1e858671df0f632f71df979c.jpg[/img]

It’s been painted with the same sand color as other American MBTs but the surface is scratched and worn by heavy use. The crew’s belongings are lying on the back of the turret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/e038a500ff63b1d27a460786479e7adecb2b8920.jpg[/img]

We’ve paid extra attention to detail to make the skin look as realistic as possible and we hope you’ll enjoy it. But that’s not all we’ll have for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/8ae16f8cdb5e49dd41ac37d0e41d571a972a7042.jpg[/img]

For the lovers of realism we have a new camouflage from the [b]Reforger 83[/b] family. The Reforger 83 exercise saw many U.S. tanks covered with unconventional camouflages, some of which we already introduced to the game. Like the others, this camouflage was seen on an Abrams MBT belonging to the 11th Armored Cavalry Regiment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/05e40578415b81e07fa057c8bc1fc2c04b2c0cc8.jpg[/img]

And, last not but least, we’ll have some real-life inscriptions that were spotted on various Abrams MBTs across the years. We picked a few cool ones that we thought you’d like.

But the best part? You can get all that by simply playing the game. A new special event called “Operation Liberty” is starting on June 11 and if you play the game every day, you’ll receive the skin on July 4 (and by that time, you’ll have everything else as well). We’ll tell you more about the event’s prizes in the next article.

So saddle up, commanders, because with the new Battle Path coming as well, this summer’s going to be hot. We hope you’ll enjoy this content and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: In Development: ELKE
notes.content:
Commanders!

With the current Battle Path in its second half, we’d like to show you what comes after you are finished with the history of mercenaries. The next Battle Path will be called Rough Riders and will focus on the history of U.S. cavalry, from its humble beginnings during the Revolutionary War to its transformation into the armored cavalry it is today. And the first vehicle of the Battle Path will be none other than the [b]ELKE technology demonstrator[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/dde16a4557253b6ec49c0093cd67ec2016a9f066.png[/img]

The ELKE is a part of the late 1970s and early 1980s search for a Sheridan replacement, which started with the HSTV-L and included the RDF and DFSV prototypes.

The word ELKE stands for Elevated Kinetic Energy. Following the dismissal of the early replacements to the Sheridan (the HSTV-L program), Pacific Car and Foundry was tasked in 1982 to produce a single prototype of their proposed elevated gun design using a Sheridan hull.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/e404cd26885bf90eee69bb34d274d77e9cbabff7.jpg[/img]

The 75mm XM274 Ares gun would depress and elevate on a hydraulic-controlled arm, producing amazing elevation and depression angles. The Ares gun was a prototype of hypervelocity medium caliber cannon featuring penetration values similar to main caliber tank guns – at a fraction of their weight. Additionally, it was envisaged to have a very high rate of fire. The gun would be magazine-fed and the whole prototype weighed mere 15 tons.

Unfortunately, while impressive, the arm design was deemed much too unreliable. Another major issue of these designs was the limited amount of ammunition carried (far below the military requirements). As such, the prototype did not go anywhere but paved the way for the RDF Light Tank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d4720e41e6be279836d33755c9d11593817aa90b.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] In Armored Warfare, the ELKE will become a Tier 7 Premium Light Tank and the first prize of the Rough Riders Battle Path.
[/list]

For its Tier, the ELKE will be the ultimate Light Tank with unparalleled mobility and firepower. The downside? Nearly complete lack of armor, although most of the elevated weapons station does count as a weapons module rather than a turret.

But this tank won’t be about armor. It will be the embodiment of speed and precision as, for its mere 15 tons, it’ll use a 300hp engine (with 400hp being available through additional progression). The gun will feature a unique animation based on our analysis of the ELKE drawings and the few photographs that are available, allowing for extreme depression and elevation angles (-40/+25 degrees).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/122c13ce7da8e68c3efbbaf7861d4d23e5b752c7.jpg[/img]

The 75mm gun caliber lower damage will be compensated by extremely high rate of fire in two modes:

[list]
[*]     Rapid burst mode (6 round magazine) with a longer reload (upgradable to 12 rounds)
[*]     Regular fire mode (60 rounds per minute) (potentially upgradable to automatic, autocannon-like fire)
[/list]

And what’s the right tactic for what is essentially an armored and armed race car? Go in with the gun blazing, of course! For those who love unrivalled firepower and speed, this will be one of the most purist vehicles in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/50b5e23489ffe5e8699b7e8d8b0e9e97095cbeb7.jpg[/img]

On the other hand, its high-positioned cannon along with its gun depression will allow for some creative use of terrain when planning ambushes. Either way, the ELKE will devastate softer targets in seconds – you don’t want to find yourselves on the wrong side of that gun.

We hope that you’ll enjoy the ELKE as well as the entire Battle Path and, as always:

See you on the battlefield!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d2b40b932bec0945b91136a4a8d534037f586912.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Offer: Europe's Edge
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:

[list]
[*]     KF41 Lynx Prototype Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle
[*]     Lynx Skyranger Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle
[*]     Boxer RIWP Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle
[*]     Ajax Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle
[*]     Boxer CRV Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle
[*]     Otomatic Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer
[*]     Gepard Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle
[*]     Leopard 2 Revolution Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Leclerc T40 Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer
[*]     Marder 2 Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle
[*]     Commander Loot Crate
[/list]

[b]Between May 29, 2025 and June 5, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:

[h3]KF41 Lynx Prototype[/h3]

This is a 2018 prototype of the KF41 Lynx, a cutting edge IFV developed by Rheinmetall for export. Featuring advanced modular armor and multiple gun configurations, the vehicle has already been adopted by Hungary with more contracts pending. You can read more about it in our dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c1a454ebf75357a2899defc02d10db91504b5ec2.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the KF41 Lynx Prototype is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It is a durable and powerful IFV featuring two weapon configurations (30mm and 35mm) as well as a new infantry type that fires large thermobaric warheads from its anti-tank launchers.

The KF41 Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Lynx Skyranger[/h3]

This is a version of the cutting edge Lynx platform but instead of the standard IFV configuration, it utilizes the Skyranger HEL turret to create a short-range anti-aircraft vehicle that can also eliminate drone swarms with ease. This configuration was proposed for the recent Hungarian military upgrade program but never built in real life. You can read more about it in our dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/df9652506b6a6b2da91fa315d228e0ab46cfe4d2.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Lynx Skyranger is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It’s best used as a scout killer but it is capable of other roles as well. It features three rather unusual abilities, such as the programmable HE ammunition that explodes above targets, the Starstreak missiles that deal more damages over larger distances and ignore APS, and the High Energy Laser active ability. When activated, the laser blinds enemy targets, significantly reducing their spotting range. You can learn more about these abilities from our developer diary.

The Skyranger Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Boxer RIWP[/h3]

The Boxer RIWP is a combination of a Tracked Boxer hull and a modular turret called RIWP. Both components are fairly new and haven’t been officially combined as of now but the Boxer platform can theoretically support this weapon system. You can read more about it in our dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/0bbc395115df5c7022b5b95a5bc4707c042c41d1.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Boxer RIWP is a Tier 10 Premium AFV that’s unique for one reason – it offers five fairly distinctive weapon configurations along with a reliable autocannon capable of quickly dealing with lighter targets. It can also deploy Mechanized Infantry.

The Boxer RIWP Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Ajax[/h3]

The Ajax is the most modern British Infantry Fighting Vehicle currently in service. Despite being plagued by developmental problems, the program to replace the aging Warrior IFV produced one of the best vehicles in its class. You can read more about it in our dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/864f3f0f74dd6d3e118b65676dd7f8fbfb5f9353.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Ajax is a Tier 10 Premium AFV featuring solid protection levels and excellent sustained firepower. Furthermore, it can deploy Mechanized Infantry like other AFVs of its class and has a special ability that allows it to better detect enemies at closer ranges.

The Ajax Tier 10 Premium AFV is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Boxer CRV[/h3]

The Boxer CRV is the Infantry Fighting Vehicle variant of the Boxer platform, featuring a cutting edge turret with 30mm autocannon and guided missiles. It is a truly next-gen IFV with orders coming from all over the world, most notably from Australia and Germany. You can read more about it in our dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/568fcf428eecab67094421d50359c27f302969a0.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Boxer CRV is a Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It is one of the best IFVs in its class, offering a combination of solid mobility and great firepower, including Mechanized Infantry deployment and the dreaded double-launch ATGM feature.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Otomatic[/h3]

The Otomatic was an attempt from the 1980s and 1990s to mate originally naval 76mm rapid-firing cannon with a tracked chassis (either of Palmaria or a Leopard) to create an advanced anti-aircraft gun. You can read more about it in our dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b362e30675b44705bd3769fd1a97bb0a7fc1f57d.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Otomatic a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. Thanks to its fast-firing 76mm gun it can deal tremendous amounts of damage over short periods of time and can deal effectively with any target it encounters on the battlefield.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Gepard[/h3]

The Gepard is one of the best short-range anti-aircraft self-propelled guns in the world. Made primarily for Germany and the Netherlands, it remains in active use to this day and has recently seen some combat in Ukraine. You can read more about it in our dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/9c276cac2259c68b13f10a4214340c9d3085a7bd.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Gepard a Tier 8 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. Unlike the Otomatic, it relies not on a single larger gun, but on the hailstorm of shells provided by its two 35mm autocannons. Even the toughest of targets crumble under its withering fire.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Leopard 2 Revolution[/h3]

The Leopard 2 Revolution is a continuation of the older Evolution upgrade, intended to improve the performance of the older variants of the Leopard 2 Main Battle Tank in order to make it excel even on the battlefields of the 21st century. The improvements include a comprehensive armor upgrade, ROSY soft-kill APS and smoke grenade launchers as well as an entire suite of cutting edge electronics. You can read more about it in our dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3846c70a3a6e49eb41c26bf378989701ab5bd63d.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Leopard 2 Revolution is a Tier 8 Main Battle Tank. It is not only well-armored, it also features an extremely accurate 120mm gun with advanced ammunition, allowing it to destroy its opponents at very long ranges, rivaling those of Tank Destroyers. The German tanks in general perform best at longer ranges and the Revolution is no exception.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Leclerc T40[/h3]

Sometimes called the French Terminator, this vehicle was designed on the Leclerc MBT chassis with one purpose in mind – to accompany tanks and fight off infantry attacks the same way as the Russian BMPT series does. You can read more about it in our dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4079a69d41017c550ae8cec52d6a60b0b791bb3c.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Leclerc T40 is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. It offers you a combination of a durable hull, rapid-fire 40mm automatic cannon and, most importantly, the Javelin missile system. Simply right-click the target, wait until it becomes locket and fire the Javelin ATGM – it will home itself on the target, attacking its weak roof armor. Thanks to this ability, the Leclerc T40 is one of the most destructive vehicles in the game.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Marder 2[/h3]

The Marder 2 was an experimental German IFV, developed in the late 1980s to replace the aging Marder IFV. It featured more armor, a new turret and a brand-new Rheinmetall dual-caliber autocannon that could fire both 35mm and 50mm rounds. Despite its qualities, the vehicle was never accepted in service due to its high cost and because it was no longer needed because of the fall of the Soviet Union. A single surviving prototype can be found today in the Koblenz military collection. You can read more about it in our dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/cb9057ff357b4c6a2edc01c083aac6e4f444b158.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Marder 2 is a Tier 8 Armored Fighting Vehicle. With its 44 tons, it’s one of the heaviest and toughest AFVs around. Unlike many other AFVs of its Tier, it is not armed with guided missiles, relying instead on its extremely powerful 50mm autocannon. This vehicle can also deploy Mechanized Infantry.
