[h2]XM2001 Crusader[/h2]

The XM2001 Crusader is an American attempt to replace the M109A6 Paladin in the 1990s with something more modern. The project was cancelled in 2002 due to its heavy weight. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xm2001-crusader]dedicated article.[/url]

[previewyoutube=xAjZAYDISN0;full][/previewyoutube]

In Armored Warfare, the XM2001 Crusader is a Tier 10 Premium Self-Propelled Gun. The Crusader is an ideal vehicle for players who like to play aggressively. Dominate the battlefield with unrivalled firepower of a three-round 155mm magazine paired with guided HE rounds, and retreat under the cover of smoke thanks to your speed and agility. The Crusader is the ultimate SPG you've been dreaming of!

The Crusader is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Challenger 2 Streetfighter II[/h2]

The Streetfighter II is an upgrade program to overhaul the venerable Challenger 2 Main Battle Tank for the conditions of modern battlefields, especially urban combat. It features a number of improvements and extra components, most notably a dozer blade, a Brimstone ATGM twin launcher and an advanced camera system by Elbit. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-challenger-2-streetfighter-ii]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/0c9d0afead2c90737c2536c06fb3baed390ab564.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Challenger 2 Streetfighter is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Its main advantages include excellent frontal armor (enhanced by the presence of its dozer blade covering its lower frontal plate), increased ramming damage and long range lethality, courtesy of a powerful ATGM launcher. Whether you desire to bring the fighting up close or support other MBTs at distance, the Streetfighter’s got your back.

The Challenger 2 Streetfighter II Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]M-95 Degman[/h2]

The M-95 Degman is an advanced Croatian prototype MBT, developed during the 1990s and 2000s. It is based on the previous Yugoslavian project, the Vihor MBT, which in turn has its roots in the improved T-72M series produced in former Yugoslavia. You can read more about its history in a [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-m-95-degman]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6f105e9ef1535581cc13bc8d8ea75e74cc32a531.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the tank is relatively fast and fairly agile while carrying some potent firepower for its Tier. In fact, its owners can choose from two powerful guns:

[list]
[*] 125mm 2A46 Russian-style smoothbore gun, known from many Russian MBTs
[*] 120mm CTG NATO-style smoothbore gun that you know from the Challenger 1 Falcon MBT
[/list]

It’s worth noting that the 120mm shells have higher penetration values and the gun can also fire Falarick ATGMs while the 125mm gun has higher damage per shot. Both guns will feature good handling as well as overall performance to offset the vehicle’s weakness, which is its mediocre armor. The Degman must rely on its mobility and firepower to survive, making it an ideal vehicle for aggressive, daring players.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Type 96B[/h2]

The Type 96B MBT, as its name suggests, is an evolution of the Type 96A, featuring such elements as an upgraded fire control system and a much more powerful engine, resulting in considerably better mobility and speed. Unlike the Type 96A, however, the Type 96B is a prototype, designed for the Chinese military team to use during the annual Tank Biathlon event in Russia. In 2017, the Chinese team won the second place, being defeated only by Russia. You can learn more about its history in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-type-96b]dedicated article![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7775377e2c5c2d4ffa109b70f8a7b2871ec78f3d.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Type 96B is a Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank. Gameplay-wise, it’s very agile and fast for its class and uses advanced ammunition, making it highly suitable for players who prefer mobility over armor protection, even though it can take a lot of punishment as well.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]M1A1 Storm[/h2]

In 1985, the Abrams was upgraded with, amongst other things, the 120mm M256 smoothbore cannon. Over 5000 M1A1 tanks were produced until 1992. This tank participated in Operation Desert Storm, which forged its legendary reputation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/cf6f663249e4fcf01ff6fc443f1c2b4474d99774.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the M1A1 Storm is a Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank. The M1A1 Storm look was inspired by Operation Desert Storm, including a gorgeous camouflage net model. But, more importantly, this tank is equipped with a massive frontal dozer blade, adding extra armor and ramming damage to the long list of its advantages.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]MBT-70[/h2]

Germany and the United States cooperated in the 1960s and 70s to create the ultimate Main Battle Tank to replace the aging Patton tank series in service. The MBT-70 prototype tank was the U.S. result of the development program. It was exceptionally well armed with a 152mm gun, capable of firing guided missiles and equipped with cutting edge technology, but high costs and endless delays in development led to the cancellation of this project and the subsequent adoption of a more reasonable design – the Abrams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/10d4bde8f88f68180201986b5ad98df3e65dae25.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the MBT-70 is a Tier 6 Premium Main Battle Tank. Several features make it quite unique – it has a large caliber gun that, while slow to reload, delivers tremendous damage with each shot. It can also fire devastating guided missiles and while its mobility levels aren’t the best, it can devastate its opponents with well-timed shots, relying on its armor to keep it alive while it reloads. And last but not least, this vehicle has a hydraulic suspension available, allowing it to tilt its hull to improve its gun depression and elevation.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

Some of the most popular and requested commanders are making a comeback in bundles together with Insignia and Boost tokens chosen specifically to allow for their faster training.

notes.title: Armored Warfare: 2024 in Review
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5f44161e076b125f75638869f30a78d785a82e77.jpg[/img]

[h3]Commanders![/h3]

As 2024 ends, it’s the perfect time to look back at the year’s highlights. From the impactful Shockwave Update to the story-driven Seahawks Battle Path and the tactical challenges of Lone Star, Armored Warfare has introduced exciting new content and challenges. With additions like the EMBT and XM2001 Crusader, this year brought a variety of memorable moments for commanders around the globe. Let’s take a closer look at what defined 2024 on the battlefield:

[h3]January: AS90[/h3]

We started the year with a bang—quite literally—with the release of the AS90, a Tier 8 Premium Self-Propelled Gun. Armed with high-damage HE and HEAT shells and exceptional mobility, the AS90 proved to be a devastating addition to any arsenal. Originally available for free through a Contract, it is now obtainable only through loot crates, direct purchase, or the Battle Path shop.

[previewyoutube=TobN00dKYAU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]March: Europe’s Edge Battle Path[/h3]

Spring saw the arrival of the Europe’s Edge Battle Path, celebrating modern European engineering with exclusive camouflages and reward vehicles, including the Leopard Cockerill (Tier 8 Premium LT), Ajax (Tier 10 Premium AFV), and KF51 Panther (Tier 10 Premium MBT). Initially obtainable as Battle Path rewards, these vehicles are now available only through loot crates, direct purchase, or the Battle Path shop.
Commanders also unlocked rare vehicles like the Object 787 Gadyuka and CV90120T Ghost, while revamped chain missions added a fresh twist to the campaign.

[previewyoutube=WnkzH-poeWo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]June: Tales from the Dark Battle Path[/h3]

Summer brought the Tales from the Dark Battle Path, a four-month campaign steeped in mystery. Players competed for powerful rewards, including the BTR-82A (Tier 8 Premium AFV), BMP-2M (Tier 9 Premium AFV), and T-90M (Tier 10 Premium MBT), all of which are now available through loot crates, direct purchase, or the Battle Path shop.

[previewyoutube=-f5ICvEr3k8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]August: EMBT[/h3]

The Enhanced Main Battle Tank (EMBT) made its debut in August, showcasing advanced French and German engineering. Equipped with the 140mm ASCALON cannon, Trophy APS, and Galix soft-kill APS, this Tier 10 sniper MBT excels in long-range engagements and is a true technological marvel.

[h3]August: Lone Star Special Operation[/h3]

The second chapter of the Black Company saga, Lone Star, transported commanders to the urban battlegrounds of Port Houston. This mission challenged players to liberate a prisoner camp while navigating intense close-quarters combat. Rewards included the Lone Star camouflage, a Cowboy avatar, and 28 new achievements.

[previewyoutube=Ze7qrFWZuZE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]September: T-80BVM[/h3]

The T-80BVM, a progression Main Battle Tank, finally joined the catalog of vehicles available for research in Armored Warfare FOR FREE! Boasting upgrades from Russia’s Motobol program, it features Kontakt-5 ERA and a 1250hp turbine engine, delivering exceptional performance in cold environments. As a key link in the Soviet tank lineage, the T-80BVM stands out as a formidable addition to the progression lineup.

[previewyoutube=IVB-2q_84lw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]September: T-64BV Mod. 2017[/h3]

The T-64BV Mod. 2017, a Tier 7 Premium MBT, brought Ukrainian engineering to the forefront. Featuring Nizh ERA, a 125mm cannon with gun-launched missiles, and superior mobility, this assault tank is both agile and formidable in frontal engagements.
As a reward vehicle for the seasonal contract, it’s not too late to join the event! Complete daily and weekly missions to claim this powerful prize.

[h3]October: Shockwave Update[/h3]

The Shockwave Update introduced the thrilling Shockwave Mode, a survival endgame challenge for Tier 10 vehicles. Teams of five faced relentless waves of enemies in a fight for survival and high rewards.
In addition, the update delivered exciting improvements:

[list]
[*] Dynamic Decals for enhanced customization.
[*] New Sounds for iconic vehicles like the T-72 series.
[*] PELE Overhaul for improved shell mechanics.
[*] Crew and Commander Upgrades, including a new skill slot.
[*] Crew Upgrades: A new sixth training level was added, along with an extra skill slot for greater tactical flexibility.
[*] Commander Changes: Commanders saw adjustments to their abilities, offering more opportunities to refine strategies and improve battlefield performance.
[*] Friendly Fire Adjustments for smoother team gameplay.
[/list]
This update set a new benchmark for immersive combat.

[previewyoutube=6ztGOpNW9Ic;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]December: Seahawks Battle Path[/h3]

The Seahawks Battle Path brings Armored Warfare’s lore to life with its Diary feature, chronicling the history of the Seahawks unit. Commanders can earn epic rewards, including:

[list]
[*] Cheonma-2 (Tier 10 Premium MBT)
[*] VN20 (Tier 10 Premium TD)
[*] XK3 Phantom (Tier 10 Premium MBT)
[/list]
Additional rewards include upgraded commanders, exclusive skins, and vehicles like the Abrams AGDS and Stingray 2 Black Eagle. With revamped missions and story-driven gameplay, this Battle Path is already shaping up to be a year-end highlight.

The campaign is live now! Join the action today and start earning these incredible rewards!

[previewyoutube=0eIOgp52xNI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]December: XM2001 Crusader[/h3]

Closing out the year, the XM2001 Crusader delivered precision artillery strikes with its 155mm gun and three-round magazine. This Tier 10 Premium SPG combines exceptional speed (67 km/h) with moderate armor and requires careful positioning due to its turret’s limited traverse angle. The Crusader’s firepower and mobility make it a standout addition to any commander’s arsenal.

Starting December 26, the Crusader will be available through blueprint loot crates, giving commanders another opportunity to add this formidable vehicle to their collection.

[h3]Thank You, Commanders![/h3]

2024 has been an incredible journey, and we couldn’t have done it without you. Here’s to more adventures in 2025—see you on the battlefield!

[url=https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Offer: Object 195 and Type 99A2-140
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today we’ve prepared the following items for you (directly available, no loot crates):

[list]
[*]     Object 195 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Type 99A2-140 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[/list]
[b]Between December 23 to December 30, 2024[/b], the following items will be available:

[h2]Object 195[/h2]

The Object 195 Main Battle Tank is one of the 1980s Soviet supertanks, intended to fight the next generation of NATO MBTs. It was developed in Nizhny Tagil by the experienced Uralvagonzavod design bureau (UKBTM), which was responsible for such legendary tanks as the T-72 and T-90. Much like other such prototypes, it was designed to be armed with massive 152mm smoothbore cannon in an unmanned turret. A single prototype was built and it allegedly passed state trials between 2008 and 2010 but the project was discontinued due to a lack of financing. You can learn more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-195]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f433540942807b4e4c5bc76352306795ff8b869f.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Object 195 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank and one of the most versatile vehicles you can get your hands on thanks to a combination of excellent armor, unmanned turret, 152mm hard-hitting gun and one special feature – the coaxial 30mm autocannon that allows you to take out unarmored targets without having to waste a shot of your main weapon.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3ZxTaa5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Type 99A2-140[/h2]

The Type 99A2-140 is an experimental version of the most advanced Chinese Main Battle Tank in existence – the Type 99A. Unlike its production counterpart, however, it is not armed with a 125mm smoothbore, but massive 140mm smoothbore cannon. This is a theoretical upgrade to the vehicle – while the People’s Republic of China was considering upgrading the firepower of its Main Battle Tanks to face latest western and Russian MBT models, a 140mm gun was never installed on this chassis and was only mentioned in passing by certain Chinese sources. Now, however, your enemies will have the opportunity to experience what such a vehicle with you in command would be like to face in battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/31141e40bfacd0fb504f4535b3523160316fb85f.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Type 99A2-140 is a rather unique Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. It is essentially a version of the progression Type 99A2 Tier 10 MBT with one difference – the 140mm gun, trading its rate of fire for penetration and single shell damage. It is very fast and mobile (with its maximum speed being well over 90 km/h), protected by ERA and APS both and capable of using an acceleration-boosting active ability that pushes its engine far beyond the limits of common Main Battle Tanks. If used right, the vehicle is extremely deadly and one of the best Tier 10 MBTs on the battlefields of Armored Warfare.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3ZxTaa5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Cashback Event is here!
notes.content:
Commanders!

For this holiday season, we've prepared a very special event for you. [b]Receive a cashback[/b] from every purchase and spending of Gold!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/18e97fb8210a14fb52e80560f30c248de7ce163c.png[/img]

Between [b]December 20 and December 31, 2024[/b], participate in this special event and get back some of your spendings in Gold that’ll be sent to your account when the event’s over. The more you spend, the more Gold you get back! In order to participate, you have to do one of the following:

[list]
[*] Make a purchase on [url=https://arwar.co/4fsiJy6]Web Shop[/url]
[*] Spend Gold in the game (for example in the active Battle Path)
[/list]

Your spending will be tracked and a part of the appropriate amount of Gold will be sent back to you after the end of the event. The more you spend, the more you get back – but please note that the maximum amount of Gold you can get back this way is limited.

Here, you can find everything that you need to know:

[list]
[*] Current amount spent and the limits
[*] Info about the cashback event and its limits
[/list]

Press the button below to track your progress:

[url=https://arwar.co/49QypKo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a75d622f9814c0fe50fffad57166c01100d858ee.png[/img][/url]

The full version of rules and regulations of the event can be found in the FAQ section. Participation is easy – log in, buy items in the Web Shop or spend Gold. The rest is handled by us.

[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2]

[b]How can I participate in the event?[/b]

In order to participate, all you need to do is one of the following things:

[list]
[*] Buy something in the [url=https://arwar.co/4fsiJy6]Web Shop[/url]
[*] Spend Gold in game
[/list]

[b]How much Gold do I get back?[/b]

The amount you get back is calculated based on your spending and is modified by appropriate coefficients. The more you spend, the more you get back – up to a certain limit.

[b]The coefficients are calculated as such:[/b]

[list]
[*] For every 1 EUR (or USD) spent, you get 66 Gold back
[*] For every 1 Gold spent, you get 0.25 Gold back (so 25 Gold back for 100 Gold spent and so on)
[*] At most you can spend 75 EUR or USD during the event (which would give you 4.950 Gold back)
[*] At most you can spend 9.000 Gold during the event (which would give you 2.250 Gold back)
[/list]

You can at most get 7.200 Gold back by combining both methods.

[b]What’s the maximum amount I can get back (the limit)?[/b]

The most you can get back is 7.200 Gold. You can track the progress on our web page.

[b]When will I get the Gold back?[/b]

Within several work days from the end of the event.

[b]Where can I see the status of my cashback?[/b]

[url=https://arwar.co/49QypKo]On a dedicated web page.[/url]

[b]How many purchases can I make?[/b]

During the event, you can buy as many bundles as you like and they will all count towards the cashback amount. Each purchase will be added to the progress bar.

[b]Why is the page not updating with new purchases?[/b]

The update happens in real time (or with a small delay) so please try refreshing the page.

[b]What if it doesn’t appear even after 24 hours from the purchase?[/b]

Contact our [url=https://arwar.co/4iJ76FL]support service.[/url]

[b]What can I do if I have further questions or want to report issues?[/b]

Contact our [url=https://arwar.co/4iJ76FL]support service.[/url]

[b]What kind of purchases do count towards cashback?[/b]

Web Shop purchases and Gold purchases via the Top Up button.

[b]What if I have multiple accounts?[/b]

Each account is dealt with separately. They cannot be combined for the purposes of this event.

[b]How will I know the cashback Gold was sent already?[/b]

Aside from a general in-game notification, the news about cashback being sent will be published on the game’s portal.

[b]What happens if I don’t reach the maximum limit?[/b]

Reaching the limit is not mandatory. You will get as much as is shown on the web page for your account.

[b]What can I use the cashback Gold on? Are there any limitations?[/b]

It’s your Gold – you can use however you see fit.

See you on the battlefield!

[b]Between December 19 and December 26[/b], 2024, the following items will be available:


[h2]KF51 Panther[/h2]

The KF51 Panther Main Battle Tank first appeared in 2022 as a demonstrator of Rheinmetall’s capabilities, mating a modified Leopard 2 hull with a brand-new turret armed not only with cutting edge weaponry, but also a missile launcher. The Panther is one of western next-gen MBT projects, much like the EMBT and the next-generation Abrams. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kf51-panther]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ecbd75a958915ae7db53e8136fe23b4dd794d164.png[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the KF51 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. The KF51 Panther is at its core a medium-range vehicle with reliable armor and solid firepower that, in addition to its 130mm gun and NERA armor, boasts a powerful missile launcher. This combination makes it one of the most powerful MBTs you can encounter in the game.

[b]In the future, the vehicle will receive an optional module allowing the Panther to use the Hero-120 drones instead of missiles.[/b]

The KF51 Panther Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]EMBT[/h2]

The Enhanced Main Battle Tank (EMBT) is a future MBT demonstrator developed over the course of several years as cooperation between the Germany (KMW) and the French (Nexter). It features a heavily modified Leopard 2 hull with a brand-new turret unveiled in 2022 during the Eurosatory 2022 expo in Paris. Our version of the tank is armed with 140mm ASCALON gun. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-embt]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a2aae2dae1bc64164e13e6f69301ee335c60328e.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the EMBT is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Extreme accuracy and firepower are its domain as it features an incredibly powerful 140mm gun and a special ability called Machine Learning that increases the kinetic round penetration with each shot (up to three times). In its medium range support vehicle role, this tank has few equals thanks to the abovementioned ability and the availability of top-attack HEAT rounds.

The EMBT Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Obsidian Blade Bundle (ZTZ-20)[/h2]

Skins rarely go more epic than this. The Obsidian Blade is a unique Main Battle Tank of unknown origin and David Murdoch's personal war chariot. As its name suggests, the tank’s surface us covered with a layer of obsidian. The cracks in the layer are filled with pure gold, as befitting a man of his influence. This skin also features unique visual effects such as the glowing coolant vapors coming out from underneath its armor. The skin is available for the ZTZ-20 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank (also currently on offer).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a9743f7736c6ab8115d39580de3bf1a1f7112570.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Obsidian Blade bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Obsidian Blade for ZTZ-20
[*]     8 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Honey Badger Bundle (Challenger 2 ATDU)[/h2]

We have another epic skin for you, this time for the Challenger 2 ATDU Tier 10 Main Battle Tank. The “Honey Badger” is based on a real-life Challenger 2 testbed called Megatron, equipped with a Barracuda camouflage system. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-challenger-2-tes-honey-badger]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a332734ffc88c1eb1a91ca07d00f9db122f2c16f.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Honey Badger bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Honey Badger for Challenger 2 ATDU
[*]     8 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Boyevaya Podruga Bundle (T-14 Armata)[/h2]

The Boyevaya Podruga skin for the T-14 Armata Tier 10 Main Battle Tank is modeled after a famous Soviet WW2 tank, commanded by Mariya Oktyabrskaya. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-second-world-war]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c046b3f69cf59bbb46d80196292fdaa400d1ea03.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Boyevaya Podruga bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Boyevaya Podruga for T-14 Armata
[*]     8 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Veteran Bundle (Type 99B)[/h2]

The Veteran skin series turns your Chinese vehicles into truly fearsome machines. Show your opponents who they are messing with by dressing your tank in one of the meanest-looking skins out there. This Veteran bundle is intended for the Type 99B Tier 10 Premium MBT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/81eabdfe1531c5566e64b4cb9a365e8f182aa46f.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Veteran Bundle (Type 99B), which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Veteran for Type 99B
[*]     8 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Veteran Bundle (Type 99A2-140)[/h2]

The Veteran skin series turns your Chinese vehicles into truly fearsome machines. Show your opponents who they are messing with by dressing your tank in one of the meanest-looking skins out there. This Veteran bundle is intended for the Type 99A2-140 Tier 10 Premium MBT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/9fb63904324240d4b00d929728c75cb6cb97d7f8.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Veteran Bundle (Type 99A2-140), which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Veteran for Type 99A2-140
[*]     8 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Warfighter Bundle (VN17)[/h2]

The rare Warfighter skin turns your VN17 Tier 8 Premium AFV into a survivor of a thousand battles. With this limited offer, you’ll stand out on the battlefield while a simultaneously blending in thanks to the camouflage nets from the skin. A contradiction? You be the judge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b0edae32ce55423940794d2244d94b4d57f506ca.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Warfighter Bundle (VN17), which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Warfighter for VN17
[*]     8 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]
This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]M1A2C War Pig Skin[/h2]

This skin for the M1A2C Tier 9 Main Battle Tank fits your Abrams with a Barracuda camouflage kit that not only unlocks certain modules for you, but can also change color based on the paint you select on your vehicle. You can read more in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-m1a2c-war-pig]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/fe26aee3d5fddea9141f959ee2d1a86da9e7f5d2.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the War Pig Bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: War Pig
[*]     3 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Desert Ajax[/h2]

We have prepared a new skin for the Ajax, Europe’s Edge Battle Path reward vehicle. The skin is based on an Ajax that appeared in this configuration (featuring a Barracuda camouflage and a desert paintjob) at an expo in the Middle East. Specifically it was the World Defense Show that took place in February 2024 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-desert-ajax]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/8ab8e2a1d3d7a9347c50887e80125b0c998c0502.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Desert Ajax Bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Desert Ajax
[*]     3 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Panzergrenadier Bundle[/h2]

In addition to the Puma Tier 10 Premium AFV, we have prepared a special skin for it. The skin is based on the camouflage used by Panzergrenadierbataillon 33 (33rd Mechanized Infantry Battalion) stationed in Neustadt am Rübenberge near Hannover (northern Germany, the state of Lower Saxony). You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-panzergrenadier]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d491c8020c3b78d66e7f44a2d2699dd13b3cf0ca.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Panzergrenadier Bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Panzergrenadier
[*]     8 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Defender Bundle (T-80UM-1)[/h2]

This skin for the T-80UM-1 Tier 8 MBT is based on the camouflage and markings as seen in 2006 on a T-80U in Kubinka. You can read more about it in a [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-t-80um-1-defender]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/84fc2eb5327ce4365f42ec7060634caf9a940c32.jpg[/img]

We are offering the Defender skin in a bundle, which includes:

[list]
[*]     Defender skin for the T-80UM-1 MBT
[*]     3 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]BMP-1P Spetsnaz Skin[/h2]

The skin for the BMP-1P Tier 4 AFV is based on a BMP-1 belonging to the 101st Special Operations Brigade of the Internal Troops of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation, as seen during the Battle of Grozny in 1996. You can read more in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-bmp-1p-spetsnaz]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b4814a423bb2b5854121af568d8ce8f992a26406.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Spetsnaz Bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Spetsnaz
[*]     Russian (Interior Forces) camouflage
[*]     3 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Leopard 2 Revolution[/h2]

The Leopard 2 Revolution is a continuation of the older Evolution upgrade, intended to improve the performance of the older variants of the Leopard 2 Main Battle Tank in order to make it excel even on the battlefields of the 21st century. The improvements include a comprehensive armor upgrade, ROSY soft-kill APS and smoke grenade launchers as well as an entire suite of cutting edge electronics. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-leopard-2-revolution]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3846c70a3a6e49eb41c26bf378989701ab5bd63d.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Leopard 2 Revolution is a Tier 8 Main Battle Tank. It is not only well-armored, it also features an extremely accurate 120mm gun with advanced ammunition, allowing it to destroy its opponents at very long ranges, rivaling those of Tank Destroyers. The German tanks in general perform best at longer ranges and the Revolution is no exception.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Leclerc T40[/h2]

Sometimes called the French Terminator, this vehicle was designed on the Leclerc MBT chassis with one purpose in mind – to accompany tanks and fight off infantry attacks the same way as the Russian BMPT series does. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-leclerc-t40]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4079a69d41017c550ae8cec52d6a60b0b791bb3c.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Leclerc T40 is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. It offers you a combination of a durable hull, rapid-fire 40mm automatic cannon and, most importantly, the Javelin missile system. Simply right-click the target, wait until it becomes locket and fire the Javelin ATGM – it will home itself on the target, attacking its weak roof armor. Thanks to this ability, the Leclerc T40 is one of the most destructive vehicles in the game.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Marder 2[/h2]

The Marder 2 was an experimental German IFV, developed in the late 1980s to replace the aging Marder IFV. It featured more armor, a new turret and a brand-new Rheinmetall dual-caliber autocannon that could fire both 35mm and 50mm rounds. Despite its qualities, the vehicle was never accepted in service due to its high cost and because it was no longer needed because of the fall of the Soviet Union. A single surviving prototype can be found today in the Koblenz military collection. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-marder-2]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/cb9057ff357b4c6a2edc01c083aac6e4f444b158.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Marder 2 is a Tier 8 Armored Fighting Vehicle. With its 44 tons, it’s one of the heaviest and toughest AFVs around. Unlike many other AFVs of its Tier, it is not armed with guided missiles, relying instead on its extremely powerful 50mm autocannon. This vehicle can also deploy Mechanized Infantry.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Pile of Gold[/h2]

We also have the Pile of Gold Loot Crate for you. This Loot Crate contains copious amounts of Gold for you to win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ee8c59781b575fe38ed2afabaf51c674ca72a20e.jpg[/img]

This Loot Crate includes:

[list]
[*]     250.000 Gold
[*]     100.000 Gold
[*]     50.000 Gold
[*]     10.000 Gold
[*]     5.000 Gold
[*]     1.000 Gold
[*]     500 Gold
[*]     100 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

We hope that you will enjoy this offer and, as usual:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Offer: Tier 10 Direct Sales
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today we’ve prepared the following items for you (directly available, no loot crates):

[list]
[*]     AbramsX Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Altay Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Object 640 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[/list]
[b]Between December 16 to December 23, 2024[/b], the following items will be available:

[h2]AbramsX[/h2]

AbramsX is an advanced technology demonstrator. It was built as a private venture by General Dynamics Land Systems and unveiled in 2022 to show what the future of the Abrams MBT could look like. It is considerably lighter than a fully upgraded Abrams while retaining its protection levels and firepower thanks to its cutting edge systems. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-abramsx]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f884c23e3a0e7f26e2fde71118eefa1b7682ec1c.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the AbramsX is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. While still maintaining the basic Abrams line features such as a 120mm gun, it is considerably lighter and less armored. On the other hand it is also faster, more agile, stealthier, and features a 30mm autocannon that can reduce most light vehicles to a pile of scrap in seconds thanks to its new ammunition. As a result, this tank can dish out a lot of damage but requires careful and skilled gameplay.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Altay[/h2]

The Altay is the result of a Turkish program to build a true indigenous MBT. After a decade of development with hundreds of millions of dollars spent, Turkey finally achieved its goal and built a tank that is roughly on par in performance with decades-old Leopard 2 variants while it still uses many foreign components, including some of its most critical systems. Nevertheless, future Altay variants are expected to feature some cutting edge components.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/293b7fbb0a09b8c59458aeb6304c1c8164503a25.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Altay is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank based on the current prototypes, but also upgraded by various hypothetical aftermarket components of the future to surpass its current capabilities and to match its assigned Tier in power. The basic tank is – gameplay-wise – a mobile sniper, much like the Leopard 2 series, relying on its mobility and the penetration of its shells rather than on its armor. There are two key features to this tank: Adjustable Suspension (tilting forward and to the side) and Hybrid Engine with its distinctive electric sound, giving the vehicle excellent mobility and agility.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Object 640[/h2]

The Object 640 is one of the last Soviet era “super tank” monsters, designed to surpass anything the west could field on the battlefield. It featured extremely advanced armor, making it highly resistant to hits while keeping its weight low. The design was truly revolutionary for the late 1980s, but, like with many other Soviet projects of the era, it was discontinued due to the lack of funding. You can learn more about it in a [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-640-black-eagle]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/788a6065d1596d8ba056bc84794dc3eb7acf97e5.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Object 640 “Black Eagle” is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. It is a fast, agile and well-protected vehicle that plays in a typical Russian-style MBT fashion – ideal for players who want to take things up close and personal. This version of the tank does not feature any camouflage and is ready to be customized as you see fit.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Offer: Asian Week
notes.content:
Commanders!

[list]
[*]     ZTZ-20 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Boxer CRV Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle
[*]     Australian Boxer skin for Boxer CRV
[*]     QN-506 Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer
[*]    VT-5 Tier 9 Premium Light Tank
[*]     Type 96B Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Seahawks Battle Coins
[*]     Commander Loot Crate
[/list]

[b]Between December 12 and December 19, 2024[/b], the following items will be available:

[h3]ZTZ-20[/h3]
 

The ZTZ-20 is a fictional Chinese Main Battle Tank for the 21st century. It combines western influences with some ideas taken from the T-14 Armata. You can read about its (real and fictional) history in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-ztz-20][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url]

[img]https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_no_text_1.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the ZTZ-20 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. On its own, it’s a beast of a machine and one of the most powerful vehicles in the game, featuring both a powerful gun and thick armor. It does have a special feature though – its missiles can cover a wide area with burning White Phosphorus that reduces enemy vehicle camouflage and deals damage to anyone entering the zone.

The ZTZ-20 MBT is available [url=https://aw.my.games/web-shop][b]in our Web Shop via Loot Crates.[/b][/url] Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

 
[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png[/img][/url]
 

[h2]Boxer CRV[/h2]

The Boxer CRV is the Infantry Fighting Vehicle variant of the Boxer platform, featuring a cutting edge turret with 30mm autocannon and guided missiles. It is a truly next-gen IFV with orders coming from all over the world, most notably from Australia and Germany. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-boxer-crv]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/568fcf428eecab67094421d50359c27f302969a0.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Boxer CRV is a Tier 9 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It is one of the best IFVs in its class, offering a combination of solid mobility and great firepower, including Mechanized Infantry deployment and the dreaded double-launch ATGM feature.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png[/img][/url]


[h3]Australian Boxer Bundle[/h3]

In addition to the Boxer CRV Tier 9 Premium AFV, we have prepared a special skin for it that transforms it into a vehicle used by the Australian military with the appropriate camouflage, markings and all that. You can read more about it in our dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/aad89a710f3c901fa859c1ae011361a76e0531ba.png[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Australian Boxer Bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Australian Boxer
[*]     3 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png[/img][/url]


[h3]VT-5[/h3]

The VT-5 is a modern Chinese Light Tank that was developed specifically with export in mind. There are many reasons why a country without its own tank development should opt to purchase a Light Tank instead of a full-scale Main Battle Tank. It’s equally as fast if not faster with equal firepower but, what is most important, it is affordable. The VT-5 excels in all these categories. While its armor cannot match that of an MBT, it can protect its crew against most infantry threats thanks to its ERA and cage armor sets. It also has a powerful 105mm gun capable of firing guided missiles, it is packed with advanced electronics and is supremely agile thanks to its 1000hp diesel engine. Simply put, wraps cutting edge technologies up into an affordable bundle. You can learn more about it in a [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-vt-5]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ba83e31c15aeec168c095c03c389f1f0c34263ca.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the VT-5 is a very powerful Tier 9 Premium Light Tank. Fast and agile, it features solid levels of protection (the configuration in the game is the one featuring the ERA kit as well as the turret cage armor) and a good rate of fire. Additionally, its gun is capable of firing guided missiles. It’s an ideal machine for players who value speed and agility, as it offers plenty of both. The VT-5 is capable of dancing around its opponents on the battlefield, outperforming even some AFVs in mobility.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png[/img][/url]



[h3]QN-506[/h3]

The QN-506 fire support vehicle is a Chinese attempt to design a cheap, export-oriented alternative to the Russian BMPT series. Instead of converting a second or third generation MBT, the engineers at Wuhan Guide Infrared Co., Ltd., likely to keep the vehicle as affordable as possible, opted to base their project on the Type 59 MBT, which is, in its basic form anyway, a copy of the old Soviet T-55 medium tank from the late 1950s. They jam-packed it with cutting edge electronics and a number of weapon systems, including ATGMs, an automatic cannon or smaller caliber rockets. However, despite the use of an unmanned turret, the protection levels of this vehicle are still quite low and, so far, there haven’t been any signs of interest in the QN-506. You can learn more about this vehicle in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-qn-506]dedicated article.[/url]

[previewyoutube=omzaADMKUck;full][/previewyoutube]

In Armored Warfare, the QN-506 is a Premium Tier 9 Tank Destroyer that gameplay-wise resembles the popular BMPT series. However, unlike the Russian Terminators, it has a number of interesting features including tree different weapon systems (30mm cannon, 70mm unguided rockets and 151mm ATGMs) and loitering recon ammunition flying towards the end of a map and spotting everything in its path. The last ability is unique to the QN-506 and makes it one of the most potent support vehicles on the battlefield.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://aw.my.games/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]



[h3]Type 96B[/h3]

The Type 96B MBT, as its name suggests, is an evolution of the Type 96A, featuring such elements as an upgraded fire control system and a much more powerful engine, resulting in considerably better mobility and speed. Unlike the Type 96A, however, the Type 96B is a prototype, designed for the Chinese military team to use during the annual Tank Biathlon event in Russia. In 2017, the Chinese team won the second place, being defeated only by Russia. You can learn more about its history in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-type-96b][b]dedicated article![/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7775377e2c5c2d4ffa109b70f8a7b2871ec78f3d.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Type 96B is a Tier 8 Premium Main Battle Tank. Gameplay-wise, it’s very agile and fast for its class and uses advanced ammunition, making it highly suitable for players who prefer mobility over armor protection, even though it can take a lot of punishment as well.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://aw.my.games/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h3]Seahawks Battle Coins[/h3]

This week, we are offering you an opportunity to [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/seahawks-battle-path-now-available]boost your Battle Path[/url] progress and get that main prize you know you want – the XK3 Phantom Tier 10 Premium MBT!

[previewyoutube=0eIOgp52xNI;full][/previewyoutube]

The following Battle Coin bundles are available:

[list]
[*]     1.000 Battle Coins (10% off)
[*]     5.000 Battle Coins (15% off)
[*]     10.000 Battle Coins (25% off)
[*]     25.000 Battle Coins (35% off)

[/list]

Battle Coins can be used for a number of things, including:

Please note: In order to use Battle Coins, you need to obtain the access to the Seahawks Battle Path.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://aw.my.games/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h3]Commander Loot Crate[/h3]

This week, we’ve prepared another special offer for you in the form of a brand new Commander Loot Crate, featuring, amongst other things, some of the rarest commanders in the game!

notes.title: Coming soon: Cold as Ice
notes.content:
Commanders!

Is your heart cold as ice right about now from all that chilly weather? Allow us to warm it up with a special event featuring Seahawks Battle Coins and other great things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/57045ef56641157e19db6678175faebc8cd1f617.jpg[/img]

This event will start tomorrow morning and will be available until January 12, 2025. Its rules are, once again, very simple. You can participate simply by destroying 5 enemy vehicles in PvE (or 1 in PvP) every day (while driving a Tier 3 vehicle or higher) in order to receive a reward.

But what is the theme, you might ask? Well, dear players, it’s you. All those times you posted things like “wouldn’t it be nice if we had this flag or that decal” and thought we couldn’t possibly be listening? As it turns out, were in fact were – and here’s the evidence. Let’s take a look at some of the prizes:

[b]Cheese camouflage[/b] – all those times you likened Object 490 to a slice of cheese? Well, now you can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/548c81e10d5267aeff661479f97260333de2089d.jpg[/img]

[b]Ice Storm camouflage[/b] – this wasn’t requested by you per se, but it still is a very nice pattern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/100de3a88ca4b0c4e6129645d5462f4a23686ed6.jpg[/img]

[b]Flag of Yugoslavia[/b] – both a decal and a flag, as requested quite a few times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/bb2f1f487ec9c19a9ab75539c68675e710d6a349.jpg[/img]

[b]Googly Eyes[/b] – this decal is just perfect for the Abrams, isn’t it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/276c3cece65562de0cbcf8f024bebddfd0985ece.jpg[/img]

[b]White Lancers[/b] – at long last, the emblem of this Polish PMC from Armored Warfare lore is making an appearance. That one is a real blast from the past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/422b19f009fc91796d2a54ced03d2823d694f862.jpg[/img]

There’s more, of course, but we don’t want to spoil everything just now. Is there anything else you’d like to see in the game in the future? Let us know on Discord and we’ll take a look. But for the time being:

[b]Please note[/b]:

[list]
[*] This event may run concurrently with other events and is available to all players
[*] You may only complete one objective per day
[*] The event starts on December 12, 2024 and ends on January 12, 2025
[/list]

We hope that you will enjoy this event and will see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Update 0.247 Now Available
notes.content:
Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.247[/b] is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4c8c80e61a3b228be4287d217f51cd1645f9f844.jpg[/img]

[h2]List of Update 0.247 Changes[/h2]

[b]Progress Boost for Vehicles[/b]

All progression vehicles now offer special bundles in exchange for Gold that will instantly boost that vehicle’s progress to maximum. If you have some progress accumulated on a vehicle, the bundle gets progressively cheaper. See the screenshot above for an example. In connection with this feature, each progression vehicle’s “progression” section was moved to the top of its Upgrades window.

Please note that the bundle incorrectly states it offers “Reputation” instead of the correct “Experience” – this will be fixed.

[b]Seahawks Battle Path[/b]

In this update, we are correcting several issues of the Seahawks Battle Path and its vehicles:

[list]
[*] Fixed the Grimm’s Leadership mission description (the mission requires 17 completions as per the counter while the description stated 15)
[*] Fixed the Seahawk mission icon in the debriefing window
[*] VN20: Sentry turret kills are now displayed correctly in the UI
[*] XK3 Phantom: The Ambush ability is now set as a default one
[/list]

[b]XM2001 Crusader[/b]

This update is bringing the XM2001 Crusader Tier 10 Premium SPG (that is going to be available in the near future). You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xm2001-crusader]dedicated article[/url].

Please note that compared to the article, the vehicle gained two new abilities:

[list]
[*] M982 Excalibur guided HE shells
[*] Supercharged soft-kill APS
[/list]

[b]Additional Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b]

With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:

[list]
[*] Altay: Target lock for the top attack shells now has its correct sound
[*] Boxer RIWP: TOW turret no longer comes with partially loaded ATGMs
[*] Boxer RIWP: All base paints now work correctly with the Warhawk skin
[*] Boxer RIWP: Front of the vehicle now changes colors correctly based on the selected base paint on the Warhawk skin
[*] Boxer RIWP: Fixed the Warhawk skin battalion decal placement
[*] Boxer RIWP: Fixed numerous smaller visual issues of the Warhawk skin
[*] BMP-2M: Fixed the Volnorez visual model
[*] BMP-2M: Fixed the smoke grenade launcher visual model
[*] BMP-2M: Fixed the exhaust grille visual model
[*] BMP-2M: Fixed the missing textures on a destroyed visual model
[*] BMP-2M: Fixed many other smaller visual issues
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed the camouflage layout of this vehicle
[*] BTR-82A: Double missile launch module is no longer getting randomly removed
[*] BTR-82A: Roadwheels no longer clip into the suspension
[*] BTR-82A: Turret parts such as the machinegun can no longer be fired through
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed the headlight visual effect
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed an issue where the wheels didn’t connect with the ground properly
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed several texture issues (rubber parts in the front, shading in the back)
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed the gunfire visual effect
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed many other smaller visual issues
[*] Challenger 2 ATDU: Fixed the Desert Rat and Honey Badger skin icons
[*] K2 Black Panther: Target lock for the top attack shells now has its correct sound
[*] KF41 Lynx Prototype: Fixed several texture issues
[*] KF41 Lynx Prototype: Added the correct model of door and troop compartment
[*] KF51 Panther: Fixed the rear light appearance
[*] M1128 Stryker: Fixed the destroyed model appearance
[*] M60A3 SLEP: Fixed the gun position
[*] MPF Light Tank: Fixed the gun position
[*] T-15 Armata: Fixed an issue where the vehicle started matches on desert maps covered in dirt
[*] T-90M Proryv: Fixed the camouflage layout of this vehicle
[*] T-90M Proryv: Fixed the excessive dirt on certain graphics settings
[*] T-90M Proryv: Rear turret ERA no longer clips into the turret
[*] T-90M Proryv: Suspension is now correctly animated
[*] T-90M Proryv: Fixed numerous other smaller visual issues
[*] TTB: Fixed the gun module size so that it cannot be damaged when firing outside of the turret
[*] XM1A3: Trophy Next Gen module is now correctly localized
[/list]

[b]General Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed several more reasons causing the game to crash

[*] Added a number of new assets for future events
[/list]

[list]
[*] KF41 Lynx Prototype Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle
[*] Lynx Skyranger Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle
[*] Namer Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer
[/list]

[b]Between December 9 to December 16[/b], 2024, the following items will be available:

[h2]KF41 Lynx Prototype[/h2]

This is a 2018 prototype of the KF41 Lynx, a cutting edge IFV developed by Rheinmetall for export. Featuring advanced modular armor and multiple gun configurations, the vehicle has already been adopted by Hungary with more contracts pending. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kf41-lynx-prototype]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c1a454ebf75357a2899defc02d10db91504b5ec2.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the KF41 Lynx Prototype is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It is a durable and powerful IFV featuring two weapon configurations (30mm and 35mm) as well as a new infantry type that fires large thermobaric warheads from its anti-tank launchers.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://arwar.co/3ZxTaa5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Lynx Skyranger[/h2]

This is a version of the cutting edge Lynx platform but instead of the standard IFV configuration, it utilizes the Skyranger HEL turret to create a short-range anti-aircraft vehicle that can also eliminate drone swarms with ease. This configuration was proposed for the recent Hungarian military upgrade program but never built in real life. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-lynx-skyranger]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/df9652506b6a6b2da91fa315d228e0ab46cfe4d2.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Lynx Skyranger is a Tier 10 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. It’s best used as a scout killer but it is capable of other roles as well. It features three rather unusual abilities, such as the programmable HE ammunition that explodes above targets, the Starstreak missiles that deal more damages over larger distances and ignore APS, and the High Energy Laser active ability. When activated, the laser blinds enemy targets, significantly reducing their spotting range. You can learn more about these abilities from our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/developer-diary-lynx-skyranger-update]developer diary[/url].

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://arwar.co/3ZxTaa5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Namer[/h2]

The Namer IFV is an Israeli heavy fighting vehicle version of the Namer platform developed in the early 2000s from the Merkava Main Battle Tank. Israel is a small country and cannot affect high infantry losses, which is why the Namer features extremely high levels of protection. The IFV variant is fitted with a Rafael turret, featuring 30mm autocannon and a Spike missile launcher. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-namer]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/18bec5a795ece21d5003970a995e59485c4e0700.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Namer is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer. As its history suggests, it is a superheavy TD with its protection levels being amongst the highest of its class. It is slow and ponderous but its thick front can deflect even advanced shells while maintaining adequate firepower thanks to its autocannon and ATGM combination. Its MBT-like characteristics make this vehicle quite forgiving for new players, but, as they say, a jack-of-all-trades is a master of none.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://arwar.co/3ZxTaa5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Offer: Object 195 and Object 490
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:

[list]
[*]     Object 490 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Object 195 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Kurganets-25 Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer
[*]     Msta-S Tier 9 Premium Self-Propelled Gun
[*]     Khrizantema-S Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer
[*]     Object 787 Gadyuka Tier 6 Premium Tank Destroyer
[*]     Iron Crate
[/list]

[b]Between December 6 and December 12, 2024[/b], the following items will be available:

[h2]Object 490[/h2]

The Object 490 Main Battle Tank was an advanced concept from the waning days of the Soviet Union. Designed in the 1980s, it represented a radical departure from the MBT paradigm. Its distinct wedge-like shape, along with the fact that the crew was located in the back, offered unparalleled levels of protection. But the most interesting part of the design was its double suspension paired with two engines, allowing the vehicle to stay mobile even after suffering significant damage. However, the conclusion of the Cold War put an end to this design, along with many other advanced Soviet projects. You can learn more about this vehicle in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-490]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/2e2adcd3c49d8704aeb85eaff8db8ff4383d7f94.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Object 490 Tier 10 Premium MBT is perhaps the best armored vehicle in the game. It’s a true behemoth that is almost impossible to slow down, let alone knock out, and concentrated effort is required to stop one of these things when encountering them on the battlefield. The combination of extremely thick armor and a powerful 152mm gun makes this tank incredibly deadly, even though these advantages are balanced by its mediocre agility and the fact that its gun is only forward facing. This MBT is ideal for you if you prefer slow, methodical advances while dealing massive amounts of damage with each shot. If you keep your flanks secure, you’ll be all but impossible to stop.

The Object 490 MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Object 195[/h2]

The Object 195 Main Battle Tank is one of the 1980s Soviet supertanks, intended to fight the next generation of NATO MBTs. It was developed in Nizhny Tagil by the experienced Uralvagonzavod design bureau (UKBTM), which was responsible for such legendary tanks as the T-72 and T-90. Much like other such prototypes, it was designed to be armed with massive 152mm smoothbore cannon in an unmanned turret. A single prototype was built and it allegedly passed state trials between 2008 and 2010 but the project was discontinued due to a lack of financing. You can learn more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-195]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f433540942807b4e4c5bc76352306795ff8b869f.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Object 195 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank and one of the most versatile vehicles you can get your hands on thanks to a combination of excellent armor, unmanned turret, 152mm hard-hitting gun and one special feature – the coaxial 30mm autocannon that allows you to take out unarmored targets without having to waste a shot of your main weapon.

The Object 195 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Kurganets-25[/h2]

The Kurganets-25 Infantry Fighting Vehicle is intended as a cutting edge future replacement to the old BMP series in Russian service. While not as chunky and expensive as the T-15 Armata super-heavy IFV, it’s designed to finally offer the 21st century protection levels the Russian military has been demanding for a long time. However, the design turned out to be quite expensive and while it is currently undergoing state trials, it is unlikely to be ever mass-produced. You can learn more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kurganets-25]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7cd4132b7354c2c73d0579f849ee533d2b139d45.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Kurganets-25 is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. Even though it offers decent protection and mobility for its class, this vehicle is all about firepower. To make sure you always have the right tool for the job, it comes with three distinctive weapon systems – a 57mm autocannon for light targets, fast and small Bulat missiles for highly mobile targets and, finally, full-sized ATGMs that can defeat pretty much anything on the battlefield. If dealing damage is your thing, few vehicles will match your playstyle better.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Msta-S[/h2]

The Msta-S SPG was developed as a replacement to the older 2S3 Akatsiya. The goal was to match (or surpass) the newly developed NATO artillery pieces with long 155mm guns. The production began in 1988 and is currently ongoing with a modernized variant rolling out for the Russian military. More than 500 Msta-S SPGs are still in Russian service and dozens were exported to several other countries. It has seen some combat during the Second Chechen War and the War in Donbass. You can learn more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-msta-s]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/61932c3ad5a85a75daab342a114edfde5486e4e6.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Msta-S is a Tier 9 Self-Propelled Gun, which makes it only usable in the Global Operations mode and in PvE. It comes with two shell types – a slow-flying one with a high flight arc, and a fast-flying one for use against more mobile targets.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Khrizantema-S[/h2]

The Khrizantema-S is a dedicated tank hunter, built on a modified BMP-3 hull. The first Khrizantema-S prototype appeared in public as early as 1996 with the initial production variant (9P157) entering service in 2005. Around 2010, an upgraded variant called 9P157-2 appeared with a modernized Ukrainian optics system and a hull machinegun the original model lacked. This variant was in use until 2017. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-khrizantema-s]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5dbccbbbb9a0142e8fb084f050977b5b227f13a1.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Khizantema-S is a Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer. It is quite a stealthy vehicle armed with a twin ATGM launcher. The key to achieving excellent results with this machine is long-range ATGM sniping followed by rapid relocation. The missiles are quite powerful and make hits easy thanks to their excellent performance.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Gadyuka[/h2]

The Gadyuka (“Viper”) is a Soviet-era fire support vehicle consisting of a T-72A hull and turret but instead of the main gun, the vehicle is armed with two 30mm autocannons and two rocket pods in order to perform better against infantry in urban and mountainous environments. A single prototype was built in 1996 and even though the project was cancelled, it eventually led to the rise of the BMPT Terminator series. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-787-gadyuka]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/1d2b58128ca5512191f0d83b4b87e00be74b72bb.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Gadyuka is a Tier 6 Premium Tank Destroyer. Despite having only average protection, its two 30mm autocannons can, along with deadly rocket salvos, rip through enemy vehicles with ease. Indeed, the Gadyuka is one of the most destructive vehicles of its Tier and a worthy addition to every player’s arsenal.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Iron Crate[/h2]

We’ve prepared for you an additional offer this week. The [b]Iron Crate[/b] is available in our Web Shop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/942f092081cb583c76d71a3315ee4cda42d6a505.jpg[/img]

This crate allows you to win a Tier 4 to Tier 10 Premium vehicle (or its value in Gold if you have it already). The crate contains some very rare vehicles, including:

[list]
[*]     ZTL-11 Tier 9 Premium TD
[*]     VN17 Tier 8 Premium AFV
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Future of the Shockwave Mode
notes.content:
Commanders!

The initial pre-Season of the [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/shockwave-update-now-available]Shockwave mode[/url] (Season 0) is now over and the mode is no longer available for the time being. Tens of thousands of you participated in Season 0 and the mode was amongst the most popular in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/748721a6bc7904e0a493ee9cc86f353059b2e541.png[/img]

But there’s no denying there has been a lot of criticism raised, as [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/seahawks-battle-path-prize-highlights]addressed in our latest article[/url]. 
Specifically:

[list]
[*]     The mode forces players into close combat inside the capture circle, soon resulting in incredibly difficult and hectic melee suitable for only a handful of vehicles (this is definitely something we’ll address)
[*]     Some AI opponents are clearly too toxic and not fun to fight, be it those dealing unavoidable damage (AbramsX, Boxer RIWP) or capable of destroying player vehicles with one shot (T-15 Lieutenants)
[*]     Performance issues do exist for many players, especially during later waves
[*]     The base layout is not ideal and makes defense more difficult than intended
[*]     The amount of some rewarded currencies is clearly a bit too high
[*]     Ammo does not refill outside of the base
[*]     Mode statistics (losses) count towards general player statistics and are spoiling them
[/list]

So, what happens now? The good news is, we’ve already begun our work on the next iteration of the mode that will bring major updates to it, including:

[list]
[*]     Different gameplay addressing the issues above
[*]     Making all classes be usable in this mode
[*]     New rewards
[*]     Ladder system to compare your results
[/list]

And much more.

However, that all will take some time and we expect the next iteration of the mode to be ready by spring 2025.

While you wait, we’ll have more amazing new features for you to enjoy, including the second part of the Shockwave update that’s bringing the long-awaited [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-drones-and-anti-drone-defense]Drones mechanic[/url]. We’ll tell you more about those in a bit.

For now, thank you for staying with us and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Offer: Tier 10 Direct Sales
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today we’ve prepared the following items for you (directly available, no loot crates):
[list]
[*]     Challenger 2 Streetfighter II Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Armata 152 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[/list]
Between [b]December 2 to December 9, 2024[/b], the following items will be available:

[h2]Armata 152[/h2]

The Armata 152 is a version of the T-14 Armata, armed with larger cannon. One of the upgrades considered for the T-14 Armata was the increase of its caliber to 152mm in order to absolutely, positively destroy anything with the first shot. The 2A83 smoothbore is a behemoth of a gun, designed in the last days of the Soviet empire for the next generation of super-tanks. It’s massive, heavy and quite costly to produce, but, most importantly, it was never truly needed to deal with the western MBTs since the standard 125mm guns were (and still are) up to the task. That is why it never found its way on any Soviet MBT with even the standard T-14 Armata being armed with an improved 125mm cannon. You can, however, experience its awesome firepower in Armored Warfare! Learn more about it in a [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/overkill-152mm-cannons-russian-mbts]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/543121b5b57b3b962c6ed51ec05accf900f10fb3.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the T-14 Armata 152 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. While not firing as fast as its 125mm counterpart, the 152mm rounds do enormous damage, often eliminating weaker opponents with a single shot. And then there’s the platform itself – the Armata, the most modern Main Battle Tank in the world. Earn it and use it to dominate!

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://arwar.co/3ZxTaa5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Challenger 2 Streetfighter II[/h2]

The Streetfighter II is an upgrade program to overhaul the venerable Challenger 2 Main Battle Tank for the conditions of modern battlefields, especially urban combat. It features a number of improvements and extra components, most notably a dozer blade, a Brimstone ATGM twin launcher and an advanced camera system by Elbit. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-challenger-2-streetfighter-ii]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/0c9d0afead2c90737c2536c06fb3baed390ab564.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Challenger 2 Streetfighter is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Its main advantages include excellent frontal armor (enhanced by the presence of its dozer blade covering its lower frontal plate), increased ramming damage and long range lethality, courtesy of a powerful ATGM launcher. Whether you desire to bring the fighting up close or support other MBTs at distance, the Streetfighter’s got your back.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://arwar.co/3ZxTaa5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:

See you on the battlefield!
