notes.title: Caribbean Crisis: Story So Far
notes.content:
Commanders!

Armored Warfare features a storyline you can participate it by playing the [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-special-operations][b]Special Operations[/b][/url] mode.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qVRcV-gD9QU

Now it’s time to review the events that took place before the introduction of the fourth Caribbean Crisis story arc mission!

[h1]Before the Storm[/h1] 

The world of 2042 is a broken one with corporations usurping much of the world’s resources and former superpowers like the United States of America are but a shadow of their former glory. This is a result of decades of deterioration, greed and unbridled exploitation of the most powerful consortiums, some of which are wealthier than entire continents combined. These corporations control private mercenary armies, equipped with all kinds of weaponry short of nuclear. Entire divisions of armored vehicles are at their disposal, ready to do their master’s bidding – not out of patriotism or loyalty, but for Credits – the universal currency of the new world. To read about the world of Armored Warfare, please visit [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/lore-world-armored-warfare][b]our dedicated article.[/b][/url]

In the late 2030s, a series of conflicts that would eventually become known as the Corporate Wars devastated large portions of Europe and the United States. Several major corporations including the British Clayburn Industries and the German Lodestar GmbH engaged in conflicts that left massive territories in corporate hands. Mercenaries, private security forces and rebel militias fought each other all over central Europe and the Balkans. The years of strife culminated in the 2039 Seahawk Rebellion when an entire battalion-sized unit of Clayburn Industries rose up against orders to commit genocide.

Unbeknownst to them, the uprising was in fact a clever ruse prepared by the mastermind behind the Clayburn Industries Corporation, Andrew Clayburn, to gain more influence across the world. Employing the services of a Corporate Wars veteran Sebastian Grimm known for his campaign against Clayburn’s rival, Lodestar GmbH, Clayburn’s plan worked almost flawlessly, resulting in thousands of dead enemies and a massive territory and wealth influx for the company, including a portion of the former American south. The handful of surviving Seahawks retreated to Istanbul, reduced to a life in shadows.

Now, two years later, you, commander, are amongst the mercenaries tasked with protecting the Clayburn Industries facility in the Mojave Desert against unknown assailants...

[h1]The Caribbean Crisis[/h1] 

[b]Chapter 1 – Attack[/b]
[list][*]Date: September 6, 2042[/*][*]Location: Mojave Desert[/*][/list]
Your mercenary unit was hired by the ISD (an international security organization overseeing the legal mercenary groups) to investigate a Clayburn Industries facility deep in the Mojave Desert, which suddenly felt silent. You find the facility abandoned, save for a mysterious group of assailants, led by a man who introduces himself as Magnus Holter. While investigating the area, it becomes clear that the mysterious enemies are trying to loot it for chemical weapons. Despite your best efforts, Magnus Holter escapes with enough chlorine to wipe out an entire city.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/mis1.jpg[/img]

[b]Chapter 2 – Pursuit[/b]
[list][*]Date: September 15, 2042[/*][*]Location: Panama Canal[/*][/list]
The mysterious mercenaries from Mojave escaped with the chemical payload, but you are hot on their trail. Summoning an ISD-provided transport ship equipped with a Zubr landing craft, you pursue the assailants to the Panama Canal only to find the sluices blocked and protected by the same forces that previously attacked the Clayburn Industries plant. You defend the Zubr while opening one sluice after another in order to allow it to pass through while looking for clues. You find out that the mercenary ship you are pursuing made its way through the canal without any trouble on its way to Jamaica, only to be ambushed by Clayburn Industries security! Could the mercenaries be actually working with Clayburn?

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/mis2.jpg[/img]

[b]Chapter 3 – Threat from the Sea[/b]
[list][*]Date: September 17, 2042[/*][*]Location: Port Antonio, Jamaica[/*][/list]
Arriving at Port Antonio, you find out that the area is occupied by two unmarked enemy warships. The Zubr landing craft drops you off at the far side of the town but you soon find that the beautiful, tropical beaches of Jamaica are far deadlier than anyone would have thought. The town is occupied by mercenaries who not only have considerable forces stationed in the area, but also operate sophisticated equipment never previously seen on any battlefield, such as anti-aircraft lasers. The Zubr craft is taken out, leaving you only one way – forward. It turns out that the plan of the enemy commander, Magnus Holter, is, for reasons unknown, to destroy the town using a warhead made using the chemicals from the looted Clayburn facility.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/mis3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Caribbean Crisis: Story So Far
notes.content:
Commanders!

Armored Warfare features a storyline you can participate it by playing the [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-special-operations][b]Special Operations[/b][/url] mode.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qVRcV-gD9QU

Now it’s time to review the events that took place before the introduction of the fourth Caribbean Crisis story arc mission!

[h1]Before the Storm[/h1] 

The world of 2042 is a broken one with corporations usurping much of the world’s resources and former superpowers like the United States of America are but a shadow of their former glory. This is a result of decades of deterioration, greed and unbridled exploitation of the most powerful consortiums, some of which are wealthier than entire continents combined. These corporations control private mercenary armies, equipped with all kinds of weaponry short of nuclear. Entire divisions of armored vehicles are at their disposal, ready to do their master’s bidding – not out of patriotism or loyalty, but for Credits – the universal currency of the new world. To read about the world of Armored Warfare, please visit [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/lore-world-armored-warfare][b]our dedicated article.[/b][/url]

In the late 2030s, a series of conflicts that would eventually become known as the Corporate Wars devastated large portions of Europe and the United States. Several major corporations including the British Clayburn Industries and the German Lodestar GmbH engaged in conflicts that left massive territories in corporate hands. Mercenaries, private security forces and rebel militias fought each other all over central Europe and the Balkans. The years of strife culminated in the 2039 Seahawk Rebellion when an entire battalion-sized unit of Clayburn Industries rose up against orders to commit genocide.

Unbeknownst to them, the uprising was in fact a clever ruse prepared by the mastermind behind the Clayburn Industries Corporation, Andrew Clayburn, to gain more influence across the world. Employing the services of a Corporate Wars veteran Sebastian Grimm known for his campaign against Clayburn’s rival, Lodestar GmbH, Clayburn’s plan worked almost flawlessly, resulting in thousands of dead enemies and a massive territory and wealth influx for the company, including a portion of the former American south. The handful of surviving Seahawks retreated to Istanbul, reduced to a life in shadows.

Now, two years later, you, commander, are amongst the mercenaries tasked with protecting the Clayburn Industries facility in the Mojave Desert against unknown assailants...

[h1]The Caribbean Crisis[/h1] 

[b]Chapter 1 – Attack[/b]
[list][*]Date: September 6, 2042[/*][*]Location: Mojave Desert[/*][/list]
Your mercenary unit was hired by the ISD (an international security organization overseeing the legal mercenary groups) to investigate a Clayburn Industries facility deep in the Mojave Desert, which suddenly felt silent. You find the facility abandoned, save for a mysterious group of assailants, led by a man who introduces himself as Magnus Holter. While investigating the area, it becomes clear that the mysterious enemies are trying to loot it for chemical weapons. Despite your best efforts, Magnus Holter escapes with enough chlorine to wipe out an entire city.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/mis1.jpg[/img]

[b]Chapter 2 – Pursuit[/b]
[list][*]Date: September 15, 2042[/*][*]Location: Panama Canal[/*][/list]
The mysterious mercenaries from Mojave escaped with the chemical payload, but you are hot on their trail. Summoning an ISD-provided transport ship equipped with a Zubr landing craft, you pursue the assailants to the Panama Canal only to find the sluices blocked and protected by the same forces that previously attacked the Clayburn Industries plant. You defend the Zubr while opening one sluice after another in order to allow it to pass through while looking for clues. You find out that the mercenary ship you are pursuing made its way through the canal without any trouble on its way to Jamaica, only to be ambushed by Clayburn Industries security! Could the mercenaries be actually working with Clayburn?

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/mis2.jpg[/img]

[b]Chapter 3 – Threat from the Sea[/b]
[list][*]Date: September 17, 2042[/*][*]Location: Port Antonio, Jamaica[/*][/list]
Arriving at Port Antonio, you find out that the area is occupied by two unmarked enemy warships. The Zubr landing craft drops you off at the far side of the town but you soon find that the beautiful, tropical beaches of Jamaica are far deadlier than anyone would have thought. The town is occupied by mercenaries who not only have considerable forces stationed in the area, but also operate sophisticated equipment never previously seen on any battlefield, such as anti-aircraft lasers. The Zubr craft is taken out, leaving you only one way – forward. It turns out that the plan of the enemy commander, Magnus Holter, is, for reasons unknown, to destroy the town using a warhead made using the chemicals from the looted Clayburn facility.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/mis3.jpg[/img]

You take the city after a tough fight and now it is the enemy commander who is left with no choice but to evacuate to a nearby island where the last of the mercenary forces are seemingly entrenched. In the midst of a heated battle to take the AA positions on the island, you see three Clayburn Industries fighter jets arrive and take out the enemy warships, followed by a forced landing of a Clayburn Industries kill team. It’s clear you’re in for the fight of your lives.

[b]To be continued in Chapter 4 – Exfiltration, now available in Armored Warfare....[/b]

notes.title: Celebrating the International Women’s Day
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today, we are celebrating the [b]International Women’s Day.[/b] While armored vehicles are typically associated with men, it’s a known fact that ladies can kick some armored ass too!

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/mainbanner_0.png[/img]

Armored Warfare features several unique commanders, each with a different back story and play style.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/sabbanner_0.png[/img]

[b]Sabrina Washington[/b] was born in San Diego, USA, as a daughter of an electronic specialist for the Pacific Fleet before its disbandment. She’s driven and goal oriented if somewhat inflexible. In Armored Warfare, she’s one of the entry commanders and, while relatively universal, she is suitable for scout and sniper vehicles.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/freybanner_0.png[/img]

[b]Freja Højbjerg[/b] is, on the other hand, a rather advanced commander. Hailing from Denmark, she was originally a U.N. peacekeeper before realizing that the U.N. was an ineffective, defunct organization. In Armored Warfare, she’s an effective artillery commander, although her perk field can also be configured for long range sniping, especially effective with HE and HESH rounds.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/erinbanner_0.png[/img]

[b]Erin O’Connell[/b] is an advanced Premium commander. Born in Ireland, she first tried to join the Irish Naval Service to follow her father’s footsteps only to almost immediately discover her love armored vehicles. She’s devoted, loyal and keen-sighted, making her one of the best scout commanders in the game. She’s occasionally available in the Web Shop or during various events.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/greybanner_0.png[/img]

[b]Kathryn Grey[/b] is an advanced reward commander that was available during the Storyline Campaign in 2017. She’s a wild, untamed and impulsive woman, although her time spent with Joshua Seagrove tempered her attitude a bit. Surviving the ill-fated Seahawk expedition to the United States of America, she currently resides incognito in Istanbul. She’s a capable close-range damage-oriented Main Battle Tank commander – the more her vehicle is damaged, the more damage she’s capable of dishing out.

Do any of these dangerous ladies command your vehicles? You now have a chance to show that by obtaining and equipping one of the three International decals we’ve prepared for you!

[b]Between March 8 and March 13, 2018:[/b]
[list][*]Win 1 battle in any mode to receive a March Flowers decal[/*][*]Win 5 battles in any mode to receive a Teddy Bear decal[/*][*]Win 15 battles in PvP, Global Operations or Special Operations to receive a High Heel Shoe decal[/*][/list]
But that’s not all. It’s time to treat your lady commanders with something nice because we’ve also prepared the following missions for you:
[list][*]Win 3 battles in any mode to receive a Gold Loot Crate[/*][*]Win 7 battles in PvP, Global Operations or Special Operations to receive 5 Improved Fire Extinguisher Consumables[/*][*]Win 10 battles in PvP, Global Operations or Special Operations to receive 5 Platinum Commander Insignia Tokens[/*][/list]
[b]Please note:[/b]
[list][*]This event starts on March 8, 16:00 CET (7 AM PST)[/*][*]This event ends on March 13, 16:00 CET (7 AM PST)[/*][/list]
[b]We hope that you will enjoy this event and will see you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Introducing the new Feedback Hub
notes.content:
Commanders!

We at My.com are dedicated to reading and listening to your opinions and reports regarding all game-related matters, which is why, today, we are introducing a brand new [b]Feedback Hub![/b]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/aw-1920x1080.jpg[/img]

The Feedback Hub features an easy to use interface that allows us to pass your opinions or issue reports to an appropriate developer faster than ever before.

It is available on this address: [url=http://go.aw.my.com/FeedbackHub][b]http://go.aw.my.com/FeedbackHub[/b][/url]

Please follow these steps to make sure your feedback reaches its intended destination:
[list][*]Select the correct product (Armored Warfare or Armored Warfare PS4)[/*][*]Select the correct category (Feedback & Suggestions or Bug Report)[/*][*]Select the topic you want to submit your information on[/*][*]Provide your feedback, link to media (for example screenshots or video) and, optionally, your contact information[/*][/list]
Make sure that your feedback is brief and on point – it makes it much easier to act upon it!

[b]Please note:[/b]
[list][*]The feedback is reviewed directly by the Armored Warfare development team, please use appropriate language[/*][*]There is a 1200 character limit on feedback submissions[/*][*]Bug reports require the inclusion of reproduction steps[/*][*]Evidence (videos, screenshots) always helps[/*][/list]
We hope that you will like this new system and, as always:

[b]Thank you for your feedback![/b]

notes.title: Offer: Razor-Sharp
notes.content:
Commanders!

Some say that entering the battlefields of Armored Warfare is great for taking an edge off – but why would you ever want to do that? Be proud of your edge; display it for all to see! Introducing the sharp-looking SAW vehicle edition, consisting of:
[list][*][b]Merkava IID SAW[/b] Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank (because there’s never enough of Merkava visual options)[/*][*][b]PTZ-89 SAW[/b] Tier 7 Premium Tank Destroyer[/*][/list]
Both of these vehicles come with unique, blade-themed camouflage and are guaranteed to cut a swathe through enemy tanks!

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_saws_banner.jpg[/img]

The SAW vehicles are now permanently available in the Web Shop, but from [b]March 6 to March 19, 2018[/b], they are also available in the following special bundles:

 
[h1]Merkava IID SAW[/h1]
 

The Merkava IID (also known as Mk.2D) is an advanced version of the standard Mk.2 Merkava, upgraded with a modular “Dor-Dalet” composite armor kit. It’s a tough and unyielding vehicle, featuring a number of battle-proven components such as its 105mm rifled cannon. The first version of the Merkava Mk.2 entered service in 1983 and the last vehicles were phased out in 2016 after thirty long years.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_saws_merkava_banner.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Merkava IID SAW is a very tough vehicle. It is not equipped with an explosive reactive armor kit, but is, nevertheless, a very tough customer due to the introduction of the additional armor, allowing it to take a lot of damage. Additionally, the tank is equipped with a Ready Rack mechanism, significantly increasing the rate of fire for the first four shots.

Aside from the permanent offer, it is available in the following bundles:

[b]Improved Bundle[/b] with 23% discount, containing:
[list][*]Merkava IID SAW Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank[/*][*]20 Gold Loot Crates[/*][*]15 Gold Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost Tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Crew Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Commander Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Credits Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Global Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]2.000 Gold[/*][/list]
[b]Prime Bundle[/b] with 40% discount, containing:
[list][*]Merkava IID SAW Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank[/*][*]20 Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]20 Platinum Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost Tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Crew Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Commander Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Credits Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Global Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]2.500 Gold[/*][/list]
 
[url=https://aw.my.com/web-shop][img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/webshop_button_v1.png[/img][/url]
 

 
[h1]PTZ-89 SAW[/h1]
 

Lacking any advanced main battle tanks in the 1980s as well as proper funding, China resorted to more creative means to destroy enemy MBTs, including gun-equipped tank destroyers. The PTZ-89, or Type 89, is one such vehicle. It was developed in the 1980s, but was only ever produced in small numbers. It was armed with an indigenous 120mm smoothbore gun with loading assistant. Its firepower was judged to be inferior to the Soviet 125mm smoothbore and the caliber was discontinued in the 1990s along with the production of this vehicle.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_saws_ptz-89_banner.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the PTZ-89 SAW Tier 7 Premium Tank Destroyer is an excellent tracked sniper. What it lacks in armor, it more than makes up for in its firepower, delivering lethal blows at long distances. It is quite mobile and easy to operate, a perfect addition for any vehicle collection.

Both SAW vehicles are also available in the [b]Saw’s Edge Bundle[/b] with 48% discount, containing:
[list][*]PTZ-89 SAW Tier 7 Premium Tank Destroyer[/*][*]Merkava IID SAW Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank[/*][*]25 Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]25 Platinum Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost Tokens[/*][*]10.000 Gold[/*][/list]

notes.title: Introducing Update 0.24 “Caribbean Crisis – Part II”
notes.content:
Commanders!

We are happy to announce [b]Update 0.24 “Caribbean Crisis – Part II”[/b], bringing a number of progression vehicles to the game along with a new dealer!

The main features of Update 0.24 “Caribbean Crisis – Part II” include:
[list][*]New dealer with a branch of light vehicles[/*][*]VT-4 Main Battle Tank[/*][*]New commander[/*][*]Final mission of the first Special Operation[/*][*]New map “Alpine Valley” for Global Operations[/*][/list]
 
[h1]New Dealer[/h1] 

In this update, we’re introducing a new dealer called Oscar Faraday. Born in Warwick, Great Britain, Oscar Faraday is the epitome of a British gentleman. But don’t let his smooth look and calm demeanor fool you – he’s one of the most dangerous people on the planet. Trained by the famous British MI5 secret service, he learned to appreciate finesse, preferring stealth over brute force during his decades-long career as His Majesty’s cold-hearted killer.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/faraday.jpg[/img] 

His choice of vehicles reflects his nature – he offers machines capable taking out targets quickly but, most importantly, silently. Many of his machines also have unique features, described in existing or upcoming detailed articles.

These vehicles include:
[list][*][b]Tier 5 AFV:[/b] Rooikat ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-rooikat][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][*][b]Tier 6 TD:[/b] EE-18 Sucuri II ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-ee-18-sucuri-ii][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][*][b]Tier 7 TD:[/b] NM142 ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-nm142][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][*][b]Tier 8 TD:[/b] Sprut-SD ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-sprut-sd][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][*][b]Tier 8 Premium LT:[/b] ASCOD LT-105 ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-ascod-lt-105][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][*][b]Tier 10 LT:[/b] K21 XC8 ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-k21-xc8][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][/list]
Another Tier 10 Tank Destroyer, the [url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-kornet-em][b]Kornet EM[/b][/url], will appear in one of the 0.24 updates, coming in the near future!

[b]Gallery [/b] 

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/rooikat_0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/sucuri.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/nm.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/sprut.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/k21.jpg[/img]

Each of these vehicles is unique to a degree. The Rooikat is slow for its Tier and Class, but it is well armored and has high view range, making it a potent passive scout. The Sucuri II on the other hand is a classic wheeled Tank Destroyer. Its unique ability is its Boomerang suspension, allowing it to reach places where other wheeled vehicles couldn’t go. The NM142 Tank Destroyer is, on the other hand, a typical missile carrier. It is unique in its ability to fire Top Attack missiles that target thin roof armor. This makes it an excellent tool in your fight against static entrenched MBTs. The Tier 8 Sprut-SD is a very agile tracked vehicle with a powerful gun but with very thin armor – in skilled hands, it becomes a truly deadly tool. And, last but not least, there’s the K21 XC8 Light Tank that can use the Designate Target AFV ability and is perhaps the best vehicle in the game when it comes to fast flanking maneuvers.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/ascod_0.jpg[/img]

The [b]ASCOD LT-105 Premium Light Tank[/b], also available in the game for Gold, is the first premium vehicle on which you can select one of two alternative turrets – either a manned one that is larger but has better ammunition, or an unmanned one that can fire in bursts but is inferior in penetration and accuracy.

This dealer himself is also unique in several aspects.

First, it does not start on Tier 1, but on Tier 5 with the Rooikat AFV. In order to start unlocking his vehicles, players have to own at least one Tier 5 progression vehicle.

Secondly, ingame Reputation is not used as the primary currency for this dealer. In order to unlock each vehicle, certain goals (achievements) have to be completed. For example, to unlock the Tier 6 Rooikat, one of the following conditions has to be met:
[list][*]Deal 75.000 damage using a Tier 5 or higher Light Tank in PvP[/*][*]Deal 300.000 damage using a Tier 5 or higher Light Tank in Global Operations[/*][*]Deal 600.000 damage using a Tier 5 or higher Light Tank in PvE[/*][/list]
The progression is also not strictly linear:
[list][*]Tier 5, Tier 6 and Tier 7 vehicles can be unlocked independently on each other by completing their achievements[/*][*]Tier 8 vehicle is available to unlock once all three previous vehicles are unlocked[/*][*]Tier 10 vehicles are available to unlock once all four previous vehicles are unlocked[/*][/list]
[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/avatar_animated.png[/img]

Once unlocked, each vehicle is upgraded by standard means, although, apart from modules, the new vehicles offer a number of interesting bonuses unlockable for Reputation, including:
[list][*]Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]Base colors[/*][*]Camouflage patterns[/*][*]Decals[/*][*]Player titles[/*][*]Player avatars[/*][*]Unique commander[/*][/list]
We hope that you will enjoy this new dealer and his vehicles!
 
[h1]VT-4 Main Battle Tank[/h1] 

In Update 0.24, we are also introducing one new progression Tier 8 Main Battle Tank to Zhang Feng’s vehicle pool – the [b]Tier 8 VT-4![/b]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/vt4_0.jpg[/img]

The VT-4 is a modern Chinese export vehicle. Armed with a 125mm smoothbore gun, it currently represents the best any country without its own tank development program can buy on an open market. You can read more about it in a [url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-vt-4][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url]

 
[b]Gallery [/b]
 

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/vt41.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/vt42_0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/vt43.jpg[/img]

 

 

 
[h1]New Commander[/h1]
 

A new commander called Andrey Zaytsev is available for unlocking all the progression vehicles of the new dealer.

Andrey Zaytsev was born in Baranovichi, Belarus. As a child, he excelled in mathematics and had no interest in a military career. However, during his mandatory one-year service, he has proven himself as an excellent tank gunner. As a result, he decided to stay in the army and gradually shifted his interests towards PMCs. Following several successful operations, he was promoted to the role of a vehicle commander.

 
[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/zaytsev.jpg[/img]
 

In Armored Warfare, Andrey Zaytsev is a sniper commander intended for long range gameplay and offering excellent bonuses for this role as long as the vehicle he commands remains stationary.

 
[h1]Final Mission of the “Caribbean Crisis” Story Arc[/h1]
 

Update 0.24 concludes the first Special Operation with a vicious fight for survival against the forces of Clayburn Industries in Jamaica, sent in to destroy all targets regardless of any previous affiliations. The players must ally themselves with Magnus Holter to survive the corporate onslaught. More of the story will be revealed during the mission itself!

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0008_13.jpg[/img]

There are four new achievements in the mission:
[list][*]For completing the fourth mission of the Caribbean Crisis Special Operation[/*][*]For destroying enemy officers[/*][*]For receiving all other achievements of the Special Operation[/*][*]A secret achievement[/*][/list]
Please note that the fourth mission of the first Special Operation now counts as “the last mission of the first Special Operation” for the purpose of achievement requirements (if an achievement needs to be completed in “the last mission”, it will, from the point of 0.24 introduction, be the fourth mission, not the third one).

 
[b]Gallery [/b]
 

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0013_11.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0017_6.jpg[/img]

 

 

 
[h1]New map “Alpine Valley” for Global Operations[/h1]
 

Narrow gorges of Switzerland, surrounded by titanic mountains, are perhaps not the best terrain for armored vehicle operations, but warriors go where they are needed, regardless of whether they fight out of sense of duty or for cold, hard cash. War has come to this alpine valley and it’s your task to root out the enemy and control this strategic location for your client, commander.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/alpine1.jpg[/img]

The new large Alpine Valley map for Global Operations features three wildcards, two of which are brand new:
[list][*]Helicopters, flying around while spotting and firing at the enemy[/*][*]Artillery, shelling the opposing forces at long distances[/*][*]Airstrikes by bomber jets[/*][/list]
You can read more about the map in [url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/introducing-alpine-valley-map][b]a dedicated article.[/b][/url]

 
[b]Gallery [/b]
 

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/alpine2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/alpine3.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/alpine4.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/alpine5.jpg[/img]

 

 

Apart from these main features, Update 0.24 includes a large number of improvements and fixes of the existing game mechanics.

 
[h1]List of 0.24 Changes[/h1]
 

 
[b][u]Gameplay Mechanisms[/u][/b]
 

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list][*]AFK and inactive players will no longer receive the base payment for battle participation which would normally prevent them from lose credits in a battle[/*][*]Improved Spall Liner retrofit now reduces internal module damage by 25% or 50% (for v2)[/*][*]Updated the description of PvE consumables to correspond to their actual mechanics[/*][*]Order of the Captor will no longer be awarded for battles that end up with a drew (simultaneous base capture)[/*][*]We changed the way crew saving throws work – in a case of a successful saving throw, the crew will now take 15 percent damage instead of the damage being completely negated[/*][*]Changed the icon of the “Specialist” commander skill[/*][*]Recon and Master Gunner medals are now possible to obtain in Special Operations[/*][*]We changed the way consumable stacking works – if you take two repair kits or med kits to battle (a larger one and a smaller one) at the same time, only the larger bonus of the two will work (they no longer stack)[/*][*]Updated the description of several Epic Medals[/*][*]Fixed the “Stuck on Authentication” issue[/*][*]The In Your Face challenge (dealing damage while being within 150 meters) has been removed from the list of challenges[/*][/list]
[b]PvE AI Behavior Changes[/b]

In Update 0.24, in order to address the AI ATGM damage output, we are introducing two changes with significant impact on AI behavior:
[list][*]The AI team composition was adjusted to include fewer vehicles that rely heavily on guided missiles[/*][*]We adjusted the rules for AI module damage dealing and targeting in order to eliminate the cases where the AI opponents keep your modules permanently destroyed (this change applies to non-ATGM damage as well)[/*][/list]
These changes, along with the previously introduced ATGM rate of fire reduction, will bring the general AI ATGM damage output to the desired levels.

[b]New Vehicles[/b]

We are introducing the following new vehicles in Update 0.24 along with a new dealer, Oscar Faraday.
[list][*]Rooikat 76 Tier 5 AFV[/*][*]EE-18 Sucuri Tier 6 TD[/*][*]NM142 Tier 7 TD[/*][*]Sprut-SD Tier 8 TD[/*][*]ASCOD LT-105 Tier 8 Premium LT[/*][*]K21 XC8 Tier 10 LT[/*][*]VT4 Tier 8 MBT (available in Zhang Feng’s vehicle pool)[/*][/list]
The following items will also be available from this new dealer:
[list][*]3 dealer decals[/*][*]2 dealer avatars (one of them animated)[/*][*]3 player titles[/*][*]3 base colors[/*][*]New commander (sniper style, his basic ability is an increase of camouflage factor when stationary)[/*][/list]

notes.title: Introducing Update 0.24 “Caribbean Crisis – Part II”
notes.content:
Commanders!

We are happy to announce [b]Update 0.24 “Caribbean Crisis – Part II”[/b], bringing a number of progression vehicles to the game along with a new dealer!

The main features of Update 0.24 “Caribbean Crisis – Part II” include:
[list][*]New dealer with a branch of light vehicles[/*][*]VT-4 Main Battle Tank[/*][*]New commander[/*][*]Final mission of the first Special Operation[/*][*]New map “Alpine Valley” for Global Operations[/*][/list]
 
[h1]New Dealer[/h1] 

In this update, we’re introducing a new dealer called Oscar Faraday. Born in Warwick, Great Britain, Oscar Faraday is the epitome of a British gentleman. But don’t let his smooth look and calm demeanor fool you – he’s one of the most dangerous people on the planet. Trained by the famous British MI5 secret service, he learned to appreciate finesse, preferring stealth over brute force during his decades-long career as His Majesty’s cold-hearted killer.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/faraday.jpg[/img] 

His choice of vehicles reflects his nature – he offers machines capable taking out targets quickly but, most importantly, silently. Many of his machines also have unique features, described in existing or upcoming detailed articles.

These vehicles include:
[list][*][b]Tier 5 AFV:[/b] Rooikat ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-rooikat][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][*][b]Tier 6 TD:[/b] EE-18 Sucuri II ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-ee-18-sucuri-ii][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][*][b]Tier 7 TD:[/b] NM142 ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-nm142][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][*][b]Tier 8 TD:[/b] Sprut-SD ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-sprut-sd][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][*][b]Tier 8 Premium LT:[/b] ASCOD LT-105 ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-ascod-lt-105][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][*][b]Tier 10 LT:[/b] K21 XC8 ([url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-k21-xc8][b]read more[/b][/url])[/*][/list]
Another Tier 10 Tank Destroyer, the [url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-kornet-em][b]Kornet EM[/b][/url], will appear in one of the 0.24 updates, coming in the near future!

[b]Gallery [/b] 

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/rooikat_0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/sucuri.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/nm.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/sprut.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/k21.jpg[/img]

Each of these vehicles is unique to a degree. The Rooikat is slow for its Tier and Class, but it is well armored and has high view range, making it a potent passive scout. The Sucuri II on the other hand is a classic wheeled Tank Destroyer. Its unique ability is its Boomerang suspension, allowing it to reach places where other wheeled vehicles couldn’t go. The NM142 Tank Destroyer is, on the other hand, a typical missile carrier. It is unique in its ability to fire Top Attack missiles that target thin roof armor. This makes it an excellent tool in your fight against static entrenched MBTs. The Tier 8 Sprut-SD is a very agile tracked vehicle with a powerful gun but with very thin armor – in skilled hands, it becomes a truly deadly tool. And, last but not least, there’s the K21 XC8 Light Tank that can use the Designate Target AFV ability and is perhaps the best vehicle in the game when it comes to fast flanking maneuvers.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/ascod_0.jpg[/img]

The [b]ASCOD LT-105 Premium Light Tank[/b], also available in the game for Gold, is the first premium vehicle on which you can select one of two alternative turrets – either a manned one that is larger but has better ammunition, or an unmanned one that can fire in bursts but is inferior in penetration and accuracy.

This dealer himself is also unique in several aspects.

First, it does not start on Tier 1, but on Tier 5 with the Rooikat AFV. In order to start unlocking his vehicles, players have to own at least one Tier 5 progression vehicle.

Secondly, ingame Reputation is not used as the primary currency for this dealer. In order to unlock each vehicle, certain goals (achievements) have to be completed. For example, to unlock the Tier 6 Rooikat, one of the following conditions has to be met:
[list][*]Deal 75.000 damage using a Tier 5 or higher Light Tank in PvP[/*][*]Deal 300.000 damage using a Tier 5 or higher Light Tank in Global Operations[/*][*]Deal 600.000 damage using a Tier 5 or higher Light Tank in PvE[/*][/list]
The progression is also not strictly linear:
[list][*]Tier 5, Tier 6 and Tier 7 vehicles can be unlocked independently on each other by completing their achievements[/*][*]Tier 8 vehicle is available to unlock once all three previous vehicles are unlocked[/*][*]Tier 10 vehicles are available to unlock once all four previous vehicles are unlocked[/*][/list]
[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/avatar_animated.png[/img]

Once unlocked, each vehicle is upgraded by standard means, although, apart from modules, the new vehicles offer a number of interesting bonuses unlockable for Reputation, including:
[list][*]Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]Base colors[/*][*]Camouflage patterns[/*][*]Decals[/*][*]Player titles[/*][*]Player avatars[/*][*]Unique commander[/*][/list]
We hope that you will enjoy this new dealer and his vehicles!
 
[h1]VT-4 Main Battle Tank[/h1] 

In Update 0.24, we are also introducing one new progression Tier 8 Main Battle Tank to Zhang Feng’s vehicle pool – the [b]Tier 8 VT-4![/b]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/vt4_0.jpg[/img]

The VT-4 is a modern Chinese export vehicle. Armed with a 125mm smoothbore gun, it currently represents the best any country without its own tank development program can buy on an open market. You can read more about it in a [url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-vt-4][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url]

 
[b]Gallery [/b]
 

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/vt41.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/vt42_0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/vt43.jpg[/img]

 

 

 
[h1]New Commander[/h1]
 

A new commander called Andrey Zaytsev is available for unlocking all the progression vehicles of the new dealer.

Andrey Zaytsev was born in Baranovichi, Belarus. As a child, he excelled in mathematics and had no interest in a military career. However, during his mandatory one-year service, he has proven himself as an excellent tank gunner. As a result, he decided to stay in the army and gradually shifted his interests towards PMCs. Following several successful operations, he was promoted to the role of a vehicle commander.

 
[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/zaytsev.jpg[/img]
 

In Armored Warfare, Andrey Zaytsev is a sniper commander intended for long range gameplay and offering excellent bonuses for this role as long as the vehicle he commands remains stationary.

 
[h1]Final Mission of the “Caribbean Crisis” Story Arc[/h1]
 

Update 0.24 concludes the first Special Operation with a vicious fight for survival against the forces of Clayburn Industries in Jamaica, sent in to destroy all targets regardless of any previous affiliations. The players must ally themselves with Magnus Holter to survive the corporate onslaught. More of the story will be revealed during the mission itself!

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0008_13.jpg[/img]

There are four new achievements in the mission:
[list][*]For completing the fourth mission of the Caribbean Crisis Special Operation[/*][*]For destroying enemy officers[/*][*]For receiving all other achievements of the Special Operation[/*][*]A secret achievement[/*][/list]
Please note that the fourth mission of the first Special Operation now counts as “the last mission of the first Special Operation” for the purpose of achievement requirements (if an achievement needs to be completed in “the last mission”, it will, from the point of 0.24 introduction, be the fourth mission, not the third one).

 
[b]Gallery [/b]
 

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0013_11.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0017_6.jpg[/img]

 

 

 
[h1]New map “Alpine Valley” for Global Operations[/h1]
 

Narrow gorges of Switzerland, surrounded by titanic mountains, are perhaps not the best terrain for armored vehicle operations, but warriors go where they are needed, regardless of whether they fight out of sense of duty or for cold, hard cash. War has come to this alpine valley and it’s your task to root out the enemy and control this strategic location for your client, commander.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/alpine1.jpg[/img]

The new large Alpine Valley map for Global Operations features three wildcards, two of which are brand new:
[list][*]Helicopters, flying around while spotting and firing at the enemy[/*][*]Artillery, shelling the opposing forces at long distances[/*][*]Airstrikes by bomber jets[/*][/list]
You can read more about the map in [url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/introducing-alpine-valley-map][b]a dedicated article.[/b][/url]

 
[b]Gallery [/b]
 

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/alpine2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/alpine5.jpg[/img]

 

 

Apart from these main features, Update 0.24 includes a large number of improvements and fixes of the existing game mechanics.

 
[h1]List of 0.24 Changes[/h1]
 

 
[b][u]Gameplay Mechanisms[/u][/b]
 

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list][*]AFK and inactive players will no longer receive the base payment for battle participation which would normally prevent them from lose credits in a battle[/*][*]Improved Spall Liner retrofit now reduces internal module damage by 25% or 50% (for v2)[/*][*]Updated the description of PvE consumables to correspond to their actual mechanics[/*][*]Order of the Captor will no longer be awarded for battles that end up with a drew (simultaneous base capture)[/*][*]We changed the way crew saving throws work – in a case of a successful saving throw, the crew will now take 15 percent damage instead of the damage being completely negated[/*][*]Changed the icon of the “Specialist” commander skill[/*][*]Recon and Master Gunner medals are now possible to obtain in Special Operations[/*][*]We changed the way consumable stacking works – if you take two repair kits or med kits to battle (a larger one and a smaller one) at the same time, only the larger bonus of the two will work (they no longer stack)[/*][*]Updated the description of several Epic Medals[/*][*]Fixed the “Stuck on Authentication” issue[/*][*]The In Your Face challenge (dealing damage while being within 150 meters) has been removed from the list of challenges[/*][/list]
[b]PvE AI Behavior Changes[/b]

In Update 0.24, in order to address the AI ATGM damage output, we are introducing two changes with significant impact on AI behavior:

[b][u]Issues and Corrections[/u][/b]
 
[list][*]Fixed a bug where players sometimes received a “splash damage” message even though they fired APFSDS shells[/*][*]Fixed a bug where some vehicle models did not display penetration decals properly[/*][*]Fixed the appearance of wooden handles of various tools attached to tanks so that they don’t look metallic[/*][*]Fixed a bug where destroying an autoloader had no influence on an already ongoing loading cycle[/*][*]Fixed a bug where the engine module on the Upgrade screen appeared in the Firepower category instead of Mobility[/*][*]Fixed a bug where completing the challenges that required players to play a certain type of vehicle did not count properly in several cases[/*][*]Fixed a bug that caused the screen to become black if a player changed the graphics settings from minimum to maximum while in night vision mode[/*][*]Fixed the light and mud effects when in the night vision mode[/*][*]Fixed a bug that caused rare crashes when exiting a battle to your Garage[/*][*]Improved the processes to reduce the client size, better optimized the client for 32bit systems[/*][/list]
 
[b]We hope that you will enjoy it and will see you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Offer: Predators
notes.content:
Commanders!

What better way to complement the celebrations of the [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/celebrating-world-wildlife-day][b]World Wildlife Day[/b][/url] than with an offer of some of the most merciless predators of Armored Warfare battlefields – [b]the Shark vehicles![/b]

But beware – these terrors from the deep are anything but endangered. Instead, they are eager to turn the tables and hunt you down to extinction. Either you’re a predator, or a prey – such is the merciless law of the wild!

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080-1.jpg[/img]

The [b]Shark edition[/b] vehicles feature level 5 crews and unique camouflage. They include:
[list][*][b]ERC 90 Shark[/b] Tier 5 Premium Tank Destroyer[/*][*][b]FV721 Fox Shark[/b] Tier 6 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/*][*][b]Stingray 2 Shark[/b] Tier 7 Premium Light Tank[/*][*][b]T-80U Shark[/b] Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank[/*][/list]
The Shark vehicles are permanently available in the Web Shop both for both standard currency and for Gold.

[b]From March 2 to March 16, 2018[/b], the abovementioned vehicles are also available in the following special bundles:
 
[h1]ERC 90 Shark[/h1]
 
The ERC 90 (also known as “Sagaie”) is a French heavily armed reconnaissance vehicle and tank destroyer, named after a type of African spear. It was developed by Panhard from 1975 specifically for export, although France did purchase 192 in the 1980s. You can learn more about its history [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-erc-90-sagaie][b]in our dedicated article![/b][/url]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/shark_erc_90_2.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the ERC 90 is a Tier 5 Premium Tank Destroyer. It’s one of the most popular vehicles amongst Tier 5 tournament players – and for a good reason! It combines a powerful 90mm cannon with excellent mobility, making it a truly deadly opponent. It’s fast and agile and when operated by an experienced player, the enemies don’t have a clue what hit them.

Aside from the permanent offer (including for Gold), it is available in the following bundle:

[b]Improved Bundle[/b] with 20% discount, containing:
[list][*]ERC 90 Shark Tier 5 Premium Tank Destroyer[/*][*]5 Gold Loot Crates[/*][*]2 Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]7 days of Premium Time[/*][*]500 Gold[/*][/list]
 
[url=https://aw.my.com/web-shop][img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/webshop_button_v1.png[/img][/url]
 
[h1]FV721 Fox Shark[/h1]
 
The Fox CVR(W) was born in the early 1960s as a complementary vehicle to the CVR(T) vehicle series (that included the Scorpion and the Scimitar tracked reconnaissance vehicles) and was the result of a program to replace the aging Alvis Saladin. Produced from 1972-1973 to around 1985, roughly 325 vehicles were made, of which Britain kept 200 and exported the rest. It was never a very successful export vehicle – more than 100 went to Nigeria and Malawi (an unknown number remains in service to this day) and the British Foxes were phased out of service by 1994. The phased out Fox turrets along with phased out Scorpion hulls were actually used to produce a rather peculiar hybrid vehicle, the Sabre.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/shark_fv721.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the FV721 Fox Shark is a Tier 6 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle. The FV721 Fox is one of the fastest and nimblest vehicles of Armored Warfare. It can dance around its opponents, unloading round after round of 30mm ammunition into their soft, rear areas, or destroy them from distance using guided missiles. It’s also one of the best spotters in the game, making it extremely valuable to any team it finds itself in.

Aside from the permanent offer (including for Gold), it is available in the following bundles:

[b]Improved Bundle[/b] with 21% discount, containing:
[list][*]FV721 Fox Shark Tier 6 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/*][*]5 Gold Loot Crates[/*][*]10 Gold Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost Tokens[/*][*]15 Gold Crew Insignia tokens[/*][*]15 Gold Commander Insignia tokens[/*][*]15 Gold Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]15 Gold Credits Insignia tokens[/*][*]15 Gold Global Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]1.100 Gold[/*][/list]
[b]Prime Bundle[/b] with 32% discount, containing:
[list][*]FV721 Fox Shark Tier 6 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/*][*]15 Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]15 Platinum Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost Tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Crew Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Commander Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Credits Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Global Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]2.200 Gold[/*][/list]
 
[url=https://aw.my.com/web-shop][img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/webshop_button_v1.png[/img][/url]
 
[h1]Stingray 2 Shark[/h1] 

The Stingray 2 Light Tank was developed by Cadillac Gage as an upgraded variant of the original Stingray. The philosophy behind both Stingrays was to install powerful, MBT-class 105 mm rifled cannon on a light, mobile and – most importantly – affordable chassis. Despite its qualities, the vehicle was never a commercial success because the market became flooded with Cold War surplus.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/shark_stingray_2.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Stingray 2 Shark is a Premium version of the Tier 7 Light Tank, featuring unique camouflage and Level 5 crews. It’s one of the most powerful vehicles of its Tier. While its armor is not nearly as strong as that of an MBT of equal Tier, its agility and firepower more than make up for that. The Stingray 2 Shark is a true hunter on the battlefield, running circles around its enemies and firing its powerful 105mm cannon at their vulnerable sides. In skilled hands, it’s absolutely devastating.

Aside from the permanent offer (including for Gold), it is available in the following bundles:

[b]Improved Bundle[/b] with 26% discount, containing:
[list][*]Stingray 2 Shark Tier 7 Premium Light Tank[/*][*]20 Gold Loot Crates[/*][*]15 Gold Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost Tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Crew Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Commander Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Credits Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Global Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]2.500 Gold[/*][/list]
[b]Prime Bundle[/b] with 42% discount, containing:
[list][*]Stingray 2 Shark Tier 7 Premium Light Tank[/*][*]25 Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]25 Platinum Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost Tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Crew Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Commander Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Credits Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Global Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]6.500 Gold[/*][/list]
 
[url=https://aw.my.com/web-shop][img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/webshop_button_v1.png[/img][/url]
 
[h1]T-80U Shark[/h1] 

The T-80U Main Battle Tank was the best mass-produced variant of the T-80 series. Back in the 1980s, it was specifically designed to establish Soviet superiority on Cold War battlefields. Featuring new Kontakt-5 set of Explosive Reactive Armor, it was possibly the most dangerous Soviet Main Battle Tank of the time. To read more about its history, please [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-t-80u][b]visit our dedicated article.[/b][/url]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/shark_t-80u_2.jpg[/img]

The T-80U Shark is a Premium version of the Tier 7 Main Battle Tank, featuring unique camouflage and Level 5 crews. It’s an excellent short to medium range combat vehicle, capable of disposing of all the enemies it encounters with relative ease.

Aside from the permanent offer (including for Gold), it is available in the following bundles:

[b]Improved Bundle[/b] with 26% discount, containing:
[list][*]T-80U Shark Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank[/*][*]20 Gold Loot Crates[/*][*]15 Gold Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost Tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Crew Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Commander Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Credits Insignia tokens[/*][*]25 Gold Global Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]2.500 Gold[/*][/list]
[b]Prime Bundle[/b] with 42% discount, containing:
[list][*]T-80U Shark Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank[/*][*]25 Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]25 Platinum Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost Tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Crew Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Commander Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Credits Insignia tokens[/*][*]50 Gold Global Reputation Insignia tokens[/*][*]6.500 Gold[/*][/list]
All four Shark vehicles can be obtained at once in the [b]Shark Bundle[/b] with 48% discount, containing:
[list][*]ERC 90 Shark Tier 5 Premium Tank Destroyer[/*][*]FV721 Fox Shark Tier 6 Premium Armored Fighting Vehicle[/*][*]Stingray 2 Shark Tier 7 Premium Light Tank[/*][*]T-80U Shark Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank[/*][*]50 Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]25 Platinum Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost Tokens[/*][*]10.000 Gold[/*][/list]
 
[url=https://aw.my.com/web-shop][img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/webshop_button_v1.png[/img][/url] 

And last but not least, we are offering the following Shark-themed decals, separately or together:
[list][*]White Shark Decal[/*][*]Black Shark Decal[/*][*]Grey Shark Decal[/*][/list]
[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/icon_all_sharks.jpg[/img]

[b]Please note:[/b]
[list][*]This event starts on March 2, 18:00 CET (9 AM PST)[/*][*]This event ends on March 16, 16:00 CET (7 AM PST)[/*][*]Every bundle can only be purchased once per account[/*][*]Every bundle is delivered either to the EU server or to the NA server, based on your server selection[/*][*]If you already owned a bundle vehicle, you will instead receive its Compensation Value in Gold instead[/*][/list]
[b]We hope that you will enjoy this offer and will see you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Developer Diary: PvE AI and Guided Missiles
notes.content:
Commanders!

One of the most common questions from the PvE-oriented part of the community is that of PvE AI-operated guided missiles or, more specifically, their amount and accuracy. It was often felt that the amount of guided missiles fired by the AI opponents in PvE missions was excessive and their accuracy too high, resulting in a number of hits that very few vehicles have a chance to withstand.

We’ve seen the community feedback and we’ve examined the situation carefully. On January 30, 2018, we’ve introduced Update 0.23.4374, which reduced the AI guided missile rate of fire by 20% with the exception of the T-15 that received 60% reduction to its rate of fire. This step was regarded by us as an initial “hotfix” to the missile situation that would allow us to measure the effect and see what impact the change would have on general PvE gameplay.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/tank1small_0.jpg[/img]

Let’s take a look at how the situation appeared before the abovementioned update with the EU server Tier 10 PvE as an example.

To demonstrate the previous state of the ATGMs, we’ll use a percentage of damage taken versus nominal ATGM damage and we’ll compare that to how much damage the armor-piercing shells fired at the vehicle in battle did – and then we will draw a comparison.

First, an example of what this means. Let’s say your vehicle was hit by 4 anti-tank guided missiles, each one with the nominal damage value of 1000 – in other words, you were hit 4000 nominal damage points in total. Of the four missiles, two bounced, one did 350 points of damage and one did 1000 points damage. You were thus hit for 1350 damage out of potential 4000, or 33.75%.

Pre-Update 0.23.4374, the following percentages of nominal damage were dealt per battle:
[list][*]Challenger 2 ATDU: 2.71% (compared to 19.63% for kinetic rounds)[/*][*]Leopard 2AX: 23.52% (compared to 29.95% for kinetic rounds)[/*][*]PL-01: 14.19% (compared to 51.73% for kinetic rounds)[/*][*]SPHINX: 106.98% (compared to 72.65% for kinetic rounds)[/*][*]Armata: 23.96% (compared to 28.35% for kinetic rounds)[/*][*]T-15: 66.97% (compared to 36.90% for kinetic rounds)[/*][*]Type 99A2: 16.46% (compared to 27.86% for kinetic rounds)[/*][*]Wilk XC8: 70.59% (compared to 75.01% for kinetic rounds)[/*][*]XM1A3: 18.49% (compared to 23.23% for kinetic rounds)[/*][/list]
To reiterate, what this means is that for example, all the missiles that impact the Leopard 2AX per battle deal 23.52% damage of their nominal (average) damage. Two things are worth noting:
[list][*]Challenger 2 ATDU is incredibly tough versus guided missiles, so is PL-01 thanks to their composite armor[/*][*]A value over 100% is possible (see SPHINX) – what this means is that the missiles, that are mostly HEAT based, not only do their base damage, but also the HEAT shell type bonus damage above the nominal one[/*][/list]
The following share of all damage taken per battle was caused by AI ATGMs pre-Update 0.23.4374:
[list][*]Challenger 2 ATDU: 19.88%[/*][*]Leopard 2AX: 53.67%[/*][*]PL-01: 16.19%[/*][*]SPHINX: 55.04%[/*][*]Armata: 53.75%[/*][*]T-15: 53.47%[/*][*]Type 99A2: 49.28%[/*][*]Wilk XC8: 45.66%[/*][*]XM1A3: 55.68%[/*][/list]
The value above is influenced by a large number of factors such as the armor layout, vehicle mobility, play style etc., but generally, it can be said that roughly one half of all damage taken by MBTs in Tier 10 PvE Hard battles was caused by ATGMs.

Now, let’s take a look at how Update 0.23.4374 changed the share of damage caused by ATGMs. After the launch of the abovementioned patch, the values started looking as such:
[list][*]Challenger 2 ATDU: 9.02% (-120.47%)[/*][*]Leopard 2AX: 32.77% (-63.77%)[/*][*]PL-01: 12.29% (-31.75%)[/*][*]SPHINX: 43.70% (-25.96%)[/*][*]Armata: 33.96% (-59.54%)[/*][*]T-15: 42.26% (-15.59%)[/*][*]Type 99A2: 31.66% (-55.68%)[/*][*]Wilk XC8: 35.87% (-27.30%)[/*][*]XM1A3: 33.71% (-65.16%)[/*][/list]
You can naturally see a much bigger drop on the MBTs since they are the ones the AI vehicles target the most since they are often the closest to them and draw the most “aggro” (the heavier the vehicle, the likely the AI is to target it with MBTs being the most likely to draw attention). In other words, [b]only roughly 28% of damage[/b] taken in PvE battles by MBTs is now on caused by ATGMs.

Compared to the pre-update scenario, this value was, for the Tier 10 MBTs, reduced by [b]roughly 72% on average.[/b]

As you can see, the update had a significant effect.

There are, however, other considerations and issues we’ll be addressing, chief among them being the question of [b]AI module damage and targeting.[/b]

We ran an exhausting series of experiments and reached several conclusions regarding the plans for the AI behavior. In Update 0.24, we are introducing two changes with significant impact on AI behavior:
[list][*]The AI team composition will change to include fewer vehicles that rely heavily on guided missiles[/*][*]We’ll adjust the rules for AI module damage dealing and targeting in order to eliminate the cases where the AI opponents keep your modules permanently destroyed (this change applies to non-ATGM damage as well)[/*][/list]
These changes, along with the previously introduced ATGM rate of fire reduction, will bring the general AI ATGM damage output to the desired levels.

This is, however, not the full scope of planned changes – in one of the future updates we are planning to take a look at the AI behavior in general and to overhaul it to improve the PvE experience.

Please note that we do not want to introduce exceedingly frustrating elements to the game or to leave the existing ones unaddressed. However, we do not want to eliminate the threat of AI ATGMs from the battlefield completely. The ATGMs are one of the key weapons in AI arsenal and we definitely want to keep them a threat, offering players an appropriate challenge.

[b]We’ll see you on the battlefield![/b]
